title: Certified Addiction Counselor (CAC I/II) - Substace Use Disorder
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Certified Addiction Counselor (CAC I/CAC II) – Substance Use Disorder Services



Location: Washington, DC
Work Setting: Hybrid; regular in-office presence required
Employment Type: Independent Contractor

Program: Substance Use Disorder (SUD) Services



About Spring Leaf Solutions

Spring Leaf Solutions is a Washington, DC-based behavioral health organization providing community-based mental health and substance use disorder services. Our team works collaboratively to provide accessible, person-centered care that supports consumers throughout treatment and recovery.



Position Summary

Spring Leaf Solutions is seeking an experienced Certified Addiction Counselor (CAC I or CAC II) to provide direct counseling services to consumers participating in our Substance Use Disorder (SUD) programs.


This is a direct-care counseling role with primary responsibility for facilitating in-person group counseling sessions and maintaining an assigned caseload for individual substance use counseling. The CAC will work collaboratively with clinical leadership, Recovery Support Specialists (RSS), assessors, and other members of the treatment team to support consumer progress and continuity of care.


Required Licensure/Certification

Candidates must hold a current, active credential in good standing in the District of Columbia appropriate for providing addiction counseling services.

Qualifying addiction counseling credentials include:

  • Certified Addiction Counselor I (CAC I) – District of Columbia
  • Certified Addiction Counselor II (CAC II) – District of Columbia

Candidates must maintain all certifications, continuing education, and other requirements necessary to practice in the District throughout their engagement with Spring Leaf Solutions.



Required Qualifications

  • Experience providing direct substance use disorder counseling services.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating group counseling sessions.
  • Ability to manage an assigned caseload and independently conduct individual counseling sessions.
  • Knowledge of substance use disorders, recovery principles, relapse prevention, stages of change, and person-centered treatment approaches.


Preferred Qualifications

  • CAC II certification preferred.
  • Experience providing both group and individual counseling within outpatient or intensive outpatient SUD programs.
  • Experience working with adults with co-occurring mental health and substance use conditions.
  • Familiarity with DC DBH Chapter 63 SUD service requirements.
  • Experience with treatment planning, treatment plan updates, reassessments, and/or SUD assessments.
  • Experience working within multidisciplinary community behavioral health teams.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record systems and Medicaid clinical documentation requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate scheduled in-person group counseling sessions for consumers receiving substance use disorder treatment.
  • Maintain an assigned caseload and provide individual substance use counseling consistent with each consumer's assessed needs and treatment plan.
  • Provide counseling focused on recovery, relapse prevention, behavior change, coping skills, motivation, and achievement of individualized treatment goals.
  • Establish effective therapeutic relationships with consumers while maintaining appropriate professional and clinical boundaries.
  • Monitor consumer participation, progress, barriers to treatment, and changes in clinical needs.
  • Document individual and group counseling services accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Managers, Recovery Support Specialists, assessors, and other members of the interdisciplinary care team.
  • Participate in treatment planning and provide clinical input regarding consumer progress, needs, goals, and recommended interventions.
  • Identify changes in consumer needs, functioning, or risk and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.
  • Participate in required clinical supervision, case consultation, and care coordination activities.
  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable Spring Leaf Solutions, DC DBH, DC Health, Medicaid, and federal requirements governing substance use disorder treatment services.
  • As needed, assist with clinical assessments, reassessments, or treatment plan development and updates within the individual's credentialed scope of practice and organizational procedures. These activities are supportive responsibilities and are not the primary function of this position.


Work Setting & Schedule

This is a hybrid position consisting of both in-person and remote responsibilities based on consumer and program needs.


Because group counseling is a core responsibility of the position, CACs must be available to facilitate regularly scheduled, in-person group counseling sessions at the Spring Leaf Solutions office in Washington, DC.

Individual counseling sessions and other responsibilities may be provided in person or remotely when clinically appropriate and permitted by program requirements.


Schedules will be coordinated with SUD program leadership based on assigned caseloads, group schedules, consumer needs, and service demand.

title: Creative Play Lab - Prototypes Internship
description:
Job Description

Play Discovery Prototypes Internship:

Do you enjoy making prototypes by using various tools and machines?

Join the LEGO® Group’s Creative Play Lab for a Paid 5-Month Internship at our Headquarters in Billund, Denmark!

If you have an unquenchable passion for exploring new play opportunities and making things with innovative prototyping techniques then you could be one of the talented students joining our Play Discovery Prototypes team this year!

Internship Dates: February 1, 2025, to June 30, 2025

About us:

Creative Play Lab (CPL) is at the heart of new product innovations at the LEGO Group. We experiment with emerging technologies, tinker with new tools, band together with new brands and integrate new inventions into the LEGO system of play to create the toys of tomorrow’s world. As an intern in the Play Discovery Prototypes team, you will learn to use our prototyping tools to get hands on with a variety of prototyping tasks from day one. You’ll get to work across our wide range of machines, developing your equipment expertise to master your craft as you support the teams in designing, prototyping, and iterating on the toys of the future with your prototyping skills.

Meet the team:

We're professional craftspeople from diverse backgrounds, including industrial designers, mechanical engineers, machinists and carpenters who deploy our expertise in equipment, printing and manufacturing to develop innovative new ways to piece together the prototypes of our future toys and internal prototypes. We explore all the possibilities for how we can make designs become reality with our unique design-for-production (or making) perspective. We ask ‘have you thought of making it this way?’ to spark ideas in our inventor colleagues to turn their concepts into physically ‘prototypable’ play.

Internship Eligibility:

  • Currently enrolled in full time education in an art, design, engineering or other craft discipline

  • Available to move to / commute to Billund, Denmark for the duration of the internship

  • Free for the entire internship period from February 1, 2025, to June 30, 2025

  • Speak English to at least a conversational / intermediate level

  • You are a hands on individual with a bias towards learning-by-making

Experience with at least some of the following disciplines:

  • CAD and CAM softwares

  • Adobe suite

  • Graphic Print programmes

  • 3D Printing techniques

  • Milling and CNC Machining

Responsibilities:

You’re here to learn from the best so we appreciate that there will be a lot of new things for you to get familiar with. We want you to bring all your energy, enthusiasm and experiences to work every day so we can achieve amazing things together while you learn along the way!

  • Use our equipment, tools and machines to support your colleagues with creating prototypes

  • Push the boundaries of ‘prototypable’ play by inventing smart solutions to overcome machining challenges

  • Bring your unique perspectives on how we problem solve for manufacturability

  • Suggest new trends or techniques we could explore in our prototypes department

  • Be resourceful in overcoming prototyping challenges and help others to problem solve their designs

  • Work with our range of equipment including CNC machines, milling machines, bandsaws etc

  • Work using a range of materials including plastic, wood, metal, textiles and paper/cardboard

  • Create new LEGO elements and other prototypes being resourceful to use every tool at your disposal to hack, build and learn every day

  • Explore new play opportunities and other prototyping solutions by making and testing different ideas to gather feedback on which techniques and designs work best and iterate on ideas collaboratives

  • Collaborate with a team of experienced designers, developers, engineers, artists and researchers to drive our innovation missions forward

Perks:

  • Shape the future of play in Creative Play Lab and contribute to the LEGO models and experiences of the future

  • Gain access to our world class prototyping studio and gain experience with a huge range of softwares, tools and machines

  • Work with a passionate team of like-minded prototypers where you’ll learn something new every day and build your professional network

  • Live and work in the global headquarters of the LEGO Group in Billund, Denmark and explore our state-of-the-art campus

  • Gain an insight into how an innovation department operates and the processes through which we design our model portfolio at the LEGO Group

Application:

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Please ensure your application is completed in English. To apply, simply submit the following by January 5th 2025.

  • An A4 size poster (landscape) designed by you to showcase why you think you are a good fit for the internship. You may use text, photographs, colour etc. to communicate your enthusiasm, talent and values. Please attach it in .PDF format to your application.

  • A current CV detailing your education and relevant experiences.

  • A full portfolio showcasing a more in-depth range of your work. This should include projects that highlight your interests, reflect your passions and demonstrate your hobbies. Please attach it in .PDF format to your application or provide a link to an online portfolio to showcase video / audio etc.

Come and join us as we use prototypes to discover the future of play!

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

title: HR Operations Partner, Americas
description:
Position Summary


The HR Operations Partner, Americas plays an important role in supporting employees, managers and leaders across the Americas region. Reporting to the Head of HR, you will work across the full employee lifecycle, helping to ensure employees receive an excellent experience from recruitment and onboarding through to development, benefits administration and offboarding.

This is a broad and varied HR generalist role where no two days are likely to be the same. You'll work closely with employees, managers, external providers and colleagues across the wider Quortex and Lumine organisations, helping to deliver effective people processes while contributing to a positive and inclusive employee experience.

The role offers significant exposure to international HR practices and provides opportunities to participate in regional and global HR projects. It is well suited to someone who enjoys working independently, takes pride in delivering excellent service and is interested in developing their career within a growing global organisation.


Key Responsibilities


Employee Lifecycle Management


• Own and administer all employee lifecycle activities for employees, contractors and EOR workers across the Americas.

• Coordinate onboarding activities including employment documentation, system setup, inductions and manager readiness.

• Prepare and manage employment changes including promotions, compensation changes, transfers, leave arrangements and contractual updates.

• Coordinate offboarding activities, ensuring all employment, payroll, benefits and system actions are completed accurately and on time.

• Maintain accurate employee records and ensure data integrity within Workday and associated systems.


Employee & Manager Support


• Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers throughout the region.

• Provide practical guidance on HR policies, procedures and employment-related matters.

• Support managers with performance, attendance, leave management and routine employee relations issues.

• Escalate complex employee relations matters appropriately whilst maintaining a positive employee experience.

• Support compliance with applicable US and Canadian employment laws and company policies


Recruitment & Talent Support


• Support managers throughout the recruitment process including interview scheduling, candidate communications and offer administration.

• Ensure a smooth and professional experience for candidates and new hires.

• Assist with talent review, performance management and employee development processes.


Payroll, Benefits & Provider Management


• Coordinate employee data changes and payroll inputs with payroll providers and Finance teams.

• Manage relationships with external benefits brokers, insurers, EOR providers and employment service vendors.

• Support annual benefits renewals, enrolment activities and employee communications.

• Assist employees with benefits-related queries and ensure timely resolution of issues.


Projects & Continuous Improvement


• Lead or support regional implementation of global HR initiatives, policy changes, organisational transitions and systems implementations across the Americas.

• Support policy development and process harmonisation projects.

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, employee experience and operational effectiveness

• Produce HR reports and workforce information as required.

• Assist with policy implementation and employee communications.


Skills & Competencies


• Strong customer-focused approach.

• Excellent communication and relationship management skills.

• Highly organised with strong attention to detail.

• Practical and solutions-oriented mindset.

• Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

• Strong judgement and ability to escalate appropriately.

• High levels of integrity and confidentiality.

• Continuous improvement mindset.


Experience Requirements


We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every requirement listed below. If your experience is broadly aligned and you're excited about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply.


We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:


• Evidenced progressive HR Generalist or HR Operations experience.

• Strong knowledge of US employment practices and employee lifecycle processes.

• Experience supporting payroll and benefits administration.

• Experience managing relationships with external benefits providers, brokers or EOR providers.

• Experience using Workday or a similar enterprise HRIS.

• Experience within an international technology or software environment would be advantageous.

• International HR exposure is desirable but not essential.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for the opportunity to join us in electrifying the future!

Purpose of the Position\:

Under general supervision, this role designs, builds, and maintains scalable digital solutions that improve procurement transparency, supplier readiness, and operational decision‑making across North America.
The Data Analyst operates transforming business requirements into robust data pipelines, automations, analytics, and BI tools aligned with MBUSI and MP Germany standards.
This role enables dashboards that support decisions affecting ~$1B PM/MLV spend and influences supplier readiness across 200+ suppliers in USMCA. Failures in data quality or reporting accuracy may impact sourcing decisions, cost savings transparency, and compliance with RVC/USMCA regulations. operational efficiency, process automation, and risk mitigation by delivering accurate dashboards and automated reporting for contract effectiveness, supplier milestones, localization/RVC, cost initiatives, capacity KPIs, and performance indicators.

Essential Functions\:

'1. Data Engineering & Architecture — 20%
Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT) using SQL, Python, and Databricks; integrate internal systems (SAP, procurement, SQE, logistics) and external sources (supplier portals, APIs). Document data lineage, schema, and definitions to ensure transparency and reuse.
2. Software & Automation Development — 15%
Design and develop automated workflows and services using Python, Power Automate, and PowerApps to reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and ensure reliable refresh cycles with monitoring, logging, and alerting.
3. BI & Advanced Analytics — 15%
Develop datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and KPIs in Power BI covering supplier performance, contract effectiveness, AVOB, future sourcing, localization/RVC, capacity readiness, and cost initiatives. Apply analytical methods such as trend analysis, forecasting, and anomaly detection where applicable.
4. Data Governance & Quality — 10%
Execute data governance standards for accuracy, access control, security, retention, and auditability. Monitor data quality KPIs, resolve defects, and align with IT, Cybersecurity, and Compliance functions to ensure policy adherence.
5. Project & Agile Delivery — 20%
Serve as a technical project manager within Agile/Scrum frameworks. Refine backlog items, estimate effort, coordinate sprints, manage risks, align stakeholders, track progress, and deliver incremental digital solutions that provide measurable business value.
6. Cross‑Functional & Global Collaboration — 10%
Translate requirements from Procurement, SQE, Capacity, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and global digitalization hubs (Germany, India, Mexico). Ensure alignment with global architecture and contribute to governance-ready documentation, decision papers, and project committees.
7. Operations, Support, and Documentation — 5%
Ensure operational stability of all tools and data products, respond to incidents, and maintain up‑to‑date technical and functional documentation required for audits and knowledge transfer.
8. Safety, Compliance & Other Duties — 5%
Perform work in compliance with MBUSI safety rules and regulations. Complete required training and carry out additional responsibilities as assigned.
Metrics and KPIs\:
- Ensure leadership receives clear, accurate, and actionable insights by maintaining dashboards and reporting with ≥98% data accuracy and delivering all critical reports within defined KPI timelines
- Data accuracy ≥ 98% for critical datasets
- Refresh success ≥ 99% for automated pipelines
- On‑time delivery ≥ 90% of sprint commitments
- Uptime ≥ 99% for key dashboards
- Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) ≤ 24 hours for data incidents
- Documented manual hours eliminated through automation

Perform safe work practices and participate in trainings and safety programs in a positive and proactive way by following safety rules, procedures, regulations, standards and laws. Report all unsafe acts, unsafe conditions, and injuries to management, including your supervisor, or the Safety Department.
Work safely 100% of the time.
Perform other duties as required.

At the City of Leduc, our mission is Building a connected community for all people. We offer a collaborative and dynamic workplace where our values of Teamwork, Service, Respect and Leadership guide our conduct and contribute to a healthy culture. If you would like to work as part of a progressive organization and enjoy a fast-paced environment, then this may be the opportunity for you.

Come work with us!

We believe in people-first service, practical collaboration, and keeping our growing community safe. Our Safety Codes team plays a crucial role in shaping Leduc’s physical landscape—ensuring every home, business, and public infrastructure project meets the highest standards of safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

We are seeking a permanent, full-time Safety Codes Officer to join our Infrastructure and Planning department. If you are a dedicated technical expert who takes pride in protecting public safety, enjoys collaborative problem-solving with contractors and builders, and thrives in a supportive municipal environment, we invite you to bring your skills to our team.

What is the Opportunity?

Reporting to the Manager, Safety Codes Services, the Safety Codes Officer is responsible for monitoring compliance across the City’s permit issuance and field inspection processes. You will ensure that development and construction across Leduc strictly align with the Alberta Safety Codes Act, provincial codes, and municipal Quality Management Plans (QMP).

This role balances technical oversight, team mentorship, and field-based risk management. Serving as a key technical resource, you will provide clear code interpretations to internal staff, developers, contractors, and residents. You will also oversee day-to-day inspection workflows, monitor variances and orders, and work closely with discipline leads across Building, Electrical, Plumbing, and Gas to uphold uniform standards throughout the community.

What will you do?

In this multi-faceted, technical leadership role, you will keep our building safety standards high while supporting efficient development. You will:

  • Monitor permit issuance and site inspection processes, ensuring application reviews, plan evaluations, and field inspections are completed accurately, safely, and in a timely manner.
  • Provide expert code interpretation and consultation to the general public, design professionals, developers, contractors, and internal municipal teams.
  • Conduct internal audits and field compliance reviews in accordance with the Safety Codes Act and the City’s Quality Management Plan (QMP), addressing variances, orders, and unpermitted work.
  • Guide and support internal staff, providing technical coaching to Permit Clerks and fostering consistent, uniform code interpretation across field inspection teams.
  • Oversee operational administration, including reviewing daily schedules, monitoring coverage, and supporting ongoing training and safety certification for discipline officers.
  • Liaise with provincial and industry authorities, representing Leduc at meetings with the Safety Codes Council (SCC), Alberta Municipal Affairs (AMA), and professional official associations (e.g., ABOA, AMOS).
  • Support cross-departmental development reviews, offering technical input on City construction projects, development permits, and subdivision applications.

Who you are?

You are a communicative, detail-oriented technical professional who brings deep regulatory knowledge, sound judgment, and a practical approach to safety compliance. You bring:

  • Active certification as a Safety Codes Officer (SCO) with the Alberta Safety Codes Council in at least one (1) discipline (Building, Electrical, Plumbing, or Gas); multi-discipline certification is considered a strong asset.
  • A minimum of three (3) to six (6) years of progressive experience conducting field inspections, plan reviews, and code interpretations under the Alberta Safety Codes Act and regulations.
  • Practical understanding of provincial trade qualification requirements and the process for verifying certified tradespeople during permit application reviews.
  • Proven leadership and communication skills, with an ability to deliver clear, consistent code guidance to contractors, developers, and field crews.
  • Strong decision-making skills with the ability to evaluate products, issue orders or variances, and navigate complex safety compliance issues with tact and diplomacy.
  • A valid Class 5 Driver’s License along with the physical ability to safely navigate active construction sites in all seasonal weather conditions.

What we Offer?

Joining the City of Leduc means choosing a workplace that values your technical expertise, supports your well-being, and invests in your long-term career. In this permanent role, we offer:

  • Comprehensive Health and Dental Benefits from day one to support the well-being of you and your family.
  • Participation in the Local Authorities Pension Plan (LAPP), ensuring secure, long-term retirement benefits.
  • Strong commitment to professional development, covering ongoing Safety Codes Council designation maintenance, training, and certification upgrades.
  • Access to the Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) for personal and professional wellness support.
  • Free parking and a free annual pass to City of Leduc recreation facilities, including access to drop-in programs to support your health and active lifestyle.

Important Notes!

  • The successful candidate must provide a current Criminal Record Check and a clean Driver's Abstract at their own expense prior to commencement of employment.
  • As per the drug & alcohol standard, this position has been deemed safety sensitive by the employer and as such is subject to reasonable cause and post-incident drug and alcohol testing.

Ready to Join Us?

If you are ready to bring your safety codes expertise to a progressive, community-focused municipality, we want to hear from you. Apply today at .

title: Producer/Editor
description:
Amaze, Inspire, Unite

Job Summary:

The Producer/Editor is responsible for developing, producing, and post-producing video content supporting the Detroit Red Wings, Detroit Tigers, and broader enterprise initiatives. This role has a strong emphasis on video editing, storytelling, and editorial execution, taking projects from initial concept and production through final delivery.

The Producer/Editor will collaborate with internal departments and creative partners to develop compelling short- and long-form content across digital, social, in-venue, broadcast, marketing, internal communications, and other platforms. The role requires strong editorial judgment, a refined understanding of visual storytelling, and the ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high standard of creative quality.

Responsibilities may include producing and editing interviews, features, promotional content, social videos, event coverage, internal communications, live and prerecorded presentations, and other original video projects.

This position requires flexibility to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other non-traditional hours, as well as travel and occasional physical production work.

Key Responsibilities:

Editing & Post-Production

  • Edit short- and long-form video content from concept through final delivery, ensuring projects meet established creative, technical, and brand standards.
  • Shape footage into compelling narratives through editorial structure, pacing, music, sound design, graphics, color correction, and visual effects.
  • Review and organize footage, selects, project files, audio, graphics, and other media throughout the post-production process.
  • Collaborate with producers, creative partners, and internal stakeholders to incorporate feedback and deliver polished final products.
  • Prepare and deliver content in appropriate formats, resolutions, frame rates, codecs, and specifications for digital, social, in-venue, broadcast, and internal platforms.
  • Maintain organized project files and editorial workflows to support efficient collaboration, revisions, and future use.
  • Utilize Adobe Creative Cloud applications, with an emphasis on Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop.
  • Maintain and contribute to department-wide editing and post-production standards, workflows, and best practices.
  • Stay current with emerging editing techniques, post-production technologies, and industry trends and identify opportunities to improve the department's creative output.

Producing & Content Development

  • Develop original video concepts, story ideas, treatments, and editorial approaches for assigned projects and areas of support.

  • Produce interviews, features, event recaps, promotional content, social content, internal communications, and other multimedia projects.
  • Conduct interviews and work with talent, players, coaches, employees, and other participants to capture compelling stories.
  • Plan and coordinate video productions, including pre-production, crew needs, locations, schedules, equipment, and production logistics.
  • Scout, select, and secure appropriate locations for video productions.
  • Collaborate with internal departments and creative partners to develop concepts and execute projects from pre-production through final delivery.
  • Determine appropriate production approaches based on creative objectives, available resources, timelines, and distribution needs.
  • Coordinate and execute video content for live and prerecorded presentations, meetings, events, and other enterprise initiatives.

Production Operations

  • Source and coordinate props, music, production resources, and other materials necessary to complete projects.
  • Maintain organized production assets, including footage, media, project files, and the department's video archive.
  • Assist with the organization and maintenance of video production equipment and studio resources.
  • Recommend hardware, software, and workflow solutions that improve production and post-production efficiency.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining established deadlines, priorities, and quality standards.
  • Communicate project status, production needs, and potential challenges clearly and proactively.

Professional & Industry Development

  • Maintain a working knowledge of current video production, post-production, and content distribution technologies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve creative processes, production workflows, and overall department output quality.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing, constructive feedback, and adherence to established creative and production standards.
  • Maintain the highest level of professionalism, integrity, and discretion when working with confidential information, talent, and organizational initiatives.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, Film, Media Production, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • A minimum of four years of professional experience in video production, editing, sports, entertainment, broadcast, news, or a related environment is preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in professional video editing and post-production workflows, with strong experience in Adobe Premiere Pro.
  • Familiarity with additional Adobe Creative Cloud applications is preferred.

  • Strong understanding of editorial storytelling, pacing, structure, music, sound, color correction, graphics, and visual effects.
  • Understanding of video codecs, compression, encoding, resolutions, frame rates, aspect ratios, and delivery specifications across multiple platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience producing content from concept through final delivery.
  • Strong cinematography and visual storytelling skills, including experience operating professional cameras and production equipment.
  • Experience producing interviews, features, event coverage, and other narrative-driven content.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly present creative ideas and communicate production needs.
  • Highly organized with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to creative and technical quality.
  • Ability to receive, interpret, and incorporate creative feedback throughout the production and post-production process.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and represent the organization professionally.
  • Ability and willingness to work flexible and non-traditional schedules, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours.
  • Ability and willingness to travel in accordance with corporate travel policies.

Working Conditions

  • Irregular and extended hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and event-based schedules.
  • Frequent periods of standing, walking, and working on location or in production environments.
  • Frequent visual and auditory attention required for both production and post-production responsibilities.
  • Fast-paced work environment with regular exposure to loud arenas, stadiums, outdoor conditions, and varying venue environments.
  • Ability to operate, transport, lift, and carry production equipment for extended periods.
  • Ability to occasionally lift and carry equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular exposure to production environments that may include outdoor elements, mechanical equipment, elevated areas, and airborne particles.
  • Travel and work in a variety of indoor and outdoor production environments may be required.

ABOUT YOUR ROLE
Independently performs analysis of moderate to complex commercial loan requests and borrower information including but not limited to financial analysis, operating performance, industry trends and economic conditions to make initial assessment of credit worthiness. Provides detailed analysis and comprehensive written summaries that support the credit risk assessment and identifies any deviations from the Commercial Loan Policy as appropriate. Participates with senior credit staff in the assignment of credit risk rating.

WHAT YOU WILL DO LIST
Perform efficient and concise detailed analysis and quality underwriting loan proposals. Underwrite loans, renewals, extensions and modifications. Proactively and independently analyze and structure proposals and complete the underwriting and evaluation process. Identify loan structure alternatives and make recommendations on credit decisions. Ensure compliance with credit policy and underwriting requirements.
Conduct assessment of credit worthiness of borrower; review historical operating performance and research economic and market conditions as they relate to the borrower’s company and industry. Research industry specific information from outside sources, which may include industry publications, area libraries, references from other banks, credit agencies, and internet searches and information sites.
Perform analysis of secondary sources of repayment such as collateral; assess the quality and source of collateral being pledged and apply an appropriate discount factor to determine an estimation of collateral marketability in a liquidation scenario.
Perform analysis of a guarantor’s financial position and construct personal net cash flow through investigation of personal financial statements, personal tax returns and credit reporting documentation. Develop an understanding of any contingent liabilities and prepares summary.
Assist in the preparation of the initial assessment that summarizes key strengths and risks and includes identification of any deviations from the Bank’s Commercial Loan policy.
Become familiar with alternative structures in order to reduce credit risk.
Assign a credit risk rating.
Prepare in-depth loan package with detailed analysis and recommendations for presentation to reviewers and/or Management Credit Committee. Attend Management Credit Committee to provide input on overall assessment and answer questions regarding their credit analysis as necessary.
Partner with lending team to conduct thorough annual reviews of current portfolio clients including review of financials, site visits, assessment of general business information and other factors that would be indicators of risk.
Discuss and review covenants and overall assessments with reviewers and establish turnaround/delivery requirements. Participate in customer meetings to provide expert analytical counsel and credit perspective.
Ensure that all work is in compliance with applicable laws, regulations and company guidelines as detailed in company policies. Seek guidance from senior credit staff as necessary and appropriate to resolve potential issues.
Develop knowledge of Company and department systems, practices, and policies. Actively participate in training programs and opportunities to expand knowledge and analytical abilities.
Participate in special projects and performs additional duties as required.
Understands compliance with all regulations governing the banking industry, as well as agency guidelines and organization policies.
Understands the compliance requirements to ensure files are maintained in accordance with regulations.

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU
Working knowledge of commercial lending process including demonstrated credit evaluation and underwriting ability, with ability to make independent credit assessments.
Knowledge of credit approval policy and process with the ability to accurately interpret lending policy and apply same to the management of the portfolio.
Knowledge of qualitative portfolio analytics and metrics with the ability to utilize automated and analytical tools and techniques.
Ability to identify and quantify business risks and the key drivers of risk and focus decisions accordingly.
Ability to understanding client industry and its general fit to portfolio parameters.
Working knowledge of banking regulations and laws governing commercial lending.
Strong written and oral communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate financial analysis detail in a clear, concise manner.
Strong organizational skills with ability to set priorities in a multi-task environment and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office with specific capability in Word and Excel.
Ability to maintain the confidentiality of credit and customer information.

Are you interested in how major businesses win contracts, manage risk and deliver large-scale projects? Join Howden's Surety team and discover how surety helps businesses secure the guarantees they need to win contracts, deliver projects and fulfil important commitments. We work with clients, insurers and financial institutions to arrange solutions that support projects, investments and commercial agreements around the world.


As part of Howden's Capital, Advisory and Placement team, you'll gain exposure to finance, legal agreements, risk assessment and relationship management, all while working on real client projects from the start of your career.


You'll join Howden in a permanent role and complete our structured 18-month development programme, designed to build your technical expertise, commercial awareness, professional confidence and long-term career foundations.


What you’ll be doing?


You'll begin with a structured induction before joining the Surety team, where you'll work alongside experienced specialists supporting complex client transactions.


  • Learn about our surety products and the end-to-end process for placing surety bonds.
  • Work directly with clients and underwriters to structure and place surety bonds.
  • Review legal contracts and financial records to identify any risks that may make the surety bond too risky for an insurer.
  • Support with reviewing client documentation and preparing materials for upcoming meetings.
  • Assist with taking meeting notes to ensure that client files are accurate and up to date.
  • Gain early exposure to client and insurer meetings, learning how our clients are advised and how deals are negotiated.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external contacts.

Who are we looking for?


No insurance experience is needed; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!


You'll be:

  • A recent Law or Finance graduate, or in your final year of study and have a strong interest in commercial, legal, and financial matters.
  • Analytical and have meticulous attention to detail.
  • Confident to learn how to influence and negotiate in professional settings.
  • A strong communicator who enjoys building relationships and working with clients, colleagues and external partners.
  • Able to articulate your ideas well both in writing and verbally.
  • Comfortable speaking on the phone with senior individuals.
  • Resilient and hard-working and curious to learn and develop.

To be eligible for our programme, you must have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.


Application process


Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!


  • Online application form – no CV required: We believe you're more than just a document, so we won't ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form.
  • Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
  • Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
  • Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day, because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!

Why should you apply?


  • £40,000 salary and a generous pension scheme.
  • A permanent role from the day you join Howden.
  • Structured learning and development through our 18-month graduate development programme.
  • 25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays and an additional day off at Christmas.
  • Access to discounted personal health policies, wellbeing support and a range of employee benefits and insurance products.
  • 2 days allocated to take part in volunteering schemes.

Explore our Connectr page to discover more about Howden, our culture, and the insurance industry. You'll find resources to help you prepare for our recruitment process and understand which career path could be the best fit for you.

Please read before submitting: You may only apply to one graduate programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in additional applications not being considered.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

title: Manufacturing Software Python Test Developer
description:
Manufacturing Software Python Test Developer

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Manufacturing Software Test Development Engineer to design, develop, and support manufacturing test automation solutions for networking products and platforms.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, hands-on software engineer and self-starter with strong experience in test automation, object-oriented Python and Perl, Linux environments, and manufacturing test processes.

In this role, you will develop scalable and reliable test frameworks and automation scripts, define test requirements and coverage, support production test infrastructure, troubleshoot complex manufacturing issues, perform code reviews, and develop tools for data collection and analysis. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to enable new products and continuously improve manufacturing test capabilities.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, deliver, and maintain manufacturing test automation frameworks, tools, and scripts supporting production and test infrastructure.
  • Develop robust automation solutions using object-oriented Python and Perl.
  • Architect test automation solutions with a focus on simplicity, reliability, maintainability, scalability, extensibility, and reuse.
  • Define test requirements, develop comprehensive test coverage, and identify opportunities to improve test effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Develop, deploy, and maintain production test scripts and related software tools.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex software, test, system, and manufacturing production issues.
  • Conduct code reviews and promote software development and test automation best practices.
  • Develop and support tools for test data collection, analysis, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Provide automation and manufacturing test support for New Product Introduction (NPI) programs.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, hardware, software, product engineering, and other cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready test solutions.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation for test frameworks, automation solutions, tools, and production processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance test quality, reliability, efficiency, and manufacturing scalability.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 4 to 6+ years of professional experience developing manufacturing test automation, large-scale test frameworks, or related software/test infrastructure.
  • Strong hands-on programming and object-oriented development experience with Python and/or Perl.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing test methodologies, production test processes, and test automation.
  • Strong experience working in Linux-based environments.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Experience designing and maintaining reliable, reusable, and scalable automation frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-motivated and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility for deliverables and schedules.
  • A continuous learner who actively shares technical knowledge and best practices with the broader team.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

  • C/C++ or Java development
  • SQL and relational databases
  • Networking technologies, protocols, and networking hardware
  • Automated testing of networking products or embedded systems
  • Manufacturing test equipment and production test infrastructure
  • Data collection, analytics, dashboards, and manufacturing monitoring/alerting solutions
  • Source control, CI/CD, and modern software development practices
  • Experience supporting NPI and high-volume manufacturing environments

Accessibility

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.


Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

Job Description:

The Auto Body Technician’s primary responsibility and accountability includes providing an exceptional and successful customer experience through the meticulous assessment and quality repair of each customer’s vehicle to restore it back to pre-accident condition. The Auto Body Technician thoroughly disassembles, repairs, and reassembles each vehicle while playing a pivotal role to our company’s promise of speed, quality and customer excellence. The Auto Body Technician works in alignment with all team members in achieving the repair facilities KPIs and is committed to being a dedicated Brand Ambassador of The Boyd Group at all times.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Ensure consistent execution of WOW (Wow Operating Way) plan.

  • Plans the repair work that is necessary and prepares cost estimates for customers. Uses various tools such as cutting guns, plasma cutters, hydraulic jacks, hammers, and pliers to repair sections of a vehicle.

  • Hammers out dents, dimples, and other minor body damage if possible; mixes and applies filler resins to repair dents when other methods are not feasible.

  • Realigns car chassis and frames to repair structural damage.

  • Removes damaged sections of vehicles and replaces them with new or aftermarket parts. Replaces or repairs glass and windshields as needed.

  • Replaces or repairs interior parts as needed.

  • Welds and otherwise attaches or fits parts into place and Prepares and repaints vehicles with factory-specified paint or agreed-upon equivalent.

  • Attempts to complete work orders within labor time guidelines. Ensures all work has been executed correctly by inspecting vehicles after repair.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education and/or Experience Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Successful completion of technical school program OR a 3-year apprenticeship as an auto body repairer.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to read job orders and work with very little supervision.

  • Ability to work with other repairers within an auto body shop.

  • Thorough understanding of methods and procedures to repair vehicle bodies.

  • Thorough understanding of how to use tools required for the trade.

Other Requirements

  • Must be able to work safely in a noisy area with many odors present.

  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds at times.

  • Must be able to visually inspect vehicle damage in a variety of weather conditions.

  • Must be able to bend, stretch, kneel, and squat to perform repairs and inspections.

title: Program Supervisor I
description:
The Program Supervisor position offers a rewarding opportunity to utilize your clinical skills and collaborate with a dedicated team. You will conduct assessments, design and implement ABA programs, and provide direct services to children with ASD and other diagnoses. Supervising caregivers, working closely with families, and participating in multidisciplinary teams are key components of this role. Program Supervisors are scheduled a balance of telehealth, in-clinic and in-home client sessions within one of the following regions: Fairfield, CA; Petaluma, CA; Walnut Creek, CA; Dublin, CA; Oakland, CA; San Jose, CA; and Burlingame, CA.

Core Responsibilities & Essential Job Functions

  • Conduct comprehensive behavioral assessments such as VB-MAPP, SSIS, FAST, Skills Streaming and EFL to identify client strengths, needs, and target behaviors.
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans (BIPs) based on assessment results and best practices in ABA.
  • Provide direct ABA services to clients, implementing interventions and teaching new skills.
  • Supervise and/or mentor caregivers and other direct care staff, ensuring treatment fidelity and providing ongoing support and training.
  • Collaborate effectively with families, caregivers, and other professionals involved in the client's care.
  • Monitor client progress through data collection and analysis, making data-based decisions to adjust treatment plans as needed.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, including progress notes, session notes, and assessment reports.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, providing clinical expertise and contributing to collaborative decision-making.
  • Stay current with the latest research and developments in ABA, attend conferences and engage in professional development activities.

Qualifications

Minimum Education, Experience & Training Equivalent to:

  • Bachelor’s degree in an applicable field and 2 years of ABA experience required.
  • Candidates with at least 12 semester units in ABA will be considered if they are close to meeting the experience requirement.
  • Significant knowledge of ABA as a discipline, familiar with the field of ABA, and knowledgeable of other community resources and agencies that serve children.
  • Experience implementing and/or designing ABA programs for individuals with ASD and other diagnoses.

Knowledge & Skills:

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and related computer software.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, as well as strong interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, lift up to 40 lbs, and be comfortable spending time on your feet.
  • Knowledge and understanding of HIPAA practices and adherence to policies.
  • American Sign Language or bilingual preferred.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to manage the physical and emotional demands of the role, including frequent exposure to disability disorders, occasional emergency situations and trauma, and constant client contact requiring concentration and sound decision-making.
  • Occasional driving (to and from office and client homes) is required.
  • Must be able to travel to multiple work sites and client homes; reliable transportation is needed.

Conditions of Employment

  • Must have a valid California Driver’s License with insurance and maintain a clean driving record.
  • Must pass health screenings, obtain required vaccinations, and clear TB testing based on company policies.
  • Must obtain and maintain criminal record clearance through the Department of Justice (DOJ). The People & Performance Department will analyze DOJ/FBI live scan reports in accordance with applicable Federal, State, and Local laws, as well as fitness for the position.
  • Must obtain and maintain clearance through the Office of Inspector General.
  • Must obtain and maintain CPR, Safety Care, and National Provider Identifier (NPI) certifications.
  • By accepting employment, you consent to the use of your home address or ZIP code for scheduling purposes. Our scheduling systems use this information to ensure you are scheduled with clients located within a reasonable travel distance.

description:

Title and Summary

Senior Software Engineer

The Quality Engineering team within Mastercard is about creating an ecosystem to build a world beyond waiting for all delivery teams to help achieve time-to-market, quality excellence, and higher customer satisfaction.

• This position will be responsible for driving adoption of Quality Engineering services (Code quality, Testing Services, Performance Engineering, Testing and Environment automation, Development Collaboration, and Continuous Integration).

• Position requires a good understanding of BDD/TDD practices, code review and analysis techniques, Test Pyramid, and open source agile testing frameworks for both web service and GUI applications.

• Interacts with technology staff including Quality Engineers, Operations, Developers, DevOps Engineers, Product management, and Program management to identify scope of projects and deliver services.

Role
• Drive quality engineering, exploratory testing, and test automation covering all key practice areas including mobile, web, and API testing.

• Drive adoption of development services (Quality Engineering, Performance Engineering, Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery, and Collaboration) amongst various delivery teams.

• Understand end-customer needs and associated value chain to drive processes and practices to ensure flawless customer experience.

• Partner with peers, stakeholders, and management to prepare for rapidly changing product roadmaps on emerging technologies to ensure highest quality standards.

• Create and utilize automated test scenarios in-sprint coupled with manual integration/end-to-end testing.

All About You
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience with exposure to software development and testing concepts.

• Web page GUI and user experience testing experience is required, including Selenium automation experience.
• Web service testing experience (REST/SOAP) is desired.

• Exposure to preparing and delivering executive-level presentations to business and technology audiences.

• Solid knowledge of Java, Spring, JUnit, Eclipse IDE, Rest Assured, Appium, Jbehave/Cucumber frameworks, Databases, APIs (REST/SOAP), SQL, UNIX/Linux, Continuous Delivery concepts and tools such as Jenkins/Bamboo, vulnerability tools such as Sonar, Checkmarx/Fortify, etc.

• Knowledge of payments domain message flows, architecture, common design patterns, ISO message protocols, EMV standards, mobile payments, simulation/emulation tools highly desirable.

• Experience in agile and waterfall delivery, life-cycle management tools (Rally/Jira), software testing standards, methods and conventions.

• Exposure to Cloud concepts (i.e. Infrastructure-as-code, Platform-as-a-Service, etc.) desirable.

• Experience with cross browser testing best practices and concepts.

• Ability to track and manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining aggressive test schedules.

• Experience creating and implementing complex test strategies/acceptance criteria/test cases to cover all testing phases, with heavy emphasis on integration and end-to-end testing.

title: starszy(-a) specjalista(-ka) relacji z klientem - 68 Oddział w Warszawie (Praga Płn.)
description:
To masz na bank:

  • umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),
  • pracę stacjonarną w 68 Oddziale w Warszawie, ul. Targowa 49/51,
  • lider: Emil Strupiechowski - śmiało sprawdź z kim możesz pracować,
  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premia w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej.

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom najlepsze doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Dbamy o portfele klientów w ponad 300 oddziałach w całej Polsce. Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,
  • posiadasz przynajmniej dwuletnie doświadczenie w bankowości,
  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,
  • lubisz stawiać sobie ambitne cele i dobrze czujesz się wiedząc do czego dążysz,
  • czujesz się komfortowo zarówno w pracy indywidualnej jak i zespołowej,
  • chcesz się rozwijać w bankowości i zdobywać nową wiedzę.

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych.,
  • doświadczenie w sprzedaży produktów inwestycyjnych (w tym funduszy),
  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • wspieranie klientów z bardziej wymagającymi potrzebami w wyborze najlepszych produktów i usług bankowych,
  • zapewnienie profesjonalnej obsługi oraz najlepszych doświadczeń związanych z wizytą w oddziale,
  • aktywna współpraca pomiędzy jednostkami banku (leadowanie i spojrzenie na klienta cross-segmentowo),
  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych,
  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych zadań sprzedażowych, za które przyznajemy miesięczne premie na atrakcyjnym poziomie,
  • telefoniczny i bezpośredni kontakt z klientami,
  • budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami banku oraz pozyskiwanie nowych,
  • codzienną obsługę transakcji gotówkowych (w oddziałach gotówkowych) i bezgotówkowych w oddziale,
  • praca w zgodzie z obowiązującymi procedurami oraz standardami dotyczącymi i realizowanymi we wszystkich kanałach dystrybucji.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),
  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),
  • ubezpieczenie na życie,
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,
  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,
  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,
  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,
  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.
  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.
  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i otrzymywać pierwsze premie.
  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.
  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

  • wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,
  • spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,
  • pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: IPOST Clinical Community Analyst
description:
IPOST Clinical Community Analyst - Remote

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.


As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.


ICON is seeking an iPOST Clinical Community Analyst to join our global Investigator Portal Operations Team.


This role is focused on supporting investigator and site engagement across clinical trials through the management of study-specific investigator portals. Working closely with study teams, site personnel, vendors, and internal stakeholders, you will help deliver effective communication, engagement strategies, and portal operations that enhance the study site experience throughout the trial lifecycle.


We are interested in speaking with individuals who have experience working within clinical research and have hands-on experience using investigator portals or similar site engagement platforms. Experience may have been gained from a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, sponsor, site, or vendor environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage investigator portals from study start-up through study close-out and archiving.
  • Partner with study teams to develop and implement site engagement and communication strategies.
  • Create, maintain, and publish portal content including news posts, communications, surveys, forms, dashboards, and study resources.
  • Coordinate portal launches and ongoing portal activities with study teams and external vendors.
  • Support portal user management and provide business support to stakeholders.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings with study teams related to portal planning, implementation, and ongoing study conduct.
  • Monitor portal activity and engagement, identifying opportunities to improve the site experience.
  • Investigate, track, and resolve portal-related issues, escalating when appropriate.
  • Contribute to process improvements, training activities, operational documentation, and best practice development.
  • Support broader site engagement initiatives and technology-related projects as required.

What We're Looking For

  • Degree in Life Sciences, Health Sciences, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Experience working within clinical trials or clinical research.
  • Experience using investigator portals or similar clinical technology platforms that support study sites and investigators.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and study conduct.
  • Excellent organisational and project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience creating communications, newsletters, site-facing content, or engagement materials.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including the ability to analyse and present information effectively.
  • Ability to work successfully within global, cross-functional teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting global or multi-regional clinical trials.
  • Experience working directly with study teams, investigators, sites, or clinical technology vendors.
  • Experience delivering training, onboarding, or user support.
  • Knowledge of site engagement strategies and change management principles.
  • Additional language skills would be advantageous.



Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.


Rewards & Benefits

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.


Benefits may include:

  • Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
  • Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
  • Retirement and pension plans
  • Life assurance and disability coverage
  • Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
  • Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.


Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

title: PBM
description:
PBM

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

Job Family Definition:

Serves as a trusted adviser to the Partner and develops a mutually beneficial relationship in alignment with HPE business priorities. Drives end-to-end revenue, HPE profitability, and pipeline through joint business plans and data-driven sales efforts. Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively “sell with”, “sell to”, and “sell through” the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem. Develops knowledge of Partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology to differentiate HPE from competitors. Coordinates and executes HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed. Aligns field sales to drive increased value to HPE for pipeline and revenue/profit growth while leveraging the collective strength of the partner ecosystem. Leads HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE. These jobs focus on selling to customers through the Partner as an extension of HPE's salesforce, typically through work that occurs outside HPE offices.

Management Level Definition:

Applies intermediate level of subject matter knowledge to solve a variety of common business issues. Works on problems of moderately complex scope. Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and limited project direction input. Exercises independent judgment within defined practices and procedures to determine appropriate action. Follows established guidelines and interprets policies. Evaluates unique circumstances and makes recommendations.

Responsibilities:

  • Provides resources and guidance to the Partner (e.g. Value Added Reseller (VAR), Distributor, SI, ISV, Managed Service Provider) on where to play within emerging trends in Partner's ecosystem in alignment with HPE business priorities. Works with the Partner to create a mutually beneficial plan for the future.
  • Drives end-to end HPE revenue, profitability, and pipeline by implementing joint business plans and data-driven sales efforts with the Partner.
  • Articulates both HPE global and local business strategies to effectively "sell with," "sell to," and "sell through" the Partner, creating a scalable selling ecosystem.
  • Develops knowledge of partner priorities, industry trends, IT landscape, IT investment strategy, HPE priorities, and HPE Technology and communicates value of the portfolios and solutions to better differentiate HPE from competitors.
  • Demonstrates business and sales leadership by building mutually beneficial relationships with one or many Partners to grow HPE market share.
  • Coordinates HPE activities with the Partner, leveraging HPE specialists when needed, including sales cadence, education, marketing, executive briefings, proactive forecasting, business planning, and client engagements. Drives HPE marketing strategy through the customer.
  • Enacts day-to-day HPE strategy, programs, and systems with and on behalf of the Partner to assure accelerated financial outcomes and build partner loyalty to HPE.
  • Tailors selling solutions to fit the needs of the partner's customer profile including HPE products, services and technology alliances to achieve assigned quota.
  • May recruit and develop business relationships with new partners, working to increase partner commitment to HPE.
  • May spend time monitoring Partner sales floor to help develop pipeline.
  • Works to ensure that partners are aware of, and compliant with, HPE's SBC requirements for Partners, including applicable legal obligations.

Education and Experience:

  • University or Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent experience.

The Role:

This role has two salary ranges, depending on the level at which the candidate is hired:


  • Project Superintendent: $114,000 - $191,000
  • Senior Project Superintendent: $132,600 - $221,000

The final level will be determined based on each candidate's professional experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role.


At Vivmark Residential, we develop, build, and operate apartment communities across the United States. We are seeking a Project Superintendent or Senior Project Superintendent to lead field operations on multifamily residential and mixed-use construction projects.


This role is responsible for the day-to-day execution of construction activities in the field, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on schedule, and in accordance with quality expectations. The ideal candidate is a hands-on construction leader who can coordinate trade partners, drive accountability, solve problems proactively, and foster a culture of safety and excellence on every project.


What You'll Do

  • Lead all on-site construction activities from groundbreaking through project completion
  • Coordinate trade partners, suppliers, consultants, inspectors, and project team members to ensure efficient project execution
  • Maintain project schedules by sequencing work, identifying risks, and proactively addressing field challenges
  • Ensure workmanship meets company quality standards, contract requirements, and design intent
  • Conduct regular site inspections and manage punch list, turnover, and closeout activities
  • Promote and enforce all safety requirements, ensuring a safe and compliant jobsite environment
  • Collaborate closely with Project Managers to align field execution with project budgets, schedules, and operational goals
  • Review plans, specifications, and constructability concerns to identify potential issues before they impact project delivery
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, daily reports, progress updates, and field logs
  • Develop strong working relationships with contractors, consultants, local authorities, and internal stakeholders

What We're Looking For

  • Experience supervising multifamily, mixed-use, commercial, hospitality, or large-scale residential construction projects
  • Strong knowledge of construction means and methods, sequencing, quality control, and safety practices
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, schedules, and contracts
  • Experience managing trade contractors and coordinating multiple work activities simultaneously
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to maintain project momentum while balancing quality, safety, and schedule objectives
  • Proficiency with construction technology platforms and Microsoft Office applications
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment and make sound decisions in the field

Preferred Qualifications for Senior Project Superintendent

  • Extensive experience leading large-scale multifamily developments, podium construction, high-rise projects, or complex mixed-use developments
  • Experience overseeing multiple phases or highly complex projects with significant operational and logistical requirements
  • Demonstrated success mentoring Superintendents, Assistant Superintendents, Project Engineers, and field personnel
  • Advanced expertise in project sequencing, scheduling, quality management, safety leadership, and field operations strategy
  • Proven ability to partner with Project Managers and senior leadership to drive successful project outcomes and operational excellence
  • Recognized as a field leader with the ability to influence project teams, contractors, and stakeholders while maintaining accountability and execution standards

Under the direction of the Project Manager of Construction, the Superintendent is directly responsible for coordinating and supervising all on-site activities for the construction of residential complexes in accordance with project documents, safety and scheduling commitments.

Essential Functions Statement(s):

  • Organize sequencing of field operations, staging of materials and satellite office.

  • Prepare project updates, documentation and related administrative duties.

  • Solve problems, prioritize and multi-task while maintaining excellent communication and organizational skills at all times.

  • Implement quality assurance and control procedures. Ensure the work performed complies with all requirements of the contract documents and specifications.

  • Work with municipalities and utility providers for service installation and inspection.
