title: Food Scientist, Cannabis Beverages and Edibles
description:
About Tilray Brands, Inc.

Tilray Brands, Inc. (“Tilray”) (Nasdaq: TLRY; TSX: TLRY), is leading global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company with operations in Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia, and Latin America that is leading as a transformative force at the nexus of cannabis, beverage, wellness, and entertainment, elevating lives through moments of connection. Tilray’s mission is to be a leading premium lifestyle company with a house of brands and innovative products that inspire joy, wellness and create memorable experiences. Tilray’s unprecedented platform supports over 40 brands in over 20 countries, including comprehensive cannabis offerings, hemp-based foods, and craft beverages.


Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Pay Range: The expected annual base salary range for this role is CAD $60,000 - $80,000 DOE


Job Summary:


Reporting to the Senior Director of Manufacturing, the Food Scientist is responsible for the research and development of new cannabis consumer products for adult use, with a focus on beverage and chocolate products.

As a Food Scientist, you will act as a technical lead on projects and drive the commercialization of edible cannabis products from formulation development to scale up and commercial manufacturing.


This role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders such as marketing, operations, supply chain, quality, and any applicable third-party agencies. The Food Scientist supports all activities required to develop, optimize and scale-up a stable and robust formulation to make it suitable for commercial production, adhering to correct procedures and health and safety guidelines.


Role and Responsibilities:


Product Development and Optimization:

  • Leverage technical expertise to design, lead and apply applications based research to cannabis ingredients and food products.
  • Lead the development of beverage, food, and other consumer product formulations, from prototype to launch-ready optimized product.
  • Independently develop product formulations, manage sensory and stability studies, and establish relationships with ingredient suppliers to discover best-in-class ingredients.
  • Lead product cost optimization initiatives.

Manufacturing Process Development:

  • Lead manufacturing process improvements for existing products and support the development and optimization of new manufacturing processes.
  • Support technology transfers for new products from R&D to commercial manufacturing by training manufacturing personnel and conducting manufacturing process validations.

QA/QC Support:

  • Create manufacturing process SOPs, manufacturing batch records, product specifications, validation protocols, and stability protocols.
  • Initiate change controls for documentation updates and collaborate with QA in investigations.
  • Be responsible for ensuring shelf stability and safety of new formulations.

New Product Innovation:

  • Independently and collaboratively develop new product concepts within the cannabis confections domain.
  • Conduct market research to understand the competitive landscape including consumer trends and preferences.

Qualifications:

  • Advanced understanding of beverage and edible formulation science
  • 5+ years of experience in a confectionery, chemistry and/or food scientist role
  • Post secondary education in confectionery, chemistry and/or food science. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of education requirements.
  • Experience developing formulations including but not limited to beverages and chocolates
  • Experience leading commercialization projects from concept through launch
  • Practical knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices and Canadian food regulations
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead product development tasks including product development and optimization, manufacturing process development, product/process troubleshooting, and project management
  • Demonstrated strong technical writing ability
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines
  • Enjoys continuous learning, strives to become the subject matter expert for a variety of products/processes, and proactively develops solutions to problems
  • Familiarity with cannabis science and the Cannabis Regulations desirable but not required
  • Familiarity with writing product documents for Health Canada an asset

Total Rewards:


At Tilray Brands, we recognize the importance of comprehensive total rewards.


We provide:

  • Vacation Time & Paid Personal Time Off
  • Extended Health, Dental & Vision Benefits
  • Health Care Spending Account
  • Cannabis Benefits & Employee Discounts
  • Performance Based Incentives
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program
  • Growth and Internal Mobility Opportunities

Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process. If you require accommodations for interviews or other meetings, please advise when submitting your application.

description:

Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company?

At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you!

Job Description:

What will you work on?

Manage quality, reliability, and safety compliance activities during the New Product Introduction (NPI) process to ensure that Spin Master products meet and/or exceed worldwide safety, chemical, and performance requirements, deliver optimal product reliability, and fulfill customer expectations for the product. This position will also monitor product performance in the field and pose improvements as required and use this information to anticipate and prevent issues on future products.


This role is 4 days per week in our Playa Vista office.


How will you create impact?

  • Perform as QA core team member on project teams; as part of the new product introduction (NPI) team, attend team meetings and lead all quality, safety and reliability activities and requirements to ensure product consistently meets all regulatory and customer requirements
  • Coordinate internal and external testing as required and planned for the development stage.
  • At concept stages of development, conduct FMEA (Failure mode and effects analysis) and other reviews to drive appropriate qualification requirements for downstream stages of testing.
  • Act as liaison during customer trials to facilitate the process.
  • Key interface with global team members on program for continuity and coordination of task completion.
  • Analyze customer return and complaints, and issue and monitor corrective action requests to address root cause.
  • Ensure that packaging labelling specifications for new toys are met and interact with the packaging department as required.
  • Ensure all requirements are met prior to releasing production or customer shipments.
  • Travel as needed to suppliers and/or customers (less than 10%)
  • Liaise with worldwide regulatory bodies (CPSC, Health Canada, etc.) in maintaining compliance in accordance with industry requirements; coordinate required activities promptly and effectively.
  • Work closely with other functional groups such as Design, Marketing, Customer Care, Sales, Planning and other divisions in Asia and Europe.
  • Other tasks as assigned related to the domain knowledge of QA and the toy and consumer goods industries.
  • Stay abreast of changing global, region-specific regulations, standards, and retailer requirements to anticipate potential impacts to processes or products
  • Maintain monthly performance metrics for key operational indicators, where needed
  • Maintain technical files for projects, in accordance with EU requirements
  • Perform training to other departments as required

What are your skills and experience?

  • Relevant experience in Quality Engineering, Product Safety, or Compliance Management for product safety and reliability
  • Toy industry specific experience is preferred
  • Compliance experience with agency standards for safety or other similar requirements
  • Six sigma, lean manufacturing, kaizen highly desirable
  • Desirable experience in areas of mechanical, electro-mechanical, PLC controllers, chemical or manufacturing engineering disciplines
  • Experience with, and knowledge of, one or more of the following specialties desirable: consumer electronics, chemistry, food safety, plastics, clothing/fabrics

#LI-Hybrid #LI-HM1

title: Data Engineer / Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Company
Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in 2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

title: Operator - 1st Shift
description:
Westlake offers you the potential to enrich your work life and career experience in an entrepreneurial environment. We work together to enhance peoples' lives through our products and presence in the communities in which we operate.​

JOB SUMMARY

The primary responsibility of this position will be to ensure only quality-approved product is packaged for the customer. This includes extrusion or injection molding, weathering, trimming, inspection, and packing. The goal will be to help keep the extrusion lines running or the molding machines running continuously and efficiently while producing a product that meets or exceeds our customers’ expectations.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Comply with Safety Policies and Procedures
  • Reads Production Schedule boards and performs work as assigned by shift supervisor
  • Inspects, feeds, and/or packs product for Work In Process (WIP) or finished product
  • Maintains standard production cycles on nonrobotic molding machines
  • Detect quality defects in molded parts, trim the molded part and assemble the molded part
  • Ensure that product has appropriate Lot Information printed on each product
  • Build/assemble boxes
  • Attach appropriate labels to boxes
  • Notify supervisor of any safety, quality, mechanical, or material issues
  • Completes production documentation
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Shift Supervisor
  • Notify Management/Supervisor of any quality or equipment issues
  • Regular attendance, timeliness, and scheduling flexibility

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Work eight to twelve-hour shift
  • Perform tasks as defined in Standard Work Instructions
  • Must perform basic math functions
  • Distinguish colors visually
  • Basic literacy skills required to clearly and legibly complete required paperwork
  • Teamwork Orientation

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

The employee should have the following:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent and training or certification in relevant skill or trade preferred
  • 1 - 2 years' experience in a relevant field

ESSENTIAL PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be able to work standing for up to 8-12 hours/shift.
  • Must be able to kneel, squat, bend/twist at the waist, and stack parts at or above head height
  • Must have full range of motion (ROM) of shoulders, knees, hips, elbows, wrists, and hands to inspect, pack, and stack finished parts
  • Must be able to complete repetitive tasks to keep up with IMM cycle times as fast as every 30 seconds
  • Must be able to wear compliant ear protection if and when, working in areas exposed to noise levels above OSHA threshold limits
  • Must be able to work in hot environments (Especially summer months) that can exceed 100F
  • Wear all required personal protective equipment (Safety toe shoes, ANSI Z87 eye protection, CR gloves)
  • Lift/move/transport items up to 50 pounds
  • Ability to move or traverse about the facilities
  • Must be able to ascend/descend stairs or ladders
  • Ability to work around dust, chemicals, and other substances, and in various environmental conditions

Westlake is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristics protected by applicable legislation.

If you are an active Westlake employee (or an employee of any Westlake affiliates), please do not apply here. You will apply via the Jobs Hub application in Workday.

title: QA Lead
description:
Do you want to take the first step in making Filipinos’ lives better everyday? Here in GCash we want to stay at the forefront of the FinTech industry by creating innovative, meaningful, and convenient financial solutions for the nation! G ka ba? Join the G Nation today!

You will be responsible for the following:

I. Creates detailed test cases, test plans, and QA checklists based on business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to ensure outputs meet defined expectations.

II. Performs data quality validation and QA testing on analytical outputs such as ad hoc extracts, reports, dashboards, tables, and views to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and fitness for use.

III. Executes SQL-based validation and testing across relevant data layers and environments to confirm that outputs align with business and technical requirements.

IV. Coordinates with Data Analysts, DAISMs (Data and AI Success Manager) and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, define test coverage, and align on acceptance criteria, scope, and timelines.

V. Conducts QA testing within agreed SLA timelines and ensures timely completion of assigned requests without compromising quality.

VI. Logs, tracks, and supports resolution of defects by documenting findings, coordinating triage, validating fixes, and performing retesting prior to sign-off

VII. Provides QA sign-off and validation support for UAT by ensuring outputs have passed required quality checks before endorsement for requestor acceptance or production deployment.

VIII. Maintains QA documentation and testing artifacts such as test scripts, evidence files, validation queries, checklists, and traceability records for audibility and future reuse.

IX. Participates in team ceremonies and status discussions such as daily stand-ups and sprint activities to report QA progress, risks, blockers, and testing updates.

B. Displays (The Knowledge, Skills, and Behaviors indicating how tasks / responsibilities will be performed)

I. Detail orientation in identifying test cases/scenarios and spotting data issues such as duplicates, missing values, inconsistencies, and logic gaps.

II. Strong grounding in QA concepts and methodologies including test design, defect management, validation, and sign-off practices.

III. Analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate data issues, trace root causes, and recommend resolutions.

IV. Knowledge of analytics and data warehousing concepts to effectively validate outputs and understand data flow dependencies.

V. Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with Data Analysts, DAISM (Data and AI Success Manager), business teams, and other stakeholders.

VI. Agile mindset with a “fast fail, learn fast” attitude in a fast-paced and iterative work environment.

C. Delivers (The specific outputs / tangible results produced by the role; resources responsible for)

I. Test cases, test plans, and QA checklists that validate whether data outputs meet defined business requirements and acceptance criteria.

II. QA evidence and data quality validation results, including queries, screenshots, and supporting documentation that demonstrate completeness, accuracy, and readiness for UAT or sign-off.

III. Defect logs and QA reports summarizing issues found, root causes, severity, status, and retest results, with proper tracking through Jira and BA QA metrics/KPIs.

IV. Improved quality of analytical outputs through early issue detection, reduced rework, and stronger compliance with SLA and QA standards.

KPIs

D. SLA compliance

E. Peer review coverage and effectiveness

F. Stakeholder feedback on QA support

G. Business support efficiency (throughput, QA cycle time)

H. Quality of output (defect leakage, rework)

We are looking for:

  • Experience in Quality Assurance / Data Testing (QA testing, concepts, methodologies) preferably in analytics, data warehousing, or data platform environments.

  • Strong SQL skills (required) for validating data across data layers and building ad hoc validation queries.

  • Hands-on experience with BI and reporting tools such as Google Data Studio / Looker Studio, Google Sheets, Excel; familiarity with BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, and DAAS is preferred.

  • Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop / big data stacks) is an advantage.

  • Experience using Jira and Confluence (or similar tools) for ticketing, defect tracking, and documentation is preferred.

title: Executive Program Manager - 1 year temporary assignment
description:
This role is a one-year temporary assignment, with potential for extension. It exists to ensure the company delivers the multi-tenant v5 platform, migrates on-premise customers to v5 where revenue uplift is expected, moves existing single-tenant cloud customers to v5 where simplification and cost reduction are expected, and uses delegated executive authority to remove friction, unblock decisions, and keep functional teams accountable for delivery.


Key Deliverables
• The v5 cloud platform is delivered.
• New features are available in the cloud.
• Customers move from on-premise and single-tenant cloud environments onto the multi-tenant v5 platform.
• Delivery commitments are clear, owned, and met across functions.
• Risks and blockers are resolved quickly.
• The program achieves its financial goals by securing revenue uplift from on-premise migrations and reducing cost and complexity through consolidation of existing cloud customers onto v5.


Responsibilities
Plan
• Create and maintain the overall program plan.
• Identify dependencies between teams.
• Keep priorities aligned.
Drive Delivery Across Functions
• Use delegated executive authority to drive delivery across Engineering, Product, Cloud, Professional Services, Customer Success, Security, Sales and Finance.
• Make sure each team knows what it must deliver, by when, and what decisions or dependencies must be resolved.
• Hold functional leads accountable for agreed commitments and escalate non-delivery early.
Remove Obstacles
• Find issues early.
• Escalate decisions when required.
• Resolve conflicts between teams.
• Track actions to completion.
Manage Risk
• Maintain the program risk and dependency log.
• Agree mitigation actions with owners.
• Escalate serious risks to the Executive Team.
Communication
• Provide regular program updates.
• Present progress, risks, and decisions to executives.
• Make sure customers receive clear and timely communications.
Track Outcomes
• Measure migration progress.
• Measure delivery progress across both migration paths: on-premise to multi-tenant v5 and single-tenant cloud to multi-tenant v5.
• Measure commercial results separately for revenue uplift, cost reduction, and simplification benefits.
• Track the number of eligible on-premise customers contracted to move to v5, the incremental price uplift agreed per customer, and the total uplift to ARR or contracted recurring revenue.
• Track existing single-tenant cloud customers moving to v5 by migration status, cost reduction opportunity, support simplification, and reduction in separate customer environments.
• Maintain a migration dashboard showing both cohorts: on-premise customers where revenue uplift is expected, and existing cloud customers where simplification and cost reduction are expected.
• Report whether expected benefits are being achieved.



Leadership Expectations
• Focus on outcomes rather than activities.
• Hold teams accountable for commitments.
• Make problems visible early.
• Drive decisions quickly.
• Balance customer needs with business priorities.
• Keep all stakeholders aligned.
• Provide one clear view of program status.


Qualifications

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Formal programme or project management qualification (e.g., MSP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, PgMP, Agile Programme Management).
  • Strong understanding of SaaS, cloud platforms, and enterprise software delivery.


Desirable

  • MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business, Technology, or Strategy.
  • Agile certifications (SAFe, Scrum, Lean Portfolio Management).
  • Change Management certification (Prosci or equivalent).
  • Cloud certifications (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud).


Experience


  • Leadership & Programme Delivery
  • 10+ years' experience leading complex, cross-functional technology transformation programmes.
  • Demonstrated success delivering large-scale strategic initiatives with executive visibility and accountability.
  • Experience managing programmes spanning Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Security.
  • Proven ability to influence and hold senior stakeholders accountable without direct line management authority.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

title: Med Tech | Full Time
description:
1129 Parkway Ave, Elkhart, Indiana 46516

Job Description

The Med Tech provides quality care and assistance with activities of daily living for residents of the community as well as assists with the administration of prescribed medications within the established scope of practice.

Responsibilities

  • Assists with the administration of prescribed medications within the established scope of practice.
  • Must maintain a working knowledge of all policies and procedures pertaining to the position.
  • Assists residents with activities of daily living.
  • Reports incidents involving residents, including care concerns or issues, to appropriate individuals (e.g., HCD, RN/LPN, or ED).
  • Performs housekeeping duties, such as making resident beds, cleaning resident apartments, common areas, dining rooms, and other areas as directed by the supervisor.
  • Responds promptly to all resident calls for assistance or emergency alerts.
  • Assists in planning and conducting activity programs for residents.
  • Follows confidentiality policies regarding the release of resident information.
  • Assists residents to and from the dining room and to and from activities.
  • Checks on residents and ensures attendance at meals and activities.
  • Checks on residents who are ill and reports their status or concerns to appropriate individuals.
  • Communicates verbally and in writing to report resident status, upcoming community information, resident appointments, admissions, and transfers.
  • Assists new residents with the move-in transition by providing emotional support.
  • Attends all scheduled medication training sessions.
  • Completes medication cart audits as assigned and maintains the medication cart as directed.
  • Successfully passes all medication administration observations.
  • Communicates all medication-related resident needs to the HCD and documents information in the Daily Log.
  • Reorders medications, faxes requests to the pharmacy, and communicates with resident family members or responsible parties (RP) as needed regarding changes. Documents all updates in the Daily Log.
  • Documents all medication administration on the EMAR/MAR.
  • Reports all medication administration exceptions to the HCD and documents them on the EMAR and Daily Log.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Must possess a High School Diploma or GED.
  • Must have successfully completed the Medication Aide Course.
  • Must possess both a current CNA license and Med Tech license from the State Board of Nursing, in good standing.
  • Must satisfactorily pass two medication administration observations annually.
  • Must satisfactorily pass all assigned medication cart audits.
  • Must complete four additional hours of medication administration education annually.
  • Must be able to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Must be organized and able to work effectively with all levels of personnel.
  • Must be a contributing member of the nursing team and follow the instructions of the supervisor.
  • Must be polite and considerate of residents, visitors, and coworkers at all times.
  • Must be able to walk and stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. and push or carry up to 25 lbs.
  • Must be able to safely lift and transfer residents while maintaining proper body mechanics.
  • Must wear the designated uniform during working hours, including a name badge, and maintain a welcoming, positive attitude.
  • Must be CPR/First Aid certified or willing to become certified within 60 days of hire.
  • Must be able to represent the community in a positive and professional manner.
  • Must attend and complete all required in-services and staff meetings.
  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays.
  • Must be able to remain calm and competent during emergency situations.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. W naszej centrali łączymy kilkanaście jednostek biznesowych, w tym nasze zaplecze technologiczne. Choć jesteśmy zupełnie różni to mamy jeden cel - wszystko robimy na bank.


Na co dzień pracujemy w metodyce agile - w chapterach i squadach. Mamy też możliwość integracji z innymi pracownikami np. dzięki ponad 20 Klubom Zainteresowań.


Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • wiesz jak pisać, żeby Cię czytano
  • lubisz prosty język w komunikacji
  • masz „dobre oko” i poczucie estetyki
  • śledzisz trendy i nowinki w świecie mediów
  • masz wiedzę o produktach bankowych
  • znasz procesy sprzedażowe
  • masz ciekawe portfolio, które chcesz nam pokazać
  • masz wysokie zdolności interpersonalne i komunikacyjne
  • myślisz o ścieżkach swoich klientów
  • cenisz pracę zespołową
  • chętnie dzielisz się wiedzą
  • cechuje Cię dobra organizacja pracy, samodzielność, odpowiedzialność oraz determinacja w realizacji zadań
  • znasz język angielski (poziom min. B1)

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • podstawową znajomością HTML
  • doświadczenie z Adobe AEM lub / i CMS-a

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • tworzenie angażującej, spersonalizowanej komunikacji i dbanie o jej spójność w digitalu
  • zarządzanie pracami komunikacyjnymi w kanałach digital dla swojego obszaru produktowego
  • planowanie i realizowanie testów, które pozwolą poprawiać komunikację
  • wspieranie rozwoju narzędzi komunikacji
  • współpraca z partnerami biznesowymi, prawnikami i agencjami reklamowymi

To masz na bank:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 12 miesięcy),
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym w (lokalizacja na początku oferty),
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,
  • kartę Multisport,
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach,
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony,
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci,
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne,
  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.
  • Przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach.

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

title: Senior Advisor, Strategic Workforce Planning & Analytics
description:
Keyera Career Opportunity

Why Keyera?


It’s our purpose-driven culture, benefits, and people. From flexible, customizable benefits and an employer-funded pension plan to our Keyera Connects social investment program and paid employee volunteer days, we’re focused on empowering our people and communities.

THE POSITION
The Sr. Advisor – Strategic Workforce Planning & Analytics provides strategic insight and workforce intelligence to enable the organization to make informed decisions about its people, capabilities, and future workforce needs. The role combines strategic workforce planning, workforce analytics, data-driven insights, and strategic advisory to help leaders understand workforce opportunities and risks and translate insights into actional talent strategies. This role will also play a key part in evolving the organization’s workforce planning and HR Analytics capabilities, including leveraging technology and AI to improve workforce insights and decision-making.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Workforce Planning

  • Lead the development of Keyera’s Strategic Workforce Planning roadmap, further embedding strategic workplace planning through the enterprise
  • Connect enterprise workforce themes to key talent programs including, engagement, succession, learning and leadership
  • Lead and facilitate strategic workforce planning activities across the organization, connecting business strategy, workforce requirements, talent, skills and organizational capabilities
  • Partner with the business and HR Leaders to understand the current workforce challenges and anticipate future workforce needs
  • Develop multi-year workforce plans, roadmaps and scenarios aligned to business strategy and strategic priorities
  • Identify workforce risks, opportunities, critical roles, emerging capabilities, and future skills required
  • Assess implications of business growth, transformation, technology and AI on workforce requirements
  • Translate workforce planning insights into actionable talent strategies, including build, buy, borrow, automate, redeploy opportunities
  • Establish and continuously evolve workforce planning methodologies, tools, frameworks, and processes.

HR Analytics

  • Develop and deliver workforce analytics and insights that support strategic business and people decisions
  • Lead the development of the quarterly Organizational Health Scorecard and present key findings (insights) to teams, leaders and executives
  • Translates workforce and talent data into clear insights, narratives, and recommendations that support decision making
  • Develop dashboards, reporting and executive-level workforce insights that clearly communicate key trends, opportunities and risks

Future of Work, Skills & AI

  • Assess the impact of AI, automation, digital transformation, and changing work models on workforce requirements
  • Partner with HR Business Partners and Leaders to identify emerging skills and capabilities required for the future
  • Support strategies to upskill and reskill employees and enable movement of talent into future capability areas
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI and technology to improve workforce productivity, capacity, and talent decision-making.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Analytics, Organizational Development or a related discipline
  • Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in HR, workforce planning, HR Analytics, strategy, consulting, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience translating business strategy into workforce and talent implications
  • Superior analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex data and identify meaningful insights
  • Experience developing workforce plans, scenarios, analytics, dashboards, and executive presentations
  • Consulting and facilitation skills with experience working with senior leaders and influencing strategic decisions
  • Experience with HR data, reporting platforms, workforce analytics tools, and HR Technology
  • Demonstrated interest and understanding of AI, automation, emerging skills and the future of work
  • Interpersonal skills with ability to communicate effectively with cross function stakeholders

Oct 4, 2026

With cutting-edge technology at the center, we're revolutionizing the industry with our massive network and commitment to finding solutions for every challenge. We create more efficient ways for shippers and carriers to transport goods across North America.

As a Lead Analyst, Information Security – Risk Governance you will be responsible for helping strengthen our security and risk management framework. In this role, you'll lead the administration and execution of our information security risk governance program, partnering with business and technology teams to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate risks that could impact the organization. You'll play a key role in driving risk-informed decision making, enhancing governance processes, and ensuring security risks are managed in alignment with business objectives and regulatory expectations.

title: Assessor – Substance Use Disorder Services
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
About Spring Leaf Solutions

Spring Leaf Solutions is a Washington, DC-based behavioral health organization providing community-based mental health and substance use disorder services. Our team works collaboratively to provide accessible, person-centered care that supports consumers throughout treatment and recovery.



Position Summary

The Assessor plays an important role in the front end of the consumer care journey, gathering and evaluating information about each consumer’s substance use, behavioral health, psychosocial needs, functioning, strengths, and risk factors to determine appropriate treatment needs and level of care.

This role is ideal for a professional who is comfortable conducting structured interviews, synthesizing complex information, completing thorough clinical documentation, and working efficiently in a behavioral health environment.



Required Licensure/Certification

Candidates must hold a current, active District of Columbia license or certification, in good standing, that qualifies them to perform SUD assessments under DC DBH Chapter 63.

Qualifying credentials include:

  • Certified Addiction Counselor I (CAC I)
  • Certified Addiction Counselor II (CAC II)
  • Licensed Graduate Social Worker (LGSW)
  • Licensed Graduate Professional Counselor (LGPC) — for providers not operating under a Human Care Agreement
  • Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)
  • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
  • Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW)
  • Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN)
  • Psychologist
  • Qualified Physician

Please note: CAC I and CAC II professionals may conduct SUD assessments but may not diagnose. All assessment activities must be performed within the scope of the individual’s DC credential and applicable program requirements.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience conducting SUD assessments using ASAM criteria and making level-of-care recommendations.
  • Experience conducting assessments within a DC DBH-certified or Medicaid-funded SUD program.
  • Experience working in outpatient and/or intensive outpatient (IOP) substance use treatment settings.
  • Experience assessing individuals with co-occurring substance use and mental health needs.
  • Familiarity with DC DBH Chapter 63 and related SUD documentation and service requirements.
  • Experience working within a multidisciplinary community behavioral health or SUD treatment team.



Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive substance use disorder assessments in accordance with DC DBH requirements, organizational procedures, and applicable standards of care.
  • Interview consumers and gather relevant information regarding substance use history, behavioral and physical health, psychosocial needs, functioning, strengths, risks, and other factors affecting treatment.
  • Apply ASAM criteria to assessment findings to identify and document the appropriate level of care and recommended SUD services within the individual’s professional scope of practice.
  • Complete required assessment documentation accurately, thoroughly, and within established timeframes, including clear documentation of findings and the rationale supporting treatment recommendations.
  • Develop or contribute to initial treatment plans and treatment recommendations based on identified consumer needs.
  • Complete reassessments, treatment plan reviews, and treatment plan updates as assigned to support ongoing care and program requirements.
  • Identify clinical concerns, changes in consumer needs, or circumstances requiring additional evaluation or escalation and communicate them to appropriate clinical leadership.
  • Coordinate with Clinical Managers, Certified Addiction Counselors (CACs), Recovery Support Specialists (RSS), and other members of the SUD team to support timely transition into appropriate services and continuity of care.
  • Maintain accurate consumer records and comply with applicable confidentiality, documentation, DC DBH, Medicaid, and organizational requirements.


Work Setting & Schedule

This is a hybrid role that may be performed primarily remotely, with in-person availability required based on consumer and program needs.


Assessments, documentation, and other responsibilities may be completed remotely when appropriate and permitted by program requirements. Assessors should also be available to conduct assessments or participate in other activities in person at the Spring Leaf Solutions office in Washington, DC when needed.


The specific balance of remote and in-person work may vary and will be determined based on program needs and coordination with your direct supervisor. Candidates should therefore be able to reliably provide both remote and in-person services as required. Assessment volume may vary based on referrals, admissions, and consumer demand.

title: Flight Simulator Technician (FSTD)
description:
⠀

If you are passionate about safety, reliability, and delivering world-class aviation training, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. You will support CAE's vision of being the global training partner of choice by helping ensure that training devices remain qualified, available, and ready for every training session.


In this role, you will perform routine technical maintenance, conduct first-line troubleshooting, and support the upkeep of training devices in accordance with qualification standards.


Key Responsibilities


  • Support Flight Simulator Training Devices (FSTDs) and/or Cabin Crew Training Devices by responding to maintenance requests and performing device setup, conversions, and demonstrations.
  • Independently complete Preventive Maintenance Tasks (PMTs) and Daily Readiness (DR) activities on training devices and associated systems.
  • Review and sign off work completed by Simulator Support Assistants on complex PMTs and maintenance activities, as applicable.
  • Maintain accurate, current, and readily accessible maintenance records.
  • Execute recurrent Qualification Test Guide (QTG) runs and perform first-line troubleshooting using schematics and aircraft or device documentation.
  • Use the Maintenance Management System to record, track, and review maintenance activities.
  • Support recurring data and content updates, including Navigation Databases, Terrain Databases, OIS and EFB content, training documents, performance data, and IOS lesson plans.
  • Maintain accurate records of all software, data, and content updates.
  • Manage inventory levels of consumables and tools and submit replenishment requests as needed.
  • Support logistics activities, including annual inventory counts, storage organization, packing, and shipping preparation.
  • Perform housekeeping and administrative activities that support the Technical Services team.
  • Comply with local and global CAE Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) standards, policies, and safe work procedures.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Technical College Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Aviation, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working with flight simulators or related training devices.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.
  • Working knowledge of computer architecture, networking, operating systems, and programming concepts.
  • Ability to perform basic software modifications and troubleshooting activities.
  • Technical knowledge of simulator hardware and software systems.
  • Understanding of aircraft and training device terminology.
  • Customer-focused approach with the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience troubleshooting multiple simulator systems, including motion, visual, avionics, flight dynamics, and aircraft systems.
  • Knowledge of commercial aviation training environments and processes.
  • Experience supporting commercial aircraft simulator platforms.
  • Familiarity with a variety of aircraft types, including commercial jetliners.
  • Knowledge of applicable regulatory authorities and standards, including EASA, UAE DGCA, or equivalent regulations related to FSTDs.
  • Experience supporting simulator qualification activities, including QTG execution and analysis.

title: Finance - Graduate Programme 2027
description:
Finance - Graduate Programme 2027

Finance Graduates at MBDA work in three annual placements to gain knowledge and experience in various areas of Finance, working with colleagues across the business nationally and internationally. At the end of the three years, you will have achieved the ultimate reward of becoming a Chartered Accountant while having gained experiences including (but not limited to) reporting, budget and business plan preparation, and financial management of contracts.

Salary: £31,900 plus a £3000 joining bonus

Dynamic (Hybrid) Working: 2-3 days per week on-site due to workload classification

Security Clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.

This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Monday 2nd November 2026 but may close earlier depending on application volumes.

What we can offer you:

  • 3 year Programme: starting September 2027

  • Annual Salary Review

  • Company bonus: Up to £2,500 (based on company performance and will vary year to year)

  • Pension: maximum total (employer and employee) contribution of up to 14%

  • Overtime: opportunity for paid overtime

  • Annual Leave: 25 days plus option to purchase extra holiday

  • Flexi Leave: Up to 15 additional days

  • Excellent career progression and development opportunities

  • Facilities: Fantastic site facilities including subsidised meals, free car parking and much more…

  • Healthcare Cash Plan: The Healthcare Cash Plan benefit provides the option to claim cash back on everyday healthcare expenses such as optical, dental, health and wellbeing and more.

The opportunity:

Our vision in Finance is to operate as one coordinated team, which strives to deliver a consistent application of standard methodology, financial controls and processes. We look to challenge all areas of the business, improve shareholder value, protect the assets of MBDA and ensure we align with all national and shareholder requirements.

Finance Graduates work in three one-year placements to gain knowledge and experience in various areas of Finance, working with colleagues across the business, both nationally and internationally. This includes the potential opportunity to complete one of these placements with either our Manufacturing Finance team in Bolton or our Projects or Cost Base Finance teams in Bristol with a compensated relocation package to support the year at another site to Stevenage.

Potential placements could be available in the following areas:

  • Accounting and Planning – preparation of company level financial plans and reports for senior management and other stakeholders

  • Programmes Finance – working as a business partner within multi-functional teams, focused on contract delivery and execution

  • Cost Control – control of functional budgets, including Information Management and Facilities, and recovery of the cost base through hourly rates

  • Bids and Contract Evaluation – support the creation of robust, profitable financial proposals to customers for our products and services

Alongside your role, you'll study for the CIMA/ACA Professional Qualification, which we fully fund as well as providing additional leave for study and exams. Training courses on offer provide learning opportunities for soft skills and deeper understanding of the organisation to support you in your career development. Support and mentorship will be provided by experienced Finance team members, as well as fellow finance graduates, a buddy and a mentor, who will all ensure you get the most from the programme.

At the end of the three years upon exam and end point assessment completion, you will have become a Chartered Global Management Accountant or Associate Chartered Accountant through the completion of the Level 7 Accountancy Professional Apprenticeship.

Working in the Finance function provides the opportunity to develop as a business partner, supporting the business in value creation, sharing of standard methodology, and delivering as one team across cultures and national boundaries.

What we're looking for from you:

  • Degree qualified in any subject to a minimum of 2.2

  • Accounting, Finance or Business qualifications are not essential, but it is important that you demonstrate a general interest in Finance and strong numerical skills.

Our company: Peace is not a given, Freedom is not a given, Sovereignty is not a given.

MBDA is a leading defence organisation. We are proud of the role we play in supporting the Armed Forces who protect our nations. We partner with governments to work together towards a common goal, defending our freedom.

We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more…

We recognise that everyone is unique, and we encourage you to speak to us should you require any advice, support or adjustments throughout our recruitment process.

title: EMEA Consultant Relations Director
description:
KM5

POSITION PURPOSE

Investment consultants play a highly influential role across EMEA and are particularly important within the UK institutional market, where they advise a significant proportion of institutional asset owners and increasingly exercise direct investment discretion through OCIO and fiduciary management mandates. Our objective is to build deep, strategic relationships with these firms, secure and maintain strong research ratings for T. Rowe Price’s investment capabilities, and translate that advocacy into sustainable commercial opportunities and long-term institutional asset growth.

The EMEA Consultant Relations Lead heads up this effort and sets the strategy for how T. Rowe Price engages with the region’s most important consulting and OCIO firms. The role will be responsible for maximizing the effectiveness and commercial impact of these relationships, ensuring that the full breadth of T. Rowe Price’s investment capabilities, intellectual capital and broader firm resources are brought to bear.

Based in London, the role sits within EMEA Distribution, working alongside local teams aswell as Consultant-facing colleagues across the Americas and Asia-Pacific. The successful candidate will therefore combine strong regional leadership with a global mindset, working collaboratively across regions and functions to strengthen the firm’s position with strategically important consulting organizations.

The successful candidate will bring deep industry experience, established consultant and OCIO relationships, strong commercial instincts and the leadership capability to further develop the firm’s consultant strategy as the institutional marketplace continues to evolve.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Set and execute the EMEA consultant and OCIO strategy. In partnership with Distribution leadership, develop the commercial strategy for T. Rowe Price’s engagement with global, regional and domestic consultants and OCIO providers. Identify where the firm should invest its time and resources to maximize influence, commercial opportunity and long-term growth.

· Build strategic relationships with priority consulting and OCIO firms. Deepen senior-level relationships across manager research, field consulting and OCIO investment teams, positioning T. Rowe Price as a trusted strategic partner rather than solely an investment product provider.

· Drive commercial outcomes. Translate consultant engagement and research success into tangible business opportunities, including new mandates, increased participation in client searches, OCIO allocations and the retention and expansion of existing institutional relationships.

description:

Job Description:

The Logistics Technician is responsible for supporting the efficient flow of materials, equipment, and finished goods through receiving, warehouse, and shipping operations. This role performs a variety of logistics activities including receiving and inspection of incoming items, processing shipments and returns, packaging high-value technical products, inventory transactions, and work order support. The position requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to handle sensitive high-tech equipment in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Receive incoming materials, equipment, and customer returns, ensuring accurate verification against purchase orders, packing slips, and system records.

  • Process inventory transactions within ERP systems to maintain accurate inventory and traceability.

  • Prepare and package high-value semiconductor, electronic, and precision manufacturing products for domestic and international shipment.

  • Create shipping documentation, labels, export paperwork, and other logistics records as required.

  • Process Returned Material Authorizations (RMAs) and support return logistics activities.

  • Pick, stage, and issue materials to support manufacturing work orders and operational needs.

  • Perform cycle counting and inventory audits to maintain inventory accuracy.

  • Handle materials safely while following ESD, safety, quality, and compliance procedures.

  • Maintain organized warehouse, stockroom, and shipping areas.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on logistics efficiency, inventory accuracy, and on-time delivery.

  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, Customer Service, and Engineering teams to resolve shipping and inventory issues.

Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:

  • Experience in shipping, receiving, warehouse, logistics, or materials handling in a manufacturing environment.

  • Experience handling high-value electronic, semiconductor, or precision equipment preferred.

  • Knowledge of shipping, receiving, inventory control, and warehouse procedures.

  • Experience using ERP, inventory management, or warehouse management systems.

  • Ability to accurately process transactions and maintain detailed records.

  • Familiarity with domestic and international shipping requirements preferred.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to read work orders, shipping instructions, and inventory documentation.

  • Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office applications.

  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.

  • Ability to lift and move materials up to established company limits and work in a warehouse/manufacturing environment.

Working Conditions:

  • Regular interaction with warehouse, manufacturing, and office personnel.

  • Frequent standing, walking, lifting, packing, and material handling.

  • Use of pallet jacks, shipping equipment, barcode scanners, and packaging tools.

  • Exposure to warehouse and manufacturing environments while following all applicable safety procedures.

Skills:

Domestic Shipping, Freight Shipping, Heavy Lifting, International Shipping, Lifting Equipment, Shipping, Shipping and Receiving, Shipping Coordination, Shipping Document Preparation, Shipping Procedures, Warehouse Forklifts

Minimum of 1 - 2 years of related experience. Operative/Technician roles will typically operate more complex machinery/processes | Required

Desirable

Job Description:

The Auto Body Technician’s primary responsibility and accountability includes providing an exceptional and successful customer experience through the meticulous assessment and quality repair of each customer’s vehicle to restore it back to pre-accident condition. The Auto Body Technician thoroughly disassembles, repairs, and reassembles each vehicle while playing a pivotal role to our company’s promise of speed, quality and customer excellence. The Auto Body Technician works in alignment with all team members in achieving the repair facilities KPIs and is committed to being a dedicated Brand Ambassador of The Boyd Group at all times.


Key Job Responsibilities

  • Ensure consistent execution of WOW (Wow Operating Way) plan.
  • Plans the repair work that is necessary and prepares cost estimates for customers. Uses various tools such as cutting guns, plasma cutters, hydraulic jacks, hammers, and pliers to repair sections of a vehicle.
  • Hammers out dents, dimples, and other minor body damage if possible; mixes and applies filler resins to repair dents when other methods are not feasible.
  • Realigns car chassis and frames to repair structural damage.
  • Removes damaged sections of vehicles and replaces them with new or aftermarket parts. Replaces or repairs glass and windshields as needed.
  • Replaces or repairs interior parts as needed.
  • Welds and otherwise attaches or fits parts into place and Prepares and repaints vehicles with factory-specified paint or agreed-upon equivalent.
  • Attempts to complete work orders within labor time guidelines. Ensures all work has been executed correctly by inspecting vehicles after repair.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education and/or Experience Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Successful completion of technical school program OR a 3-year apprenticeship as an auto body repairer.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to read job orders and work with very little supervision.
  • Ability to work with other repairers within an auto body shop.
  • Thorough understanding of methods and procedures to repair vehicle bodies.
  • Thorough understanding of how to use tools required for the trade.

Other Requirements

  • Must be able to work safely in a noisy area with many odors present.
  • Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds at times.
  • Must be able to visually inspect vehicle damage in a variety of weather conditions.
  • Must be able to bend, stretch, kneel, and squat to perform repairs and inspections.

description:

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • aktywne pozyskiwanie oraz rozwijanie relacji z klientami instytucjonalnymi,
  • realizacja transakcji na rynku walutowym (FX), stopy procentowej oraz instrumentów dłużnych,
  • budowanie i utrzymywanie długoterminowych relacji biznesowych z klientami,

  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych celów biznesowych,
  • reprezentowanie banku podczas spotkań z klientami oraz wydarzeń branżowych.

Aplikuj do nas, jeśli:

  • masz doświadczenie na rynku finansowym oraz wysoko rozwinięte kompetencje zawodowe,
  • bardzo dobrze znasz rynek walutowy, stopy procentowej oraz rynek obligacji,
  • posiadasz doświadczenie w obsłudze klientów instytucjonalnych,
  • znasz produkty skarbowe oraz instrumenty finansowe wykorzystywane do zarządzania ryzykiem,
  • potrafisz budować trwałe relacje biznesowe i skutecznie rozwijać portfel klientów,
  • wyróżniają Cię wysokie kompetencje negocjacyjne, komunikacyjne i sprzedażowe,
  • potrafisz samodzielnie podejmować decyzje w dynamicznym środowisku rynkowym,
  • cechuje Cię orientacja na realizację celów biznesowych i generowanie wartości dla klientów,
  • bardzo dobrze posługujesz się językiem angielskim w mowie i piśmie.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę;
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym;
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego);
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego;
  • kartę Multisport;
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach;
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony;
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci;
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala;
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne.


Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?
Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań. Przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

2. Spotkaj się (online) z rekruterem/-ką i managerem/-ką.
3. Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania.
Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Commercial Loan Workout Officer
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
At OceanFirst Bank, each one of our employees plays an important role in delivering value to our customers and executing daily tasks in accordance with our core values. We recognize that our employees are essential to our success, making OceanFirst a great place to work and do business.
Great benefits include: employee perks & discount programs, tuition assistance, incentive compensation program, professional development opportunities, and more! Apply today to #BecomeOceanFirst and make an impact in the local community!
ABOUT YOUR ROLE
The Commercial Loan Workout Officer is responsible for managing problem commercial, commercial real estate, and classified multifamily credits within the Special Assets portfolio. This role supports the development and execution of workout, restructure, and recovery strategies designed to mitigate credit risk, protect collateral positions, preserve principal, and improve recovery outcomes. This role partners with lending, credit, legal, borrowers, guarantors, attorneys, and other stakeholders to support effective problem loan resolution and sound credit decision-making. This role also prepares credit analyses, risk assessments, reserve and charge-off recommendations, and portfolio updates while ensuring compliance with Bank policy, lending procedures, regulatory requirements, and approved workout strategies.
WHAT YOU WILL DO LIST
Manage assigned commercial, commercial real estate, and classified multifamily credits within the Special Assets portfolio, applying sound workout practices to mitigate loss exposure, preserve principal, and support recovery outcomes.
Support the development and execution of workout, restructure, and recovery strategies that consider credit risk, collateral protection, borrower performance, legal considerations, regulatory requirements, and Bank policy.
Analyze borrower financial performance, repayment capacity, covenant compliance, collateral value, and credit trends to identify emerging risk and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
Prepare credit approval memoranda, risk assessments, collateral evaluations, reserve analyses, charge-off recommendations, financial updates, and other materials for review by senior credit authorities.
Communicate and negotiate with borrowers, guarantors, attorneys, lending officers, workout officers, and external parties to support resolution of troubled credits while maintaining appropriate risk controls.
Review loan documentation, amendments, restructures, forbearance agreements, collateral actions, and other workout-related materials for accuracy, completeness, policy compliance, and alignment with approved strategies.
Monitor borrower performance, reporting requirements, deadlines, covenants, and agreed-upon action plans to ensure timely follow-up and adherence to workout expectations.
Provide updates for Credit Quality meetings and related reporting, including problem credit status, workout progress, emerging risks, reserve needs, charge-off exposure, and recovery expectations.
Build effective working relationships with lending, credit, legal, portfolio management, borrowers, and third-party partners to support timely problem loan resolution and sound decision-making.

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU
Strong knowledge of commercial lending and commercial workout, including banking regulations, credit approvals, banking policy, and related lending procedures.
Working knowledge of bankruptcy, business and real estate law, real estate documentation, and commercial real estate lending practices.
Demonstrated skills in loan documentation review, credit underwriting, credit analysis, financial statement analysis, covenant calculations, debt coverage ratios, and other financial ratios.
Ability to build and maintain effective internal and external relationships by identifying needs, communicating clearly, and supporting practical credit solutions.
Strong written, verbal, and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with team members, cross-functional partners, customers, and other stakeholders.
Ability to understand and adapt to loan accounting systems, with proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. title: Homemaker Aide
description:
Grand Traverse County is a team of passionate and incredible people who are committed to providing responsive, effective quality service to our up-north community. We strive to be a leader in innovative, effective, collaborative, and sustainable county government. We offer stable work environments and competitive salaries to both full- time and part-time employees. Understanding the many challenges facing today’s professionals and families, we offer a competitive compensation package including an impressive list of benefits and time off.

Job Description:

Primary function of the job is to provide homemaking assistance to clients of the Commission on Aging, such as laundry, vacuuming, cleaning, dusting, and related items. Employees work as part of a team and are responsible for ensuring that the team meets its objectives.

Employees must meet the minimum requirements, conditions of employment, and be able to perform successfully all essential duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodations.

Work assignments may be irregular depending on need and number of clients requesting service. It will also require travel by the employee in the employee's own vehicle.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (may include but are not limited to the following)

  • Performs a variety of home cleaning assistance such as the following.

  • Dusts, vacuums, sweeps and mops floors.

  • Makes beds and shakes small rugs.

  • Washes dishes, cleans and disinfects kitchen counters, sinks, bathtubs and toilets.

  • Cleans refrigerator, stove and cupboards

  • Washes, dries, folds, and puts away laundry.

  • Washes walls and inside windows.

  • Interacts with clients, performs basic checks and monitoring of client situation and environment, reports all potentially harmful or unusual situations to a supervisor.

  • Performs as a mandated reporter, when appropriate.

  • Prepares and maintains accurate records of client services and related information.

  • Participates in staff meetings, training sessions, and/or other related meetings.

EDUCATION, FORMAL TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE (minimum requirements)

  • Graduation from high school or G.E.D. preferred but not required

  • Some house cleaning experience required

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES(minimum requirements)

  • Requires a valid drivers license and personal vehicle insurance and must maintain eligibility to drive as per the County's Vehicle policy.

  • CPR Certification

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT (legal or contractual pre-employment obligations and/or requirements, such as drug testing, background check, etc.)
A background check may be required initially and periodically for an individual hired, transferred, reclassified, promoted, or currently working in this job. Appointment to or continued employment in this job is contingent upon a satisfactory background check which may include, but is not limited to: confirmation of a persons' identity; review of criminal conviction records; verification of educational degree, license, or certificate required for the position; review of Department of Motor Vehicles records; Department of Justice fingerprint scan; and/or drug and alcohol testing as required and allowable by law. A satisfactory background check is defined as the absence of a criminal history record which bears a demonstrable relationship to the applicant's or employee's suitability to perform the required duties and responsibilities of the position.

DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS
Manual labor for job tasks is required and includes regular contacts with senior citizens, customers of the Commission on Aging, and co-workers to obtain and/or provide information. Supervision consists of general instructions in new assignments with advice and assistance normally available. Errors could lead to minor inconvenience and consequences that may not be obvious outside the work unit, have little effect on service to the public, and can generally be detected easily by the employee and corrected.

This job is not part of a series.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS, WORK ENVIRONMENT, AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • May be required to climb or balance; reach with hands and arms; stand; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk and hear; smell; use hands to finger, handle, or feel.

  • May be exposed to risk of electrical shock, fumes or airborne particles, and infectious diseases.

  • May occasionally be required to lift/move up to 25 pounds (such as lifting vacuums cleaners, moving furniture in order to clean, etc.)

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES, COMPETENCIES(minimum requirements)

  • Basic knowledge of English in order to interact effectively with clients and co-workers, as well as to prepare necessary paperwork

  • Interpersonal skills necessary to work courteously and effectively with other employees and the public. Sensitivity to the needs of older adults.

  • Ability to operate homemaker aide equipment (such as vacuum cleaners and washing machines) safely and in the manner for which they were designed

  • Ability to perform manual labor tasks

  • Ability to work independently

  • Ability to maintain the confidentiality of information and professional boundaries

  • Ability to use sound judgment to detect unusual, harmful, or emergency situations and act accordingly

  • Ability to comprehend, process and apply both verbal and written skills appropriate to the job

  • Ability to use County resources effectively and efficiently.

Compensation:

Starting Hourly Rate: $18.26 USD

Grand Traverse County is a great place to live, work and play. Come join our team and experience what northern Michigan is all about, apply today!


You really should see what we have to offer:

  • Medical: The County offers employees a high-deductible plan through Priority Health. To help cover the cost of the deductible, Grand Traverse County will deposit a contribution amount up to $2,000 into an employee Health Savings Account every year. You may also direct deposit funds into this account every pay period.

  • Vision: The County provides a no cost plan for employees. We also offer an enhanced plan through EyeMed.

  • Dental: Our dental insurance provider is Delta Dental. You will pay no costs or premium for diagnostic and cleaning services.

  • Wellness: Grand Traverse County is committed to creating a culture of health. We provide a variety of incentives and programs that allow you to live a healthy lifestyle.

  • Employee Recognition: We highly value our employees, which we show by providing our employees awards and recognition throughout the year, and on anniversary dates.

  • Tuition Reimbursement: Employees are reimbursed up to $5,250 annually for enrollment in courses at an accredited college, university, or trade school.

  • Vacation: Grand Traverse County provides a generous amount of vacation days to benefitted employees so you can spend time with family and friends.

  • Holidays: The County gives you 12 days a year to celebrate holidays. Beyond these 12 days, you will receive additional floating holidays to use at your discretion.

  • Personal Leave: Employees receive up to 72 hours annually depending on contract, to use for appointments, take care of family needs and other personal reasons. Employees are paid every year for unused personal leave up to 40 hours.

  • Parental Leave: Employees may take up to 6 months of leave to begin at birth or date of adoption of their child.

  • Retirement: Grand Traverse County offers a defined contribution through MERS. The plan includes a generous match that fully vests after 6 years of employment.

  • 457(b) Retirement Plans: The County also offers optional 457(b) deferred compensation and Roth retirement plans with matching contributions up to an approved amount, based on applicable contract provisions.

  • Life Insurance: Benefitted employees automatically receive life insurance.

  • Short Term Disability: The County provides a plan through Mutual of Omaha, which pays two thirds of your salary or wages for a maximum of 182 days.

  • Long Term Disability: The County provides a plan through Mutual of Omaha, which pays 60 percent of your salary or wages for a maximum of 24 months.

The Department of Environmental Protection, Bureau of Remediation and Waste Management, Division of Technical Services is seeking to fill an Environmental Hydrogeology Specialist vacancy in Augusta.

DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION


ENVIRONMENTAL HYDROGEOLOGY SPECIALIST



-ANTICIPATED VACANCY-



Opening Date: September 25, 2026

Closing Date: End of the day October 13, 2026

Location: Augusta

Position Number: 08300-1857

Position Type: Full Time/Year-Round

Class Code: 9484

Grade: 26 (Professional/Technical Unit)

Salary: $56,264.00 - $78,998.40 Per Year*

*This is earning potential over the course of nine steps; new hires typically start at step one. Annual step increases are based on performance reviews and authorization of such increases.


Interested candidates need to submit a Direct Hire Application, Cover Letter, and detailed Resume*


*For us to properly determine if you meet the minimum qualifications for any posting, you must be sure your resume includes the month and year for any relevant experience listed. Your resume should include the duties and responsibilities associated with each position. Any experience that was not full-time employment should be identified as such.


BRIEF JOB DESCRIPTION: This position provides professional hydrogeologic services relating to the investigation, remediation, and monitoring of sites contaminated by a variety of petroleum and hazardous substances. This position is expected to have the skills or experience needed to develop a specialty related to contaminant hydrogeology and a working knowledge of the geochemistry of emerging contaminants, including, but not limited to, per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). Duties include review, oversight, and participation in soil and hydrogeologic investigations, and review of work plans and reports for the Department of Defense, RCRA, Superfund, Brownfields, Voluntary Response Action, Solid Waste, Uncontrolled Sites, and other Bureau programs. The position collaborates with staff throughout the Department to achieve cleanup goals and interacts with staff in other agencies at the state and federal levels. The successful candidate is expected to be skilled in the use of a variety of sampling, geophysical, and testing tools and in the collection of soil, hydrological, and geological data during field investigations. Familiarity with GIS, database and data visualization software to support project evaluations and recommendations is also expected. Strong verbal and writing skills are required for the presentation of conclusions to technical and non-technical audiences including Department staff, consultants, responsible parties, and the general public.


For more information on the specifics of the position, please contact Chris Evans at (207) 441-5181.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: An eight (8) year combination of education and experience in the fields of hydrogeology, hydrology and geology including experience in responsible charge of geological work.


LICENSING/REGISTRATION/CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS: Licensed as a Geologist by the Board of Licensure of Geologists and Soil Scientists.


Preference will be given to candidates with the following skills or experience:

  • Knowledge of contaminant fate and transport in the subsurface.
  • Knowledge of investigation and remediation methodologies at contaminated sites.
  • Knowledge of emerging contaminants including PFAS.
  • Familiarity with GIS, statistical, geochemical, and data plotting software.
  • Ability to manage projects in order to meet project deadlines.
  • Ability to identify and analyze problems, reach logical conclusions, and make sound, risk-based, cost-effective decisions.

Currently, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or STEM OPT extensions.
