title: Senior MSK Physiotherapist
description:
Senior Physiotherapist

Guildford Hospital | Permanent | Full time

Up to £51,000 per annum, depending on skills and experience

37.5 hours per week


As a Senior Physiotherapist at our hospital, you’ll have a BSc in Physiotherapy or equivalent and registration with the Health and Care Professions Council. You also have excellent clinical reasoning and rehabilitation skills, and you’re committed to developing as a practitioner. You’re a confident communicator, skilled at engaging with all kinds of people.


As part of the team you will have clinical support available from your Regional clinical lead along with Physiotherapists, with leadership from the management team on site. You will have a CPD budget to encourage you to continue your learning and striving for clinical excellence. The hospital is brilliantly placed to support and mentor the successful candidate for this role, alongside our academy training programmes.


We can offer both part time and full time hours, with a mixture of face to face time across other sites or working from home delivering triage hours.


As a Senior Physiotherapist, you will:


  • See a wide range of musculoskeletal conditions and post operative cases, playing a key role in helping our patients achieve, maintain and recover to the level of health and wellbeing that they aspire to.
  • Work within a multidisciplinary team including nurses, AHPS and consultants in order to optimise the health and recovery of our patients.
  • Deliver high quality, effective clinical care.
  • Adhere to our values and beliefs at Nuffield Health, in which we encourage behaviour which is enterprising, passionate, independent and caring.
  • Deliver excellent clinical care that is evidence based, Safe, Effective, Caring, Well-led and responsive to our patient’s needs.
  • Ensure on-going monitoring of the standard of treatment provided.
  • Be compliant with all professional, clinical and integrated governance standards and participate in clinical audit and other quality assurance processes.

To succeed as a Senior Physiotherapist, you will:


  • Have a BSc in Physiotherapy or equivalent, you’ll be registered with the Health and Care Professions Council.
  • Demonstrate evidence of further professional training and continual professional development, reflecting your desire to develop as a practitioner.
  • Be a confident communicator with the ability to engage effectively with the general public and other healthcare professionals.
  • Be able to demonstrate excellent rehabilitation skills.
  • Be a competent and confident IT user with strong organisation skills.
  • Have the ability to prioritise and deal with your varied workload in an effective and timely manner.

It’s equally important that you share our values. We believe in putting people first and providing personalised, holistic healthcare. That makes you part of a much wider team, working to create a healthier future for each individual client.

Supporting your growth.


We’re committed to the professional development of all our clinical colleagues. Inside our Learning and Development Academy, you’ll discover a range of internal CPD courses and online content to support your clinical and professional development. As a Nuffield Health Physiotherapist, you’ll also enjoy opportunities to apply for funding support towards your relevant CPD activity and postgraduate study. Plus, you can access further professional development opportunities via the large number of apprenticeship programmes we offer.


Helping you feel good.


We want you to love coming to work, feeling healthy, happy and valued. That’s why we’ve developed a benefits package with you in mind. Here, you can choose from a range of fitness, lifestyle, health and fitness wellbeing rewards, such as free gym membership, health assessments, retail discounts and pension options. At Nuffield Health, we take care of what’s important to you.


Join Nuffield Health and create the future you want, today.


If you like what you see, why not start your application now? We consider applications as we receive them and reserve the right to close adverts early (for example, where we have received an unprecedented high volume of applications). So, it’s a good idea to apply right away to ensure you’re considered for this role.


It starts with you.

description:

03/19/26

$33.00

Department

Sheriff

About the Position

Deputy Sheriff Trainee – Starting Salary of $68,640 plus a $7,500 Sign On Incentive

Pre-Employment assessments:


$35.10 UPON SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF THE DEPUTY SHERIFF ACADEMY

Apply in less than 5 minutes!

  • Trainees may earn over $70,000 during their first full year of employment!
  • Receive up to $5,250 annually in education reimbursement
  • Earn 3 weeks of vacation in first year
  • Eligible employees receive up to 6 weeks of paid paternal leave for the birth or adoption of a child


Do you have a desire to protect and serve your community? The Maricopa County Sheriff's Office (MCSO) is seeking passionate individuals to join our team as a Deputy Sheriff Trainee. In this role, high importance is placed on ensuring public safety is provided and maintained by an individual who takes pride in their work and considers the impact of their actions on an individual, team and organizational level.

We are looking for candidates who possess integrity and strong interpersonal skills. Ideal candidates are skilled problem solvers with the ability to use good judgment while diffusing situations, resolving conflict, and serving others and the community. If this sounds like the right opportunity for you... your adventure with MCSO awaits!

To be part of our team as a Deputy Sheriff, you must, be an effective communicator, even in the most challenging of situations, care about the safety and well-being of others, respect all individuals regardless of background or socio-economic status. You must embrace the concepts of integrity, accountability and transparency as core values. You must collaborate with team members, supervisors and managers to forward the mission and vision of MCSO.

Compensation is more than a salary with MCSO. Your perks at work include paid training, a stable environment, great benefits, flexibility and generous leave, and you will have an opportunity to serve your community as part of a diverse and talented workforce.

MCSO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE

  • Maximum Reimbursement: Not to exceed $7,500
  • For successful candidates residing outside of Maricopa County
  • Reimbursements shall only be made for expenses incurred by the employee and their spouse and legal dependents. Proof of marital and dependent status may be required.
  • The County may, at its discretion, refuse to reimburse any moving expense for which the employee fails to provide appropriate documentation or that the County deems unreasonable.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum education and/or experience:
High school diploma or GED


Must be a U.S. citizen

Must be twenty (20) years and six (6) months of age at the time of application, and 21 years of age prior to the completion of the Sheriff's academy.

Must meet Arizona Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) standards, as determined through the pre-employment process, as indicated here:

Individuals with lapsed Arizona POST certification, and those who have served as a certified peace officer in another state or federal agency, please submit an application for the Deputy Sheriff - Lateral position.

Specialized training, certifications, and/or other special requirements:
Must possess, or have the ability to obtain by the time of hire, a valid Arizona driver's license.

Must provide a valid government issued birth certificate at the time of background processing.

Certified by the State of Arizona Peace Officer Standards and Training Board (AZ POST) as a Peace Officer.

Training on the following provided on-the-job: FEMA NIMS – IS100 AND 700, OSHA, payroll, and PREA.

Prior to hiring, the Sheriff's Office requires that all applicants complete the following: physical readiness assessment (PRA), a written examination, orientation, background investigation, polygraph examination, psychological exam and medical exam.


Physical Readiness Assessment (PRA)/Written Examination/Orientation – Pre-Employment division will contact you about a assessment date.


The PRA consists of completing a series of assessments which consists of the following:

ASSESSMENT MINIMUM STANDARDS

1. One (1) Repetition Max (RM)- Bench Press - Push 72% of Body Weight or 115 Pounds

2. Agility Run in 19.0 seconds

3. 300 Meter Run in 72 seconds

4. Maximum of Twenty Push-Ups

5. 1.5 Mile Run/Walk in 17 minutes, 44 seconds or less

*Graduation from the academy requires trainees successfully complete the Arizona Post POPAT (Police Officer Physical Aptitude Test).

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:


Work ethic and integrity: Ability and willingness to work hard and conscientiously regardless of assignment and be committed to MCSO's mission; to represent information truthfully and be trustworthy in performance of duties; to act without regard to personal preference or bias; to take actions and make decisions through the thoughtful consideration of discretion; to act consistently with professional standards and within MCSO's policies, procedures and values.

Attention to detail: Ability to attend to physical needs and human comfort and identify when inconsistencies in protocol exist.

Reasoning and judgment: Ability to apply deductive and inductive reasoning to information and facts about situations to reach logical conclusions from the reasoning process; to recognize problems, understand their implications and devise solutions; to determine the relevance of each item of information.

Problem solve: Ability to devise multiple solutions or contingencies and to evaluate their strengths and weaknesses; to evaluate and choose between conflicting alternatives based on partial or incomplete information; to solve problems quickly in emergency situations and under stress.

Leadership: Ability to maintain good morale, motivation and commitment from others; to set a positive tone; to have the psychological and emotional maturity, self-confidence and willingness to assume responsibility for efforts and actions and to take responsibility for the consequences of those actions; to represent the Sheriff's Office in the best possible light.

Function under stress: Ability to maintain composure in difficult or stressful situations such as those that require emergency action; to make security-related decisions promptly; to use sound judgment in stressful situations by either taking or refraining from action (e.g., showing restraint); to remain calm during emergencies.

Teamwork: Ability to work as a member of a team; to create and develop a team (e.g., assigning team roles and responsibilities, developing team goals); to lead a team; to identify potential team building problems and how to prevent them (e.g., Groupthink, scapegoating); to work harmoniously with coworkers; to participate when appropriate; to work with others to achieve desired solutions; to assist coworkers in both emergency and non-emergency situations.

Preferred education and/or experience:
Any combination of advanced education (AA, BA, BS or Graduate Degree) or experience (including Military).

Working conditions:
Working conditions may vary depending on assignment. Incumbents may be subjected to harsh elements such as extreme heat or cold, wet or dry, altitude, rough terrain, rural, suburban and urban environments. Incumbents may face dangerous, hostile and at times life threatening conditions, fatigue, physical or emotional stress related to the performance of the duties of a law enforcement officer.

Job requires the ability to work any location, shift and assignment operating 24 hours per day, 7 days per week.

Job requires the ability to: perform sprints, jumping and vaulting tasks; perform lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling; move quickly around objects and obstacles in pursuit situations; and pursue, extract and use force in both short intense effort and sustained effort situations. Actual situations may require efforts beyond the following:

  • Perform foot pursuits that may include running sprints of 100 feet or more; running for sustained periods, usually 300 feet but up to 5 minutes; running up and down stairs, usually 2 flights but may be up to 4 flights; run over uneven terrain; and dodge around obstacles.


Working environment:
The following environments described are only representative of how the essential job tasks are currently performed or envisioned. As such, in order to accommodate a disability or limitation, the essential job tasks may be performed in ways other than described on these pages.

Work Environment:

  • Indoors and outdoors; confined areas

Physical Environment:

  • Precise dexterity

Social Environment:

  • Interruptions, multiple or complicated tasks, frequently changing or unscheduled tasks, working under deadlines or time pressures
  • Concentration/vigilance
  • Isolation

ESSENTIAL JOB TASKS:

The Deputy Sheriff in the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office (MCSO) enforces laws and maintains order while protecting life and property. The Deputy Sheriff is responsible for ensuring the public safety of the citizens of Maricopa County and the State of Arizona in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws, regulations and MCSO policies.

Criminal investigations
Conducts traffic and criminal investigations, using accepted methods and techniques to identify, secure, collect and protect evidence and crime scenes; conducts interviews with victims, witnesses, and suspects, gathering information, developing probable cause, making arrests and executing search warrants.

Response to calls for service
Responds quickly to emergency situations via department vehicle using vehicle's emergency equipment when needed (e.g., lights and sirens); determines the quickest and safest approach to an emergency scene; determines the best strategy for restoring or maintaining order and safety; uses defensive tactics and appropriate level of force, to include using assigned weapons (e.g., firearm, Taser, baton), to control a situation; issues warnings and/or citations to ensure public safety and compliance with the law.

Patrol duties
Maintains a safe and secure community by identifying and responding to in-progress criminal activity and unusual or suspicious circumstances, vehicles, packages; makes observations, writes reports, communicates with the public and provides a level of service required in conjunction with all local, state and federal laws, as well as all applicable policies and procedures of the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office; engages the community in positive proactive policing practices to fulfill the departments mission, establishes strong ties and relationships within the community by conducting oneself in a professional, fair and transparent manner at all times.

Training
Attends, implements and provides all required training associated with the duties and functions of a law enforcement officer as specified by Arizona Police Officers Standards Training Board (POST) and the Maricopa County Sheriff's Office.

Administration
Interacts with the public and staff by effectively communicating verbally, and in writing, to direct, ascertain information, document incidents, requirements, needs and conditions within the facility; operates electronic and other equipment (e.g., telephones, portable radios, desktop and mobile computers, cameras); independently gathers information through a variety of methods in order to document information and actions; utilizes technology to access information and records, and documents in reports as required by policy.

title: Production Leader
description:
Solenis is a leading global provider of water and hygiene solutions. The company’s product portfolio includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, cleaners, disinfectants, and state-of-the-art monitoring, control and delivery systems. These technologies are used by customers to improve operational efficiencies, enhance product quality, protect plant assets, minimize environmental impact, and create cleaner and safer environments. Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, the company has 78 manufacturing facilities strategically located around the globe and employs a team of over 23,000 professionals in 160 countries across six continents. Solenis is a 2025 Best Managed Company Gold Standard honoree. For more information about Solenis, please visit .


Position Prerequisites


Location: Beihai, Guangxi

Education:. College degree or above in Chemical, automation, or a related field.

Experience:

More than 3 years of production team management experience in enterprise manufacturing;

Experience operating DCS or PLC;

Skills :

  • Familiarize with the hazardous properties of common chemicals.
  • Familiar with chemical equipment and facilities
  • Familiar with chemical instrumentation and DCS system.
  • Familiar with work permit procedures.

Competency :

  • Good at independent work and problem-solving, diligent and honest, with team spirit.
  • Strong leadership, good communication skills and coordination drive.

Major Accountabilities


  • Attend company/the group/government EHS-related training and keep training records.
  • Strictly comply with factory safety, environmental protection, occupational health, and security regulations and the Employee Code.
  • If a safety and environmental accident occur in plant, this position must participate in the emergency response according to the emergency plan.
  • Management teams must comply with chemical handling regulations and other safety regulations, wear PPE correctly, and promptly stop and report any unsafety behaviors.
  • Fully manage the EHS, quality, and efficiency performance of the assigned teams, and be accountable for relevant KPI.
  • Reasonably arrange the work of team members and contractor employees to ensure production tasks are completed on time.
  • Organize teams and contractors to complete production records for their shifts and carefully hand them over to the next shift.
  • Manage production discipline within the team, implement company management regulations and workshop 5S management requirements.
  • Regularly provide training to team, and conduct assessments.
  • Guide operators to do routine maintenance (TPM) to ensure reliable operation.
  • Complete routine inspections and promptly handle any abnormalities.
  • During maintenance work, strictly implement work permit systems, such as LOTO procedures, hot work permits, and confined space entry permits
  • Monitor operators to do equipment start/stop, material dosing, and related equipment control.
  • When DCS operator is not on duty, production leader operate DCS to control production lines operation; Monitor parameters such as temperature, pressure, and flow rate; Make judgments and take appropriate actions based on product process indicators.
  • Record and analyze finished product indicators and process parameters (SPC) daily; handle and report abnormal process issues according to procedures.
  • Follow the procedures for executing Interlock and alarms; do not bypass Interlock without permission.
  • Guide on-site personnel to complete sampling, sample delivery, and analysis to ensure samples are representative.
  • Actively cooperate with colleagues from EHS, maintenance, quality , logistic, and other departments.

title: ekspert ds. analiz i doświadczeń klienta
description:
To masz na bank:

  • umowa o pracę (pierwsza umowa na 12 miesięcy),
  • praca hybrydowa (częściowo w biurze w Poznaniu, ul. Kolorowa 8 i 10 (przy centrum handlowym King Cross)).
  • zespół/lider: Zespół Rozwoju Procesów Reklamacji, Michał Michalak
  • cel: rozwój i optymalizacja procesów obsługi reklamacji z perspektywy efektywności operacyjnej oraz doświadczeń klientów.

Lubisz, gdy rzeczy dzieją się na bank? My też! W naszym zespole IT korzystamy z najnowszych technologii, by to osiągnąć, ponieważ jesteśmy firmą technologiczną z usługami bankowymi.

Tworzymy zespół ponad 2000 specjalistów, którzy wspierają bank i dbają o niezawodność i bezpieczeństwo systemu bankowego. Ekosystem IT to nie tylko wsparcie dla tworzonych przez nas produktów, ale szereg systemów corowych, platform globalnych i wielu innych procesów.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj jeśli:

  • posiadasz min. 3 lata doświadczenia w obszarze analizy biznesowej, CX/UX lub optymalizacji procesów,
  • masz doświadczenie w pracy z procesami obsługi klienta (doświadczenie w obszarze reklamacji będzie dodatkowym atutem),
  • potrafisz mapować procesy biznesowe oraz ścieżki klienta,
  • znasz metody analizy danych i potrafisz formułować trafne wnioski oraz rekomendacje,
  • brałeś/aś udział w projektach związanych z automatyzacją procesów (np. RPA, BPM, workflow),
  • znasz narzędzia analityczne, takie jak Excel, Power BI lub SQL,
  • wyróżnia Cię myślenie procesowe, orientacja na klienta oraz dbałość o jakość,
  • potrafisz skutecznie współpracować z różnymi interesariuszami i komunikować wyniki swoich analiz
  • jesteś osobą samodzielną, proaktywną i skoncentrowaną na ciągłym doskonaleniu procesów.

Mile widziane jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • znajomość narzędzi automatyzacyjnych (np. Power Automate),
  • doświadczenie w projektach UX/CX (badania użytkowników, testy użyteczności),
  • znajomość metod Lean, Six Sigma lub design thinking.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • analiza procesów obsługi reklamacji pod kątem efektywności, jakości oraz doświadczeń klientów,
  • mapowanie ścieżki klienta (Customer Journey) i identyfikowanie obszarów wymagających usprawnień,
  • testowanie i walidacja wdrażanych rozwiązań, w tym zmian wpływających na doświadczenie użytkownika (UX),
  • identyfikowanie możliwości automatyzacji i optymalizacji procesów oraz inicjowanie działań usprawniających,
  • współtworzenie i wdrażanie rozwiązań wspierających automatyzację obsługi reklamacji (np. workflow, RPA, narzędzia cyfrowe),
  • monitorowanie kluczowych wskaźników efektywności (KPI) oraz przygotowywanie rekomendacji usprawniających,
  • udział w projektach rozwojowych i transformacyjnych związanych z obszarem obsługi klienta,
  • współpraca z zespołami IT, operacyjnymi i biznesowymi przy wdrażaniu nowych rozwiązań i zmian procesowych.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmuje wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

Przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach:

· Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.

· Spotkaj się (online) z rekruterem i managerem.

· Wykonaj zadanie merytoryczne/test (w zależności od stanowiska).

· Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole IT!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Group Legal Director
description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you.

Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.

PURPOSE OF THE JOB


The Group Legal Director is an internationally oriented and highly experienced senior legal leader heading the Legal function and reporting directly to the Chief Legal & Corporate Affairs Officer (CLCO) who is a member of Ayvens Executive Committee. The Group Legal Director is responsible for leading and continuously developing the Group Legal Department, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, pragmatic and business-oriented legal support across the Ayvens Group.


As a trusted advisor to the CLCO, Executive Committee and senior stakeholders, the Group Legal Director contributes to the development and execution of Ayvens' strategy, safeguards legal and governance standards, oversees material legal risks and drives the (cost) efficiency and effectiveness of the Ayvens global legal function.


INTRODUCTION


Ayvens is a listed and ECB regulated subsidiary of Société Générale and a leading international mobility provider operating across multiple jurisdictions. The Group Legal Department comprises more than 20 legal professionals located in Amsterdam and Paris. The team is organised into centres of expertise supporting Group functions and local legal teams across the organisation. The global legal community of Ayvens consists of more than 100 in-house lawyers across over 40 countries, providing legal support to Ayvens' international business activities. The Heads of Legal in Ayvens’ countries report functionally to the Group Legal Director.


We are seeking an internationally oriented, highly experienced and commercially minded Group Legal Director to lead the Legal Department and contribute to the strategic leadership of the Ayvens global legal function. The Group Legal Director combines strategic judgement and strong legal expertise with proven leadership capabilities, business and digital acumen and the ability to operate effectively in a complex international and regulated environment. Experience in French corporate law and in a French listed and regulated environment would be an advantage.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Advise and support the Executive Committee, Managing Board and Supervisory Board on significant legal, governance, and regulatory matters, in close cooperation and consultation with the CLCO.
  • Lead the strategic development of the legal function through process optimisation, digitalisation, legal technology, AI solutions, data-driven management, knowledge sharing and continuous cost reduction and improvement initiatives. Oversee the identification, assessment and mitigation of material legal and regulatory risks and ensure appropriate escalation, reporting and governance within the organisation and its stakeholders.
  • Manage the affairs of the Ayvens Legal Department, provide guidance and support to team members, act as a sparring partner and foster professional development, staff engagement and a strong team spirit. title: Rehab Specialist
description:
Rehabilitation Specialist

Wokingham FWC | Fitness | Permanent | Part time

Up to £28,129.71 pro rata depending on experience

15 hours per week


At Nuffield Health the UKs largest healthcare charity, everything we give our patients, members and customers would not be possible without you. Your passion, your warmth, your drive to make a difference. Whether it’s driving connected health, helping the nation, transforming experiences, or building the career you want – we give you the support to do it all. Join our journey. It starts with you.


We are looking for a Rehabilitation Specialist to help us build a healthier nation at our club. We are looking for a Rehabilitation Specialist who will deliver Nuffield Health Rehabilitation Programmes utilising the unique Nuffield Health pathway, championing the Charitable Purpose. This role will play a crucial part in Nuffield’s long-term vision for clinical rehabilitation and will require the Rehabilitation Specialist to undertake remote (digital) and in person facilitation of exercise, emotion wellbeing support, healthy eating, and goal setting to aid the participants recovery. The pathway will involve weekly 1to1s, group exercise classes (virtual and in person), promote goal setting and self-directed activity.


You will demonstrate leadership and influencing skills, be a good communicator, organised and self-motived. As part of this role, you will work collaboratively onsite, centrally and with our Charity team and our beneficiaries. You will need excellent IT skills and hold a Level 3 Personal trainer qualification which is essential for the role. Ideally you will have previous experience working in a Rehabilitation Specialist position and an understanding of rehabilitation, along with potentially a Bsc (Hons) in Sports Rehabilitation (desired not essential).

As a Rehabilitation Specialist you will:

  • Organise and run a series of rolling 12-week rehabilitation programmes.
  • Facilitate and deliver both live stream and in person group exercise classes, with people that have varying degrees of abilities and physical function.
  • Be able to promote self-directed activity using pre-recorded on demand classes and a journal which will aid in the participants being able to self-manage their condition after the 12-week Programme.
  • Capability to re-calibrate exercises and intensities based on regular improvements demonstrated by changes in both effort and performance.
  • Identify any deterioration of participants and if necessary follow internal escalation processes, ensuring reporting is processed within a specific timeframe and that outcome data is accurately captured, which is essential in supporting our Charitable Purpose and tracking and monitoring participants progress.
  • Engage in 1to1 telephone conversations each week with every participant to offer coaching in terms of setting short term and long-term goals, understanding restrictions, monitoring progress, understanding and offering emotional wellbeing support, and empowering self-directed activity.

Skills required:

  • Problem-solving and diagnostic skills
  • Organisational ability
  • Effective decision-making skills
  • Time and resource management
  • Experience working with vulnerable adults
  • Qualifications showing good English and number skills

Helping you feel good.


We want you to love coming to work, feeling healthy, happy and valued. That’s why we’ve developed a benefits package with you in mind. Here, you can choose from a range of fitness, lifestyle, health and fitness wellbeing rewards, such as free gym membership, health assessments, retail discounts and pension options. At Nuffield Health, we take care of what’s important to you.

Join Nuffield Health and create the future you want, today.

So, it’s a good idea to apply right away to ensure you’re considered for this role.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

BASIC FUNCTION:

  • Perform everyday maintenance of the laboratory, cell culture and mice colony
  • Test and analyze human and mouse specimens

SUPERVISORY ACCOUNTABILITY:

Technician will report to Dr. Marina Jerebtsova.

All test and analysis are designed by supervisor.

NATURE AND SCOPE:

This is a one-year position that is supported by NIH SC1HL150685 grant “The role of HGFL in the sickle cell disease nephropathy”. The proposed research is aimed at understanding of the mechanism of kidney disease and developing a novel clinical test for early kidney disease detection in sickle cell disease patients.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Order laboratory supply and reagents
  • Isolate RNA and proteins from the cells and mouse organs
  • Perform RT-PCR, Western Blot, and immunostaining of paraffin-embedded tissues
  • Collect and organize results
  • Participate in the laboratory meetings
  • Participate in the preparation of IBC, IACUC and IRB protocols.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Self-motivated, cooperative, and dedicated
  • Good communication skills
  • Experience with Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Experience with animal handling, human cell cultures, immunohistochemistry, PCR and Western blot are highly preferred

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

title: Technical Director, Enterprise Architecture
description:
Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift:

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description:

The Technical Director, Enterprise Architecture is responsible for defining and governing FormFactor's enterprise technology architecture, application strategy, integration standards, and modernization roadmap. The role serves as the senior technical authority for enterprise business systems and partners with business and IT leaders to ensure technology investments align with strategic objectives, operational requirements, and long-term growth plans.

The Technical Director establishes architecture standards, guides solution design, drives technology innovation, and ensures enterprise platforms are scalable, secure, integrated, and supportable. The position is software agnostic in scope while requiring deep expertise across FormFactor's hybrid Oracle application ecosystem, including on-premises and cloud solutions. Oracle database administration is outside the scope of this role.

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Architecture Strategy & Governance

  • Define and maintain enterprise architecture principles, standards, decision frameworks, and governance processes across business applications, integrations, data platforms, cloud services, and emerging technologies.

  • Develop target-state architectures and multi-year technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy, operating priorities, and investment plans.

  • Directly manage and lead the Oracle ERP AMS team responsible for the lifecycle execution, deployment, and optimization of FormFactor's hybrid Oracle application landscape and other associated core business platforms.

  • Lead architecture review boards, release management, steering committees, and cross-functional governance forums to drive transparent decisions, executive alignment, and accountable execution.

  • Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture standards, approved project delivery methodologies, IT change governance, cybersecurity requirements, and SOX controls.

  • Identify architectural risk, technical debt, lifecycle concerns, and platform dependencies, and establish practical remediation plans.

  • Identify, architect, and lead the structural framework for deploying Enterprise GenAI applications, intelligent automation pipelines, and predictive model hosting initiatives within the corporate ERP and supply chain fabric to accelerate time-to-market.

Business Capability & Solution Architecture

  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Trade Compliance, and other business functions to translate business capabilities and process needs into sustainable technology solutions.

  • Provide technical direction for major programs and solution designs, balancing business value, user experience, scalability, security, reliability, supportability, and total cost of ownership.

  • Promote process simplification, common capabilities, reusable services, and standardized technology patterns across the enterprise.

  • Guide make, buy, modernize, integrate, and retire decisions across the enterprise application portfolio.

Oracle Enterprise Application Architecture

  • Serve as FormFactor's senior architecture authority for the Oracle enterprise application ecosystem, excluding Oracle database administration.

  • Provide architectural leadership across hybrid Oracle platforms, including Oracle E-Business Suite and related Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, Order Management, WMS, and ASCP capabilities, as well as cloud solutions such as GTM, CPQ, EPBCS, OAC, OIC, and other adopted Oracle services.

  • Define application boundaries, integration approaches, extension strategies, customization guardrails, environment patterns, and lifecycle roadmaps across Oracle platforms.

  • Evaluate Oracle product roadmaps and recommend future-state architecture strategies that support business priorities while reducing complexity, risk, and technical debt.

  • Ensure Oracle solutions integrate effectively with non-Oracle platforms such as MES, PLM, Workday, ServiceNow, Microsoft technologies, analytics platforms, and other enterprise systems.

Integration Architecture & Technology Standards

  • Define enterprise integration strategy and common standards for APIs, middleware, event-driven services, EDI, batch interfaces, file exchange, and data movement.

  • Guide architecture teams in designing system integrations and ensuring solutions follow company technology standards and proven practices.

  • Promote reusable integration services, consistent monitoring, secure data exchange, error handling, and end-to-end operational supportability.

  • Ensure integrations support reliable business processing across ERP, manufacturing, supply chain, planning, analytics, and corporate platforms.

Application Portfolio, Modernization & Cloud Strategy

  • Establish lifecycle strategies for enterprise applications and identify opportunities for rationalization, consolidation, modernization, and retirement.

  • Lead hybrid-cloud and SaaS architecture planning, including migration sequencing, interoperability, security, operating-model impacts, and business continuity.

  • Evaluate new platforms and technology investments using business fit, architectural alignment, implementation risk, vendor viability, and total cost of ownership.

  • Drive modernization strategies that improve agility, resiliency, usability, supportability, and speed of business change.

AI, Automation & Process Innovation

  • Identify and lead opportunities to use AI, intelligent automation, predictive capabilities, and digital workflows to improve decision-making, process effectiveness, and employee productivity.

  • Establish architecture standards and governance for responsible integration of AI-enabled capabilities into enterprise applications and business processes.

  • Partner with business and technology teams to prioritize use cases, validate business value, and develop scalable implementation roadmaps.

  • Promote automation and architecture reuse that reduce manual work, improve control effectiveness, and accelerate delivery.

Data & Analytics Enablement

  • Partner with data and analytics leaders to ensure enterprise architecture supports trusted, secure, accessible, and well-integrated information across platforms.

  • Enable advanced analytics and AI by supporting consistent data flows, traceability, governed access, and clear ownership of enterprise information.

  • Ensure application and integration designs support enterprise reporting, planning, operational analytics, and future data-driven capabilities.

Leadership, Stakeholder & Partner Management

  • Lead and develop enterprise, solution, application, and integration architects, establishing clear accountabilities and consistent architecture practices.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executives and business partners on technology strategy, architecture decisions, investment priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.

  • Provide architecture oversight for strategic vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including review of designs, deliverables, and roadmap alignment.

  • Build effective partnerships across Applications, Data, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, PMO, Internal Audit, and business functions.

  • Oversee critical lifecycle infrastructure initiatives, ensuring seamless alignment and coordination with the DBA team for core system patching and upgrades.

Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:

  • Progressive experience in enterprise applications, solution architecture, enterprise architecture, systems integration, or technology leadership.

  • Experience leading architects, technical leaders, or enterprise technology teams in a complex global environment.

  • Experience leading global enterprise application delivery teams, solution architects, and functional leads in a matrixed corporate framework

  • Proven experience establishing enterprise architecture standards, governance processes, technology roadmaps, and target-state architectures.

  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale application modernization, integration, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives.

  • Experience architecting solutions across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, Trade Compliance, Analytics, and other core enterprise functions.

  • Strong experience with enterprise integrations, middleware, APIs, data movement, SaaS platforms, and hybrid-cloud architectures.

  • Experience operating within SOX-controlled environments and partnering with Cybersecurity, Risk, Internal Audit, and PMO organizations.

  • Experience in semiconductor, high-tech manufacturing, or another complex global manufacturing environment is strongly preferred.

  • Extensive hands-on architecture experience across Oracle enterprise applications in complex, integrated production environments.

  • Deep knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite, including Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, Order Management, WMS, ASCP, and related application architecture.

  • Significant experience with Oracle cloud applications and services such as GTM, CPQ, EPBCS, OAC, OIC, or comparable Oracle SaaS and PaaS capabilities.

  • Proven ability to develop roadmaps for hybrid Oracle environments spanning on-premises and cloud platforms.

  • Strong understanding of Oracle application integrations, extensions, configurations, customizations, reporting, security dependencies, and modernization options.

  • Experience evaluating Oracle product direction and translating vendor roadmaps into practical enterprise architecture recommendations.

  • Enterprise architecture strategy, business capability alignment, solution governance, and application portfolio management.

  • Architecture leadership across ERP, manufacturing, supply chain, planning, analytics, SaaS, cloud, and integration platforms.

  • Executive communication, structured decision-making, stakeholder alignment, influence, and negotiation.

  • Ability to simplify complex technical issues and communicate risks, options, and recommendations to technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Strong financial judgment related to technology investments, licensing, vendor proposals, implementation cost, and total cost of ownership.

  • Ability to lead through influence across global, cross-functional teams and external partners.

  • Proven track record in orchestrating cross-functional DBA operations and managing the end-to-end execution of complex patch setups and environment stability.

Measures of Success:

  • Clear, actionable enterprise architecture roadmap aligned with business priorities and investment planning.

  • Improved architecture consistency, solution quality, integration reliability, and compliance with governance standards.

  • Measurable reduction in technical debt, redundant capabilities, unsupported technologies, and unnecessary customization.

  • Successful modernization of FormFactor's hybrid Oracle and broader enterprise application landscape.

  • Increased reuse, automation, AI enablement, process efficiency, and speed of delivery.

  • Strong business stakeholder confidence in architecture decisions, roadmaps, and technology outcomes.

Skills:

Artificial Intelligence (AI), Enterprise Application Architecture, Enterprise Application Integration (EAI), Enterprise Business Architecture, Enterprise System Architecture, IT Change Management, Oracle Database Administration (DBA)

Education & Experience:

Minimum of 15 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 12 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 8 years experience; or equivalent experience | Required

$183,400.00 - $240,765.00

We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. Join us to help scale innovation globally and shape what’s next in crop science.

As a Production Technician for Vylor, you will play a vital hands‑on role in our seed production operations, ensuring work is completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. title: Level 1 Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst

Location or Darlington, with hybrid working arrangements.

About the role

At Railpen, we are committed to helping secure our members’ future through responsible investment and continuous improvement. As a Business Analyst (Level 1), you’ll help turn business needs into clear requirements and practical improvements across our Change & Transformation (C&T) portfolio, helping to ensure that business needs are clearly understood, documented and delivered.

Working alongside experienced Business Analysts, Project Managers, stakeholders and technical teams, you’ll support analysis activities across projects and smaller change initiatives. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop core Business Analysis capability through hands-on experience, coaching and participation in the wider Business Analysis community. As your capability and confidence develop, you may also take ownership of discrete analysis activities on lower-complexity work, with appropriate support and oversight.

To learn more about Railpen including our values, culture and purpose, visit our careers page here.

What you’ll be doing

  • Supporting the gathering, analysis and documentation of business requirements, helping teams develop a clear understanding of business needs.
  • Mapping processes, capturing data and analysing information to identify issues, opportunities and practical improvements.
  • Producing and maintaining high-quality project documentation, including meeting notes, action logs, requirements documentation and process maps.
  • Coordinating stakeholder input, workshops and follow-up actions to support effective business analysis delivery.
  • Supporting the definition, review and sign-off of business requirements in line with agreed governance standards and project timelines.
  • Assisting with testing preparation activities, including drafting test scenarios, coordinating business users and supporting evidence gathering.
  • Communicating progress updates, decisions and next steps to stakeholders and business users.
  • Taking ownership of discrete analysis activities on lower-complexity work as your capability develops, with appropriate support and oversight.
  • Building your Business Analysis capability through coaching, feedback, hands-on experience and active participation in the wider BA community.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for a curious, motivated and detail-oriented individual who wants to develop a career in Business Analysis. You’ll be organised and analytical, able to communicate clearly and comfortable working collaboratively with business and technical colleagues. You’ll approach problems in a structured and evidence-based way, ask thoughtful questions and take ownership of agreed actions. A willingness to learn, seek feedback and develop greater confidence and independence will be central to success in the role.

Essential

  • Strong organisational and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Some experience of, or exposure to, requirements gathering, process mapping, data analysis or related problem-solving activities. This could have been gained through employment, project work, education or another relevant setting.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver quality outputs within agreed timescales.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with both business and technical audiences.
  • Good stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
  • A structured, logical and evidence-based approach to problem solving.
  • Curiosity about how things work, with the confidence to ask questions and constructively challenge existing ways of working.

Desirable

  • An awareness of Business Analysis tools, techniques or methodologies, or a willingness to develop this knowledge.
  • Exposure to testing, business readiness or change delivery activities.
  • An interest in investment, pensions or financial services.

Why is this role exciting now?

This is an opportunity to build a Business Analysis career in a supportive C&T environment. You’ll gain exposure to different areas of the organisation, learn from experienced colleagues and see how effective analysis helps turn business needs into practical change. As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to take greater ownership of analysis activities and develop your professional capability through our wider BA community.

What you’ll get in return

  • A competitive salary (depending on experience) plus generous annual bonus plan
  • 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • We provide membership of the Railways Pension Scheme, a Defined Benefit arrangement under which you get a pension for life and a lump sum when you retire, based on your length of service and pay
  • 4x Life Assurance cover
  • We support hybrid and flexible working along with very generous family leave including 12 months full pay maternity leave and 6 months full pay paternity leave
  • Take a look at the full range of benefits available to support you, click here

Next steps

If you’re excited by the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution and grow your career with us, we encourage you to apply by 8th October 2026.

Inclusion at Railpen

At Railpen, diversity, equity and inclusion are core to who we are. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported and able to thrive. Our mission to secure a better future for our members is strengthened by the different perspectives and experiences our people bring.

We are transparent about our gender pay gap and are actively committed to addressing it through fair and inclusive recruitment, progression and reward practices.

We respect and support individuals’ pronouns and encourage colleagues to share them if they feel comfortable to do so.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, neurodiversity, or any other protected characteristic. If you need adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.

title: Product Leader, Product management
description:
As a product leader, your role is to design, implement and manage a line of high-performing products that meet the needs of members and clients. You are responsible for developing, pricing, improving, implementing and promoting the products offered, based on the needs of members, clients and the distribution networks, and in line with market trends and Desjardins Group’s target position. You lead and influence specialists and different stakeholders with respect to development projects and complex strategic initiatives of a cross-sector and highly innovative nature, in relation to the product line. You make recommendations on the development and execution of strategic initiatives with a very high degree of operational and conceptual complexity. You develop and recommend business directions and positions for the products you are responsible for. title: Associate Healthcare Director
description:

Job Description

The Associate Healthcare Director (AHCD) is responsible for assisting the community’s Healthcare Director (HCD) in leading the health and wellness activities for the community’s resident population and assuring that the resident care department operates efficiently and effectively. The AHCD will assist in leading the team of medication technicians and nursing assistants in the provision of quality care and services while maintaining compliance with all applicable local, State, and Federal Regulations and Harmony Senior Services policies and standards

  • Evaluates residents prior to move-in to determine whether their care and service needs can be met in the community.

  • Collaborates with each resident’s physician, pharmacist, third party healthcare providers, and other members of the healthcare team to promote coordinated care and services.
  • Participates in the oversight of the community’s medication management program.
  • Collaborates with the pharmacy, conducts med tech training and skill validation, performs routine audits and other activities that promote safety in medication administration.
    Maintains a working knowledge of all applicable local, State, and Federal regulations.
  • Assures that resident evaluations and documentation meet all requirements and collaborates with the HCD to assure that the resident care department is survey ready at all times.
  • Participates in the development of, and compliance with, plans of correction as applicable.
  • Assures that infection control standards are maintained to prevent or limit the spread of communicable infectious illness.
  • Provides training and skill validation for med techs, personal care aides and others to promote safe resident care.
  • Participates in the hiring process as needed by conducting interviews and providing onboarding training and coaching to new resident care team members.
  • Participates in community and resident care meetings as needed when the HCD is unavailable.
  • Provides leadership that promotes a culture of collaboration and teamwork.
  • Establishes and maintains a collaborative and positive working relationship with all community team members.
  • Communicates compassionately and regularly with residents’ families. Promptly responds to questions or concerns and participates in effective problem-solving.
  • Completes all State and Harmony initial, annual and other required training.
  • Partners with the Harmony Square Director and Healthcare Director on managing Behavior Expressions and the overall wellness needs of the Harmony Square residents.
  • Carries out other duties as assigned.

    Qualifications/Skills/Educational Requirements:
  • Level of formal Education: Current valid and unencumbered license to practice as an RN or LPN in the State in which the community is located.
  • Areas of Study: Nursing. Experience in caring for geriatric individuals and those with Alzheimer’s and other forms of dementia strongly preferred.
  • Years and type of Experience: 1-2 years’ experience required; 3 or more years' experience preferred.
  • Special Certificates: Current CPR certification required.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule including day, evening and night shift and weekends.
  • Ability to be on-call after hours.
  • Ability to act as the Manager-on-Duty on selected weekends.

title: Vice President, Communications
description:
Richemont, one of the world leaders in the luxury sector, has various Houses specializing in jewelry, watches and high-end accessories. Each Maison proudly embodies a tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont strives to preserve the heritage and identity specific to each of them. At the same time, we are committed to innovating and designing new products in line with the values ​​of our Houses, through a process of permanent creativity.

Overview:
The Vice President of Communications will report to the Chief Marketing Officer, and will serve as the senior strategic leader responsible for shaping and driving the integrated communications strategy across Cartier North America. In close partnership with the Chief Marketing Officer, the VP will help define the long-term vision for how the Maison appears across North America through media, direct-to-consumer communications, public relations, and celebrity and talent partnerships.

This role is accountable for translating global brand priorities into client-focused communications strategy that strengthens brand desirability, client engagement, and overall business impact. The VP will set clear priorities, guide investment decisions, and ensure all communications channels work together to deliver one elevated and consistent brand voice.

The VP will lead and influence across functional teams, agency partners, HQ stakeholders, and senior business leaders. They will operate at both a strategic and executive level, while remaining close to their direct teams to ensure excellence in execution, judgment, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities:


Communications Strategy:

  • Define and lead the annual short- and long-term communications strategy for North America, ensuring alignment with global and local brand positioning, business priorities, and client strategy.
  • Integrate media, direct-to-consumer communications, public relations, celebrity and talent engagement, and cultural moments into one cohesive strategic roadmap.
  • Identify key brand-building opportunities across consumer touchpoints, ensuring consistency and elevated storytelling.
  • Foster relationships across pillars & create a hub of communications excellence to translate business objectives into actionable strategies
  • Demonstrate inspirational leadership to produce an influential Maison vision to external stakeholders & audiences

Media & Direct-to-Consumer Communications:

  • Demonstrate expertise to be recognized as an influential leader at all levels to orchestrate and advance initiatives to support Business KPIs
  • Leverages various data ecosystems to create and guide business decisions
  • Lead the media strategy across paid, owned, and emerging channels to drive brand awareness, desirability, and client engagement.
  • Oversee the direct-to-consumer communications strategy, ensuring messaging is compelling, and aligned to broader Maison and Marketing priorities.
  • Drive full-funnel storytelling strategies that connect product, brand campaigns, cultural moments, retail priorities, and client experiences.
  • Partner closely with Brand Strategy & Planning, Commercial, Brand Image, Client and Marketing teams to ensure communications support the full brand and client journey.

Public Relations:

  • Partner with Director of Public Relations to develop the press strategy for North America, strengthening relationships with top-tier media, editors, journalists, stylists, and industry voices.
  • Guide proactive press storytelling across brand campaigns, product launches, high jewelry, retail openings, arts and culture initiatives and other key market moments.
  • Ensure all press engagement reinforces the Maison’s positioning, enhances reputation, and delivers meaningful visibility in priority media channels.
  • Create authentic relationships with tastemakers to drive strategic communications aligned with the Maison’s values.

Celebrity & Entertainment:

  • Partner with AVP of Celebrity and Entertainment to develop and lead the celebrity, talent, and entertainment engagement strategy for North America, ensuring partnerships strengthen brand desirability.
  • Oversee talent engagement for editorial and campaign shoots, red carpet moments, award shows, brand events, client experiences, and cultural partnerships.
  • Ensure we continue to build and maintain senior relationships with talent, publicists, agents, stylists, managers, studios, networks, and other key entertainment industry partners.
  • Identify and secure strategic talent opportunities that create meaningful brand visibility, press impact and social amplification.
  • Partner with Central teams to ensure celebrity and talent activations are aligned, brand-appropriate, and executed with excellence.

Leadership:

  • Lead, develop, and empower a high-performing communications organization across media, public relations, and celebrity engagement.
  • Demonstrate and create a strong culture of accountability through the coaching and development of the team
  • Foster strong collaboration across Central/global teams, local markets, commercial leadership, retail, merchandising, client development, HR, legal, and other key partners.
  • Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks to evaluate communications performance, media impact, talent engagement, consumer reach, brand desirability, and business contribution.
  • Translate insights into executive-level recommendations, strategic briefs, and actionable plans for senior leadership.
  • Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of campaigns, partnerships, and press moments to optimize future strategy and investment.

Agency Management (or external partnership):

  • Assess team capabilities, agency partnerships, and ways of working to ensure the function is organized to meet evolving business and brand needs.
  • Manage agency partners with clear expectations, strategic direction, accountability, and performance measurement.

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in communications strategy, media, public relations, integrated marketing, celebrity/talent relations, or related fields, with significant senior leadership experience.
  • Deep understanding of the luxury environment, the client journey and historic brand management.
  • Proven ability to set strategy at enterprise, regional, or market level and translate global brand priorities into locally relevant execution.
  • Executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Strong people leadership skills with experience building, developing, and evolving high-performing teams.
  • Highly strategic, culturally fluent, commercially aware, and comfortable navigating ambiguity while driving clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to effectively manage Communications budgets with focus on ROI.

Salary Range: $250,000-$290,000

  • Monitor progress to plan and design a recovery strategy if project deviates from delivery schedules

  • Conduct retrospectives on completed projects to support process, policy and tool-set improvements

  • Ability to communicate effectively across written, verbal and presentation formats to a variety of audiences from engineer to Executive
  • Ability to develop a project schedule using work-breakdown techniques that lead to a defined critical path
  • Ability to design and document a project charter that includes scope, schedule, budget and risk management plan
  • Able to apply critical thinking techniques to analyze problems, develop solutions, build resource forecasts or manage risk
  • Ability to use either Waterfall or Agile methodologies to handle projects which may comprise both software and hardware
  • Ability to lead the gathering of product requirements and project scope across a multi-function team
  • Ability to lead through influence to drive forward both the team and program
  • Ability to manage and facilitate team meetings and initiatives to effectively develop plans and achieve goals
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills and experience establishing guidelines in these areas for others
  • Strong working knowledge of technology companies or domains and the interplay between Marketing, Product Development, Manufacturing, Customer Support, Sales and Professional Services
  • Expertise in the use of standard tools for project and portfolio management such as MS Project/MS Project Server
  • Desired experience with Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence)
  • Expert skills using MS Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Word
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

Qualifications

  • Successfully completed a Summer 2026 internship with F5
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or a related technical field graduating between December 2026 and September 2027
  • Must be able to start no later than September 30th, 2027
  • Must be able to work onsite in accordance with F5s policies; fully remote work options are not available
  • Demonstrated understanding of Project Management processes, strategies and methods
  • Experience managing a geo-dispersed project team
  • Experience working in a concurrent software development environment as part of a complex build and merge management process

Preferences

  • Desired PMP certification with accompanying experience managing projects to a successful conclusion
  • Desired Agile ScrumMaster certifications (CSM, A-CSM, CSP-SM)
