description:
About the Company
Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in 2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

The Role + Purpose:

The Senior Merchant, Denim Pants is a key role on the Madewell women’s merchandising team, responsible for owning the end-to-end product strategy for our most important category. This role blends creative vision with analytical rigor, partnering closely with Design, Planning, Marketing, and Visual to bring compelling assortments to life that resonate with the Madewell customer. In Season

  • Analyze the competitive environment and use that knowledge to positively impact results, making recommendations to leadership.

description:
Job Title:

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Location: Bellevue, WA. This is Hybrid role.

Technical Product Manager (TPM)

As a Technical Product Manager, you will define why a product exists, where it is going, and how it delivers measurable value. You will own product direction across assigned platforms and initiatives, align stakeholders across the enterprise, and guide roadmap decisions that balance innovation, compliance, risk reduction, platform health, and business outcomes. This role is ideal for a technically fluent product leader who can translate ambiguity into clear direction and bring teams together to deliver with confidence.

Responsibilities


  • Define and maintain the long-term product vision and strategic roadmap at the group, solution, or platform level.
  • Establish success metrics, outcome targets, and value measures that connect platform capabilities to business priorities, compliance needs, and risk reduction.
  • Balance roadmap delivery with platform health needs, including defects, patches, improvements, and technical sustainability.
  • Keep roadmaps current, transparent, and effectively socialized with business, technology, and risk stakeholders.
  • Identify the highest-value problems to solve and clearly articulate why they matter now.
  • Drive prioritization across initiatives and quarters, making informed go/no-go investment decisions.
  • Ensure initiative sequencing aligns with enterprise strategy and avoids duplicate builds across programs.
  • Maintain deep working knowledge of assigned platforms and verticals, including interfaces, capabilities, functions, integrations, and dependencies.
  • Serve as the technical and solution point of contact for your product area.
  • Own capability- and feature-level design, including the creation and upkeep of detailed design documentation that reflects key solution decisions.
  • Partner with QA and Solution Architecture to identify, validate, and support key test cases.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of assigned initiatives, from planning through launch and post-launch outcome tracking.
  • Support test and launch phases directly, including defect triage with QA and release bridge participation with Release Management.
  • Maintain Jira hygiene across assigned work, including SOX and audit compliance expectations.
  • Anticipate risks, blockers, and dependencies; escalate early and clearly when support is needed.
  • Maintain backup coverage plans to ensure business continuity when out of office.

Lead quarterly planning activities based on scope:

Group level: Partner with business stakeholders to prepare Initiative Requirements Documents, initiative phasing, Jira capabilities, and balanced quarterly goals.

Solution level: Validate platform impacts, coordinate with impacted teams, and ensure cross-domain considerations are detailed before planning.

Platform level: Assess platform-impacting initiatives, identify synergies or conflicts, promote reuse, and determine feasibility within quarterly capacity.

  • Align across Legal, Privacy, Security, Architecture, business, QA, engineering, and other key stakeholder groups.
  • Translate regulatory and business requirements into clear, actionable product direction.
  • Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs with honesty, clarity, and confidence.
  • Partner closely with Technical Product Owners and Team Coaches while maintaining clear ownership boundaries: the TPM determines whether the product should be built and whether it achieved its outcomes; the TPO determines whether it is ready to build and safe to ship.
  • Demonstrate innovation, accountability, ownership, proactivity, collaboration, transparency, and continuous growth in day-to-day work.

Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, solution architecture, or a comparable technical delivery role.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a product or platform roadmap, including prioritization tradeoffs and measurable outcome delivery.
  • Strong technical fluency, including the ability to read design documentation, reason through integrations and APIs, ask strong engineering questions, and serve as a credible technical point of contact.
  • Hands-on experience in Agile environments using Jira, including backlog structure, quarterly or PI planning, and audit-grade hygiene.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, including engineering, QA, architecture, business, legal, privacy, security, and risk partners.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous business needs into defensible product direction.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in telecommunications or another large-scale regulated enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with SOX, PCI, privacy, or other compliance frameworks and how they influence product decisions.
  • Experience with platform-level capacity planning and multi-program dependency management.
  • Prior hands-on experience in engineering, data, architecture, or technical delivery.

The base salary for this position is $95,000 – $145,000 plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

title: Security Engineer - Email Security
description:
At Zelis, we Get Stuff Done. So, let’s get to it!

A Little About Us

Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.

At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.

A Little About You

You bring a unique blend of personality and professional expertise to your work, inspiring others with your passion and dedication. Your career is a testament to your diverse experiences, community involvement, and the valuable lessons you've learned along the way. You are more than just your resume; you are a reflection of your achievements, the knowledge you've gained, and the personal interests that shape who you are.

Position Overview

Zelis is seeking a Security Engineer - Email Security to support and enhance the security, reliability, and protection of our enterprise email environment. This role will focus on identifying and preventing email-based threats, administering email security controls, troubleshooting mail-flow and security issues, and supporting Microsoft 365/Exchange Online environments.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Microsoft Exchange, email security technologies, phishing investigations, mail-flow analysis, and security incident response. This individual will work closely with Security Operations, Messaging/Infrastructure, Identity, and other technology teams to protect the organization from phishing, business email compromise (BEC), malware, spoofing, and other email-based threats.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed analysis of suspicious messages, including email headers, message routing, URLs, attachments, sender reputation, authentication results, and other indicators of compromise.
  • Administer and support email security controls within Exchange Online, Defender for O365, EasyDMARC, and Abnormal Security environments.
  • Troubleshoot email delivery, mail-flow, quarantine, filtering, and security-policy issues.
  • Review and analyze Exchange message traces and mail-flow logs to determine message disposition and identify security or delivery issues.
  • Configure and maintain mail-flow rules, anti-spam policies, anti-phishing protections, allow/block lists, quarantine policies, and related email security controls.
  • Support incident containment and remediation activities, including message removal, sender/domain blocking, URL blocking, mailbox remediation, and escalation of compromised accounts.
  • Assist with administration and tuning of Microsoft Defender for Office 365 or comparable secure email gateway/email security technologies.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot email authentication technologies including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
  • Identify false positives and false negatives and recommend improvements to email security policies and detection rules.
  • Document investigations, findings, remediation actions, and recurring email security issues.
  • Create and maintain operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-base documentation.
  • Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, Identity and Access Management, Infrastructure, and Messaging teams during security investigations.
  • Assist with email security metrics, reporting, trend analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Stay current on emerging phishing techniques, business email compromise tactics, attacker infrastructure, and email security best practices.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of proven experience designing and implementing enterprise-grade email security guardrails in regulated fintech or healthcare environments with a strong security-first mindset and expertise in phishing and BEC prevention, email authentication, data loss prevention, policy enforcement, monitoring, and incident response.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Exchange, Exchange Online, or Microsoft 365 messaging environments.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange mail flow, connectors, transport/mail-flow rules, message tracking, and message tracing.
  • Experience investigating phishing, spam, malware, spoofing, and business email compromise incidents.
  • Strong understanding of email protocols and technologies, including SMTP, DNS, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
  • Experience analyzing email headers and determining message origin, routing, authentication results, and potential indicators of malicious activity.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Exchange Online Protection (EOP), or similar enterprise email security platforms.
  • Understanding common attacker techniques involving credential phishing, malicious attachments, malicious URLs, impersonation, and account compromise.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to independently investigate moderately complex incidents and appropriately escalate high-risk or advanced threats.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Office 365, including Safe Links, Safe Attachments, Threat Explorer, automated investigation and response, and related capabilities.
  • Experience using Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Sentinel, or the Microsoft Defender security ecosystem.
  • Experience with PowerShell for Exchange Online administration, investigation, or automation.
  • Familiarity with other Microsoft tools; Defender for Endpoint, Purview, etc. Support administration, monitoring, and policy tuning of EDR/XDR platforms.
  • Experience investigating compromised Microsoft 365 accounts and malicious inbox or forwarding rules.
  • Knowledge of email security gateways or platforms such as Proofpoint, Mimecast, Cisco Secure Email, Abnormal Security, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence concepts, indicators of compromise (IOCs), and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Knowledge of AI/ML security concepts and emerging threats, data leakage, model abuse, identity and access controls, secure integrations, and protection of sensitive data within AI-enabled systems.

Core Competencies

  • Email Security & Threat Analysis
  • Microsoft Exchange / Exchange Online
  • Microsoft 365 Security
  • Microsoft Defender for Office 365
  • Email Header & Mail-Flow Analysis
  • SPF, DKIM & DMARC
  • Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
  • PowerShell / Security Automation
  • Technical Documentation
  • Cross-functional Collaboration

Please note at this time we are unable to proceed with candidates who require visa sponsorship now or in the future.


Location and Workplace Flexibility

Zelis is headquartered in the U.S., with multiple locations across the country and in Hyderabad, India. Check out our locations to learn more about our offices. All employee work locations are based on the needs of the position and are determined by the Leadership team. In-office work and activities vary based on work and team objectives in accordance with Company policies.


While location expectations vary by role, candidates within approximately 50 miles of a U.S. office are generally preferred to support collaboration when needed. Our hybrid approach is flexible, and in-office presence is guided by team and business needs rather than a fixed weekly schedule.

Base Salary Range

$135,200.00 - $185,900.00

At Zelis we are committed to providing fair and equitable compensation packages. The base salary range allows us to make an offer that considers multiple individualized factors, including experience, education, qualifications, as well as job-related and industry-related knowledge and skills, etc. Base pay is just one part of our Total Rewards package, which may also include discretionary bonus plans, commissions, or other incentives depending on the role.

Zelis’ full-time associates are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well-being, and financial protection. The US-based benefits include a 401k plan with employer match, flexible paid time off, holidays, parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the role. We believe in the value of diverse perspectives and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive workplace for all.

Accessibility Support
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require a reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email TalentAcquisition@zelis.com.

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities, duties, and skills from time to time.

title: Program Manager
description:
The program manager for financial grants administration is responsible for the comprehensive administration, coordination, and financial oversight of externally and internally funded grants and sponsored programs in the school of medicine. The Program Manager supports faculty, principal investigators (PIs), program directors, and institutional leadership throughout the grant lifecycle, including proposal development, budget preparation, award setup, financial monitoring, compliance, reporting, and closeout.

The position serves as a key liaison among principal investigators, academic and clinical departments, Finance, Research Administration, Sponsored Programs, Human Resources, Procurement, and external funding agencies. The Program Manager ensures that grant activities are conducted in accordance with sponsor requirements, institutional policies, approved budgets, and applicable federal regulations.

Essential Functions (Principal Duties and Job Responsibilities):

  • Manage a portfolio of federal, state, foundation, corporate, and other sponsored awards from pre-award through closeout.
  • Coordinate administrative activities associated with grant-funded programs and projects.
  • Maintain detailed grant calendars, deliverables, reporting schedules, milestones, and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as the primary administrative resource for faculty, principal investigators, program directors, and departmental leadership regarding grant management.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple departments and institutional units to support successful program implementation.
  • Monitor program performance and assist leadership in identifying operational or financial risks that could affect grant objectives.
  • Assist faculty and program leadership with identifying and reviewing funding opportunities.
  • Review funding announcements and summarize sponsor requirements, deadlines, eligibility criteria, and submission requirements.
  • Coordinate development and submission of grant applications.
  • Develop and review grant budgets, budget justifications, staffing plans, and supporting documentation.
  • Verify appropriate application of salary, fringe benefits, indirect costs, participant support, subawards, consultants, equipment, travel, and other expenses.
  • Coordinate institutional approvals and ensure applications are submitted by required deadlines.
  • Establish systems to monitor grant expenditures against approved budgets.
  • Prepare monthly financial reports, budget-to-actual analyses, projections, and spending forecasts.
  • Review grant expenses for allowability, allocability, reasonableness, and consistency with approved award terms.
  • Monitor personnel expenses, salary allocations, effort commitments, purchasing, travel, consultants, subawards, and other grant expenditures.
  • Identify budget variances, potential deficits, unspent balances, and financial risks and recommend corrective actions.
  • Coordinate budget revisions, rebudgeting requests, carryforward requests, and no-cost extensions.
  • Work closely with Finance to reconcile grant accounts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Assist PIs and leadership with developing financial strategies to ensure funds are appropriately utilized during the award period.
  • Monitor grant end dates and proactively develop closeout plans to minimize unallowable expenses and excessive unspent balances.
  • Assist with preparation of costing allocations and payroll accounting adjustments in workday
  • Ensure grant activities comply with institutional policies, sponsor requirements, and applicable federal regulations.
  • Support compliance with Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200) and other applicable requirements.
  • Monitor effort commitments and assist with effort certification processes.
  • Coordinate with appropriate offices regarding IRB, IACUC, conflict-of-interest, research compliance, and other regulatory requirements when applicable.
  • Maintain documentation necessary to support internal reviews, external audits, and sponsor monitoring.
  • Assist with development and implementation of corrective action plans when compliance concerns are identified.
  • Maintain accurate records for all assigned grants, including award documents, budgets, amendments, contracts, reports, and correspondence.
  • Develop grant dashboards and tracking tools to monitor financial performance, deadlines, deliverables, and key performance indicators.
  • Prepare routine and ad hoc reports for PIs, department chairs, deans, executive leadership, and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinate financial and programmatic reporting requirements with appropriate institutional offices.
  • Monitor reporting deadlines and ensure required reports are submitted accurately and timely.
  • Maintain grant files in accordance with institutional record-retention requirements.
  • Other duties as assigned

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Preferred:

  • Demonstrated effectiveness to advancing a culture and climate of diversity, equity, belonging and anti-oppression.
  • Demonstrated effectiveness as a leader of faculty and staff.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Ability to write policies and procedures.
  • This position will require strong leadership and organizational skills, as well as a deep understanding of academic policies and procedures.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, finance, accounting, public administration, healthcare administration, research administration, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of progressively responsible experience in grants administration, research administration, financial management, program management, or a related area.
  • Demonstrated experience with budget development, financial monitoring, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of grant administration principles and sponsored-project management.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other financial or administrative systems.
  • Experience analyzing data
  • Experience managing federally funded grants (HRSA, NIH, Department of Education, CDC, etc.).
  • Experience in higher education, healthcare, workforce development, or student success programs.

Education and Experience Preferred:

  • Master’s degree in Higher Education, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Education, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Five or more years of grants management experience within higher education, an academic medical center, medical school, healthcare organization, or research institution. Knowledge of health professions education and workforce diversity initiatives.
  • Experience managing federal awards from agencies such as NIH, HRSA, CDC, Department of Education, or other federal sponsors.
  • Experience with institutional financial, research administration, or grant management systems.
  • Experience with grant writing and grant reporting.

Licensure, Certification or Registration Preferred:

  • Certified Research Administrator (CRA), Certified Financial Research Administrator (CFRA), or other relevant professional certification preferred.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Meharry Medical College complies with Title IX and is an affirmative action employer. Candidates will be considered for employment without discrimination for an non-merit reason such as race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, handicap or veteran status.

description:
Beyond Blue

Security Officer

2

Regular

Full time

Flex (United States of America)

Job Description:

Security Officers maintain a safe and secure environment at our HealthCare facilities by protecting patients, visitors, staff, and property. They patrol buildings and grounds, monitor security systems, and maintain a visible presence to deter unsafe or suspicious activity. Security Officers respond to emergency alarms, assistance calls, and sensitive situations, working collaboratively with Communications, other security personnel, and the University Police Department. They assist with disorderly or combative individuals, provide crisis intervention, and conflict resolution, and help de-escalate potentially volatile situations. Additional responsibilities include completing security reports, conducting basic investigative reviews, enforcing facility policies, monitoring access control and surveillance systems, and assisting patients, visitors, and staff to support a safe healthcare environment.

Essential Functions

• Patrols assigned areas, maintaining a visible security presence to deter crime and provide assistance as needed.

• Monitors security equipment and systems, including CCTV, access control, alarm systems, and radio communications, to maintain situational awareness and respond appropriately to incidents.

• Conducts routine inspections of facilities and security systems to identify and report irregularities such as fire hazards, unsecured doors, equipment malfunctions, or safety concerns.

• Controls access to facilities by permitting authorized individuals’ entry, restricting unauthorized access, issuing passes, and monitoring visitor activity after hours.

• Responds to suspicious activity, emergency alarms, and calls for service, taking appropriate action, including notifying police, fire departments, or other emergency responders when necessary.

• Investigates incidents, unusual circumstances, and reports from staff, visitors, medical staff, and patients; conducts basic investigative reviews and prioritizes information for reporting purposes.

• Assists medical personnel and staff in managing disruptive or combative individuals and provides crisis intervention, conflict resolution, and de-escalation when appropriate.

• Warns violators of policy or rule infractions and takes appropriate action to prevent losses, damage, or unsafe conditions.

• Maintains accurate documentation, including Daily Activity Reports, incident reports, lost and found logs, and other required departmental records in accordance with departmental procedures and General Orders.

• Provides customer service by interacting with students, faculty, staff, patients, visitors, and vendors; offering information, safety guidance, escorts, and assistance as needed while maintaining professionalism and sensitivity in difficult situations.

• Assists the University police department during special events and as requested.

• Attends required training sessions and completes assigned training to remain compliant with departmental policies and procedures.

• Maintains a professional appearance and demeanor while representing the department and the University.

• Performs administrative tasks and other duties as assigned.

Education Requirement

Minimal education and/or equivalent experience needed

Vocational training may be needed based on the given area

Experience Requirement

An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

All experience must be paid and in the same related field.

Part-time and PRN experience will be prorated based on hours worked per week.

Volunteer work and internships for academic credit are not counted.

Certifications & Licensures

N/A

Working Conditions

A. Standing or walking for extended periods of time while performing patrol and monitoring duties: 4. Regular (> 50% of the time)

B. Handling objects weighing up to 10 pounds: 4. Regular (> 50% of the time)

C. Interacting with staff, patients, visitors, and vendors while maintaining situational awareness: 4. Regular (> 50% of the time)

D. Lifting, pushing, or pulling objects weighing up to 50 pounds: 3. Intermittent (10% - 50% of the time)

E. Carrying or moving objects weighing up to 25 pounds: 3. Intermittent (10% - 50% of the time)

F. Exposure to temperature extremes while working indoors and outdoors: 3. Intermittent (10% - 50% of the time)

G. Operating security equipment and tools that may present a risk of minor injury: 3. Intermittent (10% - 50% of the time)

H. Responding to stressful or emergency situations requiring calm decision-making: 3. Intermittent (10% - 50% of the time)

I. Interaction with individuals who may be disruptive, combative, or in mental crisis: 3. Intermittent (10% - 50% of the time)

J. Sitting at a computer workstation for extended periods of time while completing reports or administrative tasks: 2. Occasional (< 10% of the time)

K. Performing repetitive motions while operating equipment or completing documentation: 2. Occasional (< 10% of the time)

L. Assisting with moving or positioning patients, equipment, or materials, which may pose a risk of back injury: 2. Occasional (< 10% of the time)

M. Exposure to hazardous materials, including chemicals, waste, cuts/punctures, and bloodborne or airborne pathogens: 2. Occasional (< 10% of the time)

Physical Demands

This position requires regular standing or walking with objects weighing up to 10 pounds; intermittent lifting, pushing, and/or pulling of objects weighing up to 50 pounds; intermittent standing or walking with objects weighing up to 25 pounds; intermittent sitting at a computer workstation for extended periods of time; and performing tasks with repetitive motions. Also involves intermittent risk of back injury from moving, lifting, or positioning patients, equipment, or materials; intermittent risk of injuries from use of equipment on the job; intermittent exposure to cuts or punctures; intermittent exposure to radiation; and occasional exposure to hazardous chemicals and fumes including waste, bloodborne or airborne pathogens, burns, temperature extremes, loud noises, working in confined spaces, and combative or violent people. Occasional job-related travel may also be required.

title: Pelvic Floor Care Navigator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here is what we offer:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

JOB PURPOSE:

The Pelvic Floor Care Navigator (PFN) assists within UROGYN Division in research, community outreach, and clinical care activities. PFN is responsible to promote high quality of research & care for women with pelvic floor disorders at Howard University (HU) and Howard University Hospital (HUH), coordinate research & clinical care within UROGYN Division. This position will provide administrative support for Division of Urogynecology operations. This position reports to Urogynecology Chief.


SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY:

This position reports to the Chief of Urogynecology and coordinates with other members of the research team. This position has no formal supervisory authority or authority for the direction of others.


NATURE AND SCOPE:

This position supports research & clinical care within the Division of Urogynecology, OBGYN Department and Howard University/Howard University Hospital. This position may interact with a variety of participants, clinicians, staff and faculty. They may also interact with research partners, advisory board participants, and other stakeholders. External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients, other healthcare personnel, and research staff.


PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:


Research:

· Recruit, screen, and consent study participants in accordance with approved protocols

· Schedule and coordinate study sessions, assessments, and follow-up visits

· Communicate regularly with site clinicians and research partners to monitor study progress and troubleshoot challenges

· Use designated software to support study operations, data management, tracking, and reporting

· Assist with authorizations for study related treatments and care.

· Assist participants to navigate through HU and HUH systems.

· Protects private health information and safeguards Belmont three fundamental ethical principles for research.


Community Outreach:

· Lead monthly outreach events to increase UROGYN HU and HUH community outreach and increase research participation and awareness regarding pelvic floor disorders & UROGYN services at HU/HUH

· Collaborate with FPP community outreach team

· Work with HUH and HUH marketing team to improve social media presence

· Serve as a visible ambassador for Howard University’s Urogynecology program

· Develop and strengthen relationships with community members, organizations, and partners throughout the DMV community.

· Proactively identify, research, and attend relevant community events and opportunities where women’s health and urogynecology services can be promoted.

· Develop and implement community outreach activities focused on women’s pelvic health,

· Educate community members about the availability of urogynecology services at Howard University, including the types of conditions treated, services offered, and how to access care.

· Establish, cultivate, and maintain strong working relationships with community organizations, healthcare providers, faith-based organizations, advocacy groups, women’s organizations, senior centers, and other community partners.

· Follow up with individuals who express interest in care to help ensure that they successfully transition from community outreach to a scheduled and attended clinic appointment.

· Track outreach activities, community contacts, referrals, appointments, and other engagement metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of outreach efforts.

· Gather feedback from community members and partners to inform future outreach efforts and improve patient experience.

· Collaborate with the Howard University Marketing and Communications team to develop and maintain outreach materials, including flyers, brochures, educational handouts, promotional materials, and other resources for distribution at community events.

· Promote Howard University’s presence at community events through social media highlighting community partnerships and to expand awareness of women’s health and urogynecology services available at Howard University.


Clinical Care:

· Prepare patients for medical appointments including obtaining and recording patients’ vital signs.

· Prepare instruments and equipment for examinations and/or office procedures.

· Assist UROGYN provider with examinations and office procedures.

· Clean and dress wounds, remove sutures as requested by a provider.

· Observe patients and reports adverse reactions to medication or treatment to medical personnel in charge.

· Collect samples, taken by physician for testing, and deliver them to the laboratory.

· Clean, disinfects, and sterilizes materials, instruments, equipment, rooms and supplies.

· Perform inventories and places requisitions for supplies.

· Review patient charts for instructions regarding prescriptions, tests, follow-up appointments and/or patient testing procedures.

· Schedule patients for follow-up and office procedures. Works with the front desk or surgical scheduler to coordinate schedule.

· Obtain authorization for medications and tests etc.

· Assist in locating and filing records.

· Maintain knowledge of and complies with established policies and procedures.

· Maintain work area in a neat and orderly manner.

· Provide patient education and instruction as directed by the provider, including bladder diaries, self-catheter care, bladder instillations, and others.

· Perform voiding trials, foley catheter care, straight catheterization, urinalysis.

· Assist with pessary care and specialized procedures (Urodynamics, Ultrasound, cystoscopy, anal manometry, pelvic physical therapy and others).

· Maintain inventory of pessaries.

· Approve, orders, and assists in Botox procedures.

· Perform other related duties as assigned.


CORE COMPETENCIES:

· CITI Training

· UROGYN skills

· Ability to be detailed oriented, follow established priorities or procedures, and deliver high quality customer service.

· Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions and behave with tact, decorum and diplomacy.

· Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations

· Knowledge of examination, diagnostic and treatment room procedures.

· Knowledge of Medical Terminology, CPT and ICD-9/10 code reference books, Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to maintain a safe work environment to maintain quality control standards.

· Demonstrated skill in oral and written communications as well as ability to speak clearly, understand and respond to oral and written instructions.

· Skill in assisting in a variety of treatments and medications as directed

· Skill in taking vital signs, maintaining records and recording test results.

· Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with research participants, patients, medical staff, and the public.


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Spanish fluency required; Medical Spanish Translator Certification is required.

Licensed Practical Nurse preferred, not required. Associate degree in Medical Technology, Nursing or related field or minimum of seven (7) years related experience in a physician’s office, clinic and/or hospital, research or equivalent combination of education and experience. Certification or registration as a Medical Technology or completion of a Medical Assistant program is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$50,000-$60,000

Position Description

The Repair Technician 2 will perform repair and/or service work of Company products in accordance with prescribed procedures. The job requires using a variety of hand tools and small power tools to take apart and repair the customer tools. Each repair tech has a computer to review Tool Service Bulletins, pack out instructions for reconditioned tools and parts or tools collected for Quality Engineering.


What You Will Do:

  • Work safely and intentionally during all aspects of job including proper PPE and situational awareness.
  • Read and comprehend repair order information and parts schematics.
  • Complete the information on the repair order form including the utilization of technician notes.
  • Perform necessary repairs that might include disassembly of units, diagnosis of operating difficulty, location and replacement of worn or defective parts within the allotted time in accordance with work instructions.
  • Make decisions surrounding the repair of the tool based on TSB’s, work instructions, and playbooks.
  • Keep records of parts used and provide data for billing and/or warranty information and utilize tech notes.
  • Recognize and report operational irregularities and defective materials.
  • Set up and perform electrical, mechanical, and functional tests to ensure tool repair and/or work performed is in accordance with prescribed quality standards.
  • Work from parts sheets, specifications, and drawings.
  • Under supervision make recommendations as to warranty liability and any unusual repair problems.
  • Work is subject to in-process and final inspection.
  • Responsible for quality of work, safety and housekeeping in assigned area.
  • Be a Milwaukee Tool culture champion by handling tasks as assigned, including working on different processes and departments as needed.

What You Will Bring:

  • Requires an education equivalent to high school diploma
  • Must have mechanical skills and diagnostic skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Basic computer and writing skills
  • 3 months or more previous experience in Repair/Recondition meeting established goals for production, quality, and attendance.
  • Fluency in English with strong communication skills, written and oral

At TTI Canada, we’re proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive rewards package that supports your health, financial well-being, and personal growth:

title: Rehab Specialist
description:
Rehabilitation Specialist

Reading FWC | Fitness | Permanent | Part time

Up to £28,129.71 pro rata depending on experience

15 hours per week


At Nuffield Health the UKs largest healthcare charity, everything we give our patients, members and customers would not be possible without you. Your passion, your warmth, your drive to make a difference. Whether it’s driving connected health, helping the nation, transforming experiences, or building the career you want – we give you the support to do it all. Join our journey. It starts with you.


We are looking for a Rehabilitation Specialist to help us build a healthier nation at our club. We are looking for a Rehabilitation Specialist who will deliver Nuffield Health Rehabilitation Programmes utilising the unique Nuffield Health pathway, championing the Charitable Purpose. This role will play a crucial part in Nuffield’s long-term vision for clinical rehabilitation and will require the Rehabilitation Specialist to undertake remote (digital) and in person facilitation of exercise, emotion wellbeing support, healthy eating, and goal setting to aid the participants recovery. The pathway will involve weekly 1to1s, group exercise classes (virtual and in person), promote goal setting and self-directed activity.


You will demonstrate leadership and influencing skills, be a good communicator, organised and self-motived. As part of this role, you will work collaboratively onsite, centrally and with our Charity team and our beneficiaries. You will need excellent IT skills and hold a Level 3 Personal trainer qualification which is essential for the role. Ideally you will have previous experience working in a Rehabilitation Specialist position and an understanding of rehabilitation, along with potentially a Bsc (Hons) in Sports Rehabilitation (desired not essential).

As a Rehabilitation Specialist you will:

  • Organise and run a series of rolling 12-week rehabilitation programmes.
  • Facilitate and deliver both live stream and in person group exercise classes, with people that have varying degrees of abilities and physical function.
  • Be able to promote self-directed activity using pre-recorded on demand classes and a journal which will aid in the participants being able to self-manage their condition after the 12-week Programme.
  • Capability to re-calibrate exercises and intensities based on regular improvements demonstrated by changes in both effort and performance.
  • Identify any deterioration of participants and if necessary follow internal escalation processes, ensuring reporting is processed within a specific timeframe and that outcome data is accurately captured, which is essential in supporting our Charitable Purpose and tracking and monitoring participants progress.
  • Engage in 1to1 telephone conversations each week with every participant to offer coaching in terms of setting short term and long-term goals, understanding restrictions, monitoring progress, understanding and offering emotional wellbeing support, and empowering self-directed activity.

Skills required:

  • Problem-solving and diagnostic skills
  • Organisational ability
  • Effective decision-making skills
  • Time and resource management
  • Experience working with vulnerable adults
  • Qualifications showing good English and number skills

Helping you feel good.


We want you to love coming to work, feeling healthy, happy and valued. That’s why we’ve developed a benefits package with you in mind. Here, you can choose from a range of fitness, lifestyle, health and fitness wellbeing rewards, such as free gym membership, health assessments, retail discounts and pension options. At Nuffield Health, we take care of what’s important to you.

Join Nuffield Health and create the future you want, today.

If you like what you see, why not start your application now? We consider applications as we receive them and reserve the right to close adverts early (for example, where we have received an unprecedented high volume of applications). So, it’s a good idea to apply right away to ensure you’re considered for this role.

It starts with you.

title: Risk Business Partner
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

We are recruiting for a Risk Business Partner


Location: UK


Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. We're experts helping clients adapt and thrive in a changing world. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mind-set, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 23,000 employees and spanning 56 countries.


Our people are our biggest asset as well as our largest shareholder group and are everything that makes us unique; our inclusive culture, the quality service we offer our clients, and our continued growth, all come from our people-first approach. There’s no such thing as individual success. We all need to play our part, contributing our skills and experience to make a true difference. That’s Howden.


Why work at Howden?

We have always been employee-owned and driven by entrepreneurial spirit. Right from the beginning, we've focused on employing talented individuals and empowering them to make a real difference to the company, whilst building successful and fulfilling careers at the same time. Simply put, we hire talented specialists and give them what they need to make a difference for clients. Always have, always will.


People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down disappointed head-hunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work/life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.


What is the role?

The Risk Business Partner sits within the Risk function and supports UK&I Retail and its central functions. Reporting to the Interim Head of Risk, this permanent UK-based role will build strong relationships across the business and help embed the Enterprise Risk Management Framework, giving stakeholders the practical guidance, constructive challenge and confidence they need to manage risk effectively.


What will you be doing?

  • Partner with stakeholders across UK&I Retail and its central functions to embed the Enterprise Risk Management Framework into business activity and decision-making
  • Provide practical, proportionate risk advice and communicate risk responsibilities clearly across the business
  • Support the development and application of risk appetite, monitor agreed metrics and help stakeholders address tolerance breaches
  • Lead and support risk and control assessments, agreeing proportionate actions to strengthen the control environment
  • Embed effective risk event reporting and support root-cause analysis to identify recurring themes and systemic issues
  • Challenge the business on policy coverage, implementation and adherence, including requests for exceptions and waivers
  • Design and coordinate stress and scenario testing, gather relevant data, challenge assumptions and review model outputs
  • Prepare clear risk information and reports for relevant boards, committees and senior stakeholders
  • Identify and monitor emerging risks, track remedial actions and support the effective management of agreed actions
  • Deliver risk training and awareness activity, manage assigned projects and contribute to wider change initiatives

What are we looking for?

  • Proven knowledge of risk management gained within a regulated environment
  • Experience applying or supporting enterprise risk management frameworks, risk appetite processes, risk assessments or control frameworks
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated sector, with retail insurance experience desirable
  • Evidence of providing clear, practical advice and constructive challenge to business stakeholders
  • Experience supporting operational resilience, stress testing or scenario testing
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse risk information, identify themes and translate findings into proportionate actions
  • A track record of delivering projects or change activity while managing competing priorities
  • Experience building effective stakeholder relationships and supporting confidence in new or changing processes

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define.

Our business succeeds by allowing our people to make a mark in the areas they care about most: personal development, volunteering, and fundraising for charity, or creating new insurance products that address society’s greatest challenges.


And we know that separate home and work lives don't really exist. If you're happy and healthy at home, you're more likely to be happy and fulfilled at work – and vice versa. That's why we do our best to support our people in every aspect of their lives.


Diversity and Inclusion

At Howden we value diversity - there is no one Howden ‘personality type’. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
  • We support each other, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
  • We are determined to make a positive difference, at work and beyond

We consider our people our chief competitive advantage and as such we treat colleagues, candidates, clients, and business partners with equality, fairness, and respect – regardless of age, disability, race, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, or family circumstances.


Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.


If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.


*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.


Our sustainability promise

We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

title: Sterile Processing Technician Associate (Evenings)- West Penn Hospital
location: Pittsburgh PA, 15224, West Penn 4800 Friendship Ave
description:
Company :

Allegheny Health Network

Job Description :

GENERAL OVERVIEW:

This role is responsible for decontaminating, cleaning, assembling, sterilizing, and distributing surgical instruments and equipment. This role ensures that surgical instrumentation and equipment is properly processed and available for use in procedural and patient care areas, adhering to established policies, procedures, and regulatory standards. This role works under direct supervision, learning and applying the principles of sterile processing to maintain a safe and effective healthcare environment.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Follows all safety and infection control policies, procedures, and protocols and uses personal protective equipment (PPE) as required. (15%)

  • Receives and sorts contaminated instruments and equipment from various departments. (10%)

  • Disassembles instruments and cleans them using appropriate cleaning agents and equipment. (10%)

  • Inspects cleaned instruments for cleanliness, proper function, and damage. (10%)

  • Assembles instrument sets according to established count sheets and tray lists. (10%)

  • Wraps or packages instruments and sets for sterilization. (10%)

  • Monitors sterilization cycles and interprets printouts to ensure proper sterilization parameters were met. (10%)

  • Operates and maintains automated washing and decontamination equipment. (5%)

  • Loads and operates appropriate sterilization equipment. (5%)

  • Documents sterilization cycles and maintains accurate records. (5%)

  • Delivers sterile items to requesting departments in a timely manner. (5%)

  • Maintains a clean and organized work environment. (5%)

  • Other duties as assigned or requested. (0%)

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • High School/GED

  • For SPTs hired after 12/29/2020: Pass a nationally accredited central service exam within 18 months of hire; maintain Certified Registered Central Service Technician (CRCST) or Certified Sterile Processing and Distribution Technician (CSPDT) certification.

    • A Surgical Technologist holding an active Certification of Surgical Technologist (CST) or Tech in Surgery Certified (TSC) meets this license requirement.

Subject Matter Expert

title: Global Study Associate Director
description:
Global Study Associate Director (oncology)

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.


As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.




What You Will Do:



  • Lead, provide guidance and delegate appropriately to a cross-functional study team or oversee outsourced delivery activities to ensure the clinical study progresses as planned, driving achievement of milestones according to timelines, budget and quality standards. May hold accountability and/or oversight of several studies.
  • Lead and facilitate communication across all functions, including external partners and service providers. Lead and conduct investigator meetings and other study related meetings.
  • Provide input into and hold accountability for the development of essential study level documents (i.e., Clinical Study Protocol (CSP) through to Clinical Study Report (CSR)) in accordance with relevant SOPs.
  • Develop and maintain relevant study plans including required input into study level quality and risk management planning (e.g., risk-based quality management, proactive risk and contingency plans, etc.) ensuring that the risk response strategies and issue escalation pathways are clear to the entire study team
  • Ensure all external service providers (i.e., Contract Research Organizations (CROs), central laboratories, IXRS, ePRO, etc.) engaged at the study level are performing to contracted goals and timelines/budget and that adequate oversight is documented and any issues are escalated appropriately. May participate in vendor selection activities.
  • Identify and report quality issues that have occurred within the study in accordance with relevant SOP and collaborate with all functions as necessary to overcome barriers and achieve milestones; proactively communicate findings and corrective action plans (CAPAs) to relevant stakeholders (e.g. CPT, quality assurance staff, functional line management, etc.)
  • Oversee Trial Master File (TMF) completion in accordance with relevant SOPs, including ensuring the TMF plan and Expected Document List (EDL) are in place and that QC activities are performed on an ongoing basis to ensure TMF completeness at all times
  • Ensure timely compliance with company-wide governance controls (e.g., Delegation of Authority, Sunshine Act, financial system attestations, Clinical Trial Transparency)
  • The GSAD is responsible for study budget re-forecasting following initial budget estimate provided by the CPT and accountable for study budget management through the study lifecycle and for providing budget progress reports to the CPT including any financial risks and mitigation plans (as part of the ongoing study change control process)
  • Ensure studies are inspection-ready at all times, according to ICH-GCP and SOP and relevant policies/guidelines; GSAD is the primary Study Management point-of-contact in the event of an audit or inspection
  • Provide regular feedback on individual performance to the study team members and their line managers to support their professional development; may mentor less experienced colleagues

Your Profile:

  • University degree (or equivalent), preferably in medical or biological sciences or discipline associated with clinical research
  • 5 + years of relevant clinical experience in the pharmaceutical industry focused in Clinical Project/Trial Management
  • Experience overseeing large global clinical trial projects
  • Experience overseeing Oncology studies/projects is required

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.


Rewards & Benefits

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.


Benefits may include:

  • Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
  • Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
  • Retirement and pension plans
  • Life assurance and disability coverage
  • Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
  • Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.


Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.


Inclusion and Accessibility

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

title: Partnership Solutions Coordinator - University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
description:
Learfield is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Partnership Coordinator to join our Sports Properties team and support the execution of corporate sponsorship activations on campus. This role plays a key part in bringing partnerships to life in meaningful, visible ways for fans, sponsors, and the university community.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for executing day-to-day fulfillment activities across partner accounts, providing behind-the-scenes coordination that ensures seamless delivery. You’ll work closely with internal team members, university contacts, and brand partners to track assets, deliver campaign elements, and support gameday operations. This is a hands-on role suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys logistics and planning, and is excited to grow a career in sports sponsorship.

  • Support the activation and fulfillment of corporate partnership agreements across traditional, digital, and in-venue platforms

  • Supervise gameday staff, as needed, to support on-site execution
  • Provide proof-of-performance documentation for fulfilled partnership elements
  • Support administrative functions such as budget tracking, invoicing, contract documentation, and expense reporting

  • Strong organizational skills with high attention to detail

  • Team-oriented mindset with a willingness to take initiative and support where needed
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and home games

  • Bachelor’s degree in sports management, marketing, business, communications, or a related field

title: LaSalle Early Analyst Development Program
description:
The Opportunity:


Join LaSalle – We’re develop future real estate investors for tomorrow, today! LaSalle Investment Management is seeking upcoming or recent college grads to join our rotational program providing exposure to LaSalle’s investment products, which may include separate accounts, open and closed end funds, and debt spanning across various risk profiles and geographies within LaSalle’s business platforms and functions. Selected candidates will spend 12 months learning the fundamentals of real estate investing through role shadowing, participating in business projects, and other learning and development opportunities.


Through guided and self-directed learning and training activities, the program gives participants exposure to professional development, critical skill building, and helps them prepare for a career in real estate investment management. Strengthen your business acumen through exposure to senior leaders, performance coaching and feedback, mentoring relationships, leadership and professional development opportunities, and develop a professional network that includes some of the best talent in the industry. You’ll be a meaningful part of the team, gaining valuable experience and getting first-hand insights experience on real estate investment management from LaSalle, a proven industry leader.


Upon successful completion of the 12-month program, individuals have access to full-time placement in a permanent role (subject to business needs as well as individual performance, skillset, and interests).


Responsibilities & Job Duties:

  • Active role in a variety of special projects within the defined framework of the program, involving hands-on experience and rotations through key departments - your days will be filled with fast-paced on-the-job training and development as a vital part of the team.
  • Exposure to a variety of asset classes including office, industrial, retail, and multifamily property investments that span various risk profiles and geographic regions.
  • Perform property level analysis for the firm’s direct real estate investments and aid the team in acquiring, monitoring, and improving the performance of commercial real estate investments.
  • Shadowing and project responsibilities may include but are not limited to the following: market research, support underwriting efforts for debt/equity opportunities, financial analysis and modeling, risk analysis and valuation, drafting investment memos, portfolio monitoring, analysis and valuation, ad-hoc projects, presentations, and other duties as appropriate.
  • Gain proficiency in the business practices, operations and procedures in each department rotation, acquiring knowledge, skills and experience required to advance to a professional role at LaSalle.
  • Observe, learn, and apply departmental procedures to become familiar with the functions of each department.
  • Develop a solid knowledge of the business lines, including the business plans, products, and processes and build a solid knowledge of the firm’s strategies and follow established investment policies and procedures.
  • Meet with Program Manager and mentors on a regular basis to discuss rotation results and performance feedback, business priorities, career development, etc.
  • Provide feedback to Program Manager about rotations, special projects, etc, contributing to continuous improvement of the program.
  • Participate in formal and informal mentor and peer resource opportunities.
  • Efficiently execute research and analytical tasks, leveraging internal and external resources.
  • Attend formal training classes, completing all assigned courses and participating in extensive self-learning.
  • Meet with senior leaders, soaking in their experience and insights, while developing your own skills based on their guidance.

  • BA/BS degree in real estate, finance, accounting, or economics or related field with strong record of academic achievement, with a graduation date in Winter 2026 or Spring 2027.
  • Candidate must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated interested in financial services, real estate or investment management.
  • Strong computer literacy, especially in Microsoft Office (Excel and PowerPoint).
  • Financial acumen and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills.
  • Self-starter must be organized and able to work independently.
  • Ability to prioritize work and multi-task, with a strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to perform under pressure and meet time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Campus involvement/leadership experience.
  • Previous internship or co-op program experience preferred.

  • Health benefits include medical, dental, vision, mental health support and additional ancillary insurance plans.

  • Financial wellness is supported through a 401(k) plan with a company match, flexible spending accounts or a health savings account.

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return.
