title: ekspert(-ka) relacji z klientem zamożnym
description:
To masz na bank:

  • umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),
  • pracę stacjonarną w 17 Oddziale we Wrocławiu , pl. Powstańców Śląskich 17/115
  • zespół/lider: Katarzyna Żurawska,
  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premia w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej.

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom najlepsze doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Dbamy
o portfele klientów w ponad 300 oddziałach w całej Polsce. Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,
  • masz ponad 3-letnie doświadczenie w bankowości i sprzedaży usług i produktów bankowych, w tym produktów inwestycyjnych,
  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,
  • masz wiedzę w zakresie funkcjonowania rynku kapitałowego oraz jego instrumentów,
  • lubisz stawiać sobie ambitne cele i dobrze czujesz się wiedząc do czego dążysz,
  • czujesz się komfortowo zarówno w pracy indywidualnej jak i zespołowej,
  • chcesz się rozwijać w bankowości i zdobywać nowe kompetencje zgodnie z wybraną specjalizacją w segmencie Klienta Zamożnego, Hipoteki, MŚP.

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych,
  • doświadczenie w sprzedaży produktów inwestycyjnych (w tym funduszy),
  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • obsługa klienta zamożnego,
  • zapewnienie profesjonalnej obsługi oraz najlepszych doświadczeń związanych z wizytą w oddziale,
  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych,
  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych zadań sprzedażowych, za które przyznajemy miesięczne premie na atrakcyjnym poziomie,
  • telefoniczny i bezpośredni kontakt z klientami,
  • budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami oraz pozyskiwanie nowych,
  • praca w zgodzie z obowiązującymi procedurami oraz standardami dotyczącymi i realizowanymi we wszystkich kanałach dystrybucji.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),
  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),
  • ubezpieczenie na życie,
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,
  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,
  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,
  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,
  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.
  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.
  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i otrzymywać pierwsze premie.
  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.
  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

  • wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,
  • spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,
  • pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Quality Improvement Specialist
description:
Mary Free Bed Summary

We have the great privilege of helping patients and families re-build their lives. It’s extraordinarily meaningful work and the reason we greet the day with optimism and anticipation. When patients “Ask for Mary,” they experience a culture that has been sculpted for more than a century. Our hallmark is to carefully listen to patients and innovatively serve them. This is true of every employee, from support staff and leadership to clinicians and care providers.

Mary Free Bed is a not-for-profit, nationally accredited rehabilitation hospital serving thousands of children and adults each year through inpatient, outpatient, sub-acute rehabilitation, orthotics and prosthetics and home and community programs. With the most comprehensive rehabilitation services in Michigan and an exclusive focus on rehabilitation, Mary Free Bed physicians, nurses and therapists help our patients achieve outstanding clinical outcomes. The growing Mary Free Bed Network provides patients throughout the state with access to our unique standard of care

Mission Statement

Restoring hope and freedom through rehabilitation.

Employment Value Proposition

At Mary Free Bed, we take pride in our values-based culture:

  • Focus on Patient Care. A selfless drive to serve and heal connects all MFB employees.
  • Clinical Variety and Challenge. An inter-disciplinary approach and a top team of professionals create ever-changing opportunities and activities.
  • Family Culture. We offer the stability of a large organization while nurturing the family/team atmosphere of a small organization.
  • Trust in Each Other. Each employee knows that co-workers can be trusted to make the right decision for our family, patients, staff, and community.
  • A Proud Tradition. Years of dedicated, quality service to our patients and community have yielded a reputation that fills our employees with pride.

Summary

​​Supports quality, safety and patient experience initiatives and organizational standards, through the use of data collection and analysis of patient satisfaction reports , patient complaints and service recovery trends, and Patient Family Advisory Council(s) input. Responsible for Quality Division safety, quality, outcome, and satisfaction metrics, reporting, and analysis to support organizational and leadership requirements.

​

​​

Essential Job Responsibilities

  • ​​Participates in training, data entry, data compilation, production of reports in collaboration with the Quality and Risk Department including:
  • ​Patient safety reporting
  • ​Patient satisfaction reporting, with external benchmarking
  • ​Patient input and comment trending
  • ​Clinical outcome reporting, with external benchmarking
  • ​Quality Improvement and Risk Management Committee reporting
  • ​Assists the Quality and Risk Department with the identification of quality and clinical outcome metrics, appropriate tools for data collection, and available reporting to support improvements across Mary Free Bed organizations. Supports the annual quality and safety goals for the organizational, including definitions of goals, identification of baselines, and/or benchmarks. Responsible for compilation and results reporting to provide accurate performance results.
  • ​Assists the Quality and Risk Department with the use of data collection tools, surveys, and audits, used in improvement projects. Supports the need for further improvements needed to enhance the availability of usable data including survey format revisions, technology requirements/changes/ products and the education of users.
  • ​Monitors and reports trends in outcome result and tracks action plans with program and department leadership.
  • ​Assists the Quality and Risk Department with literature review, knowledge transfer, and implementation of systems for all new regulatory reporting (i.e., IMPACT, QRP, etc.).
  • ​Assists with the Mary Free Bed network/system site data submission for patient safety, patient satisfaction and clinical and functional outcomes as appropriate.
  • ​Supports improvement planning, improvement initiatives, and results analysis for MFB organizations to guarantee Mary Free Bed’s inspirational, highly reliable, high quality and safe culture.
  • ​Supports (and is cross-trained) in patient complaints and grievances, including communication and coordination of service recovery efforts with patients, families, and team members. Functions as Patient Advocate, as needed, beyond Care Manager advocacy.
  • ​Supports, and participates under guidance of the Director of Quality and Risk, training opportunities and workflows for customer services, improvement processes and tools, regulatory program requirements and risk reduction activities.
  • ​Assists with compliance in hospital wide accreditation and regulatory programs including CMS, The Joint Commission, CARF, HFAP if applicable.
  • ​Assists the Quality and Risk Department with performance improvement initiatives using tools such as PDSA, FEMA, Root Cause Analysis, and process mapping.

​​

Customer Service Responsibilities

Demonstrate excellent customer service and standards of behaviors as well as encourages, coaches, and monitors the same in team members. This individual should consistently promote teamwork and direct communication with co-workers and deal discretely and sensitively with confidential information.

Responsibilities in Quality Improvement

Contribute by identifying problems and seeking solutions. Promote patient/family satisfaction where possible; participates in departmental efforts to monitor and report customer service.

Essential Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Hospitality, or Allied Health area.
  • College coursework and/or experience in healthcare, data management, quality, clinical outcome reporting, and/or customer service industry.
  • Minimum 3 years previous work experience in a data management or administrative coordinator role.
  • Demonstrated organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Competent language and grammar skills with the ability to compose, edit, and proof minutes, letters, and other correspondence.
  • The competence to make independent decisions as well as preserve the confidentiality of special matters; demonstrated experience in problem solving and critical thinking.
  • Advanced competency with Microsoft Office applications, Adobe, Share Point, and databases.
  • Experience in compiling and presenting data in meaningful formats.
  • Energetic, positive, collaborative “can-do” attitude and work style.
  • Experience in working with people of all backgrounds.

Preferred Job Qualifications

  • ​​Experience with patient satisfaction surveying and reporting / Press Ganey
  • ​Experience with eRehab, UDS, FIM and WeeFIM data and reporting
  • ​Experience with Incidence / Occurrence system / RL6
  • ​Experience with employee learning modules / Health Stream system
  • ​Experience with EQUADR, NDNQI, NSHN
  • ​Experience with process mapping

title: Associate Mechanical Manufacturing Value Engineer
description:
Associate Mechanical Manufacturing Value Engineer

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. Job Description:

The Associate Mechanical Value Engineering Engineer is responsible for driving mechanical cost reduction, manufacturability improvements, supplier optimization, and quality enhancements across new and existing products. Working closely with Mechanical Design Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Supplier Quality, and external fabrication partners, this role develops high-value mechanical solutions that improve product quality, manufacturability, reliability, and cost competitiveness.

The engineer supports both new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining products by applying Design for Manufacturability (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Value (DFV) principles across a broad range of mechanical fabrication technologies. The role serves as a key technical interface between engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure robust production processes and continuous product cost reductions throughout the product lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive value engineering initiatives focused on mechanical cost reduction, quality improvement, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Support fabrication technologies including sheet metal, machining, die casting, plastic injection molding, extrusion, and mechanical assemblies.
  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers (CMs), original design manufacturers (ODMs), and fabrication suppliers to optimize manufacturing processes and reduce product costs.
  • Identify tooling, material, and process improvement opportunities that improve quality and lower total product cost.
  • Analyze manufacturing, supplier, and field quality data to identify improvement opportunities and corrective actions.
  • Participate in root cause investigations of product, assembly, and process failures and drive closure of corrective actions.
  • Support qualification of new suppliers, manufacturing processes, tooling, and mechanical components.
  • Support supplier audits and manufacturing assessments in partnership with Supplier Quality and Supply Chain organizations.
  • Communicate technical recommendations and business cases supporting cost reduction and manufacturing improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
  • Typically 2-5 years of experience in Mechanical Manufacturing Engineering, Value Engineering, Product Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience working with mechanical fabrication processes and manufacturing environments.
  • Understanding of mechanical component design, materials, tolerances, and manufacturing methods.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and CAD systems such as SolidWorks or equivalent.
  • Advanced English Level

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

  • Strong understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and fabrication methods.
  • Ability to evaluate product designs for cost, manufacturability, quality, and scalability.
  • Strong analytical and root cause problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of supplier development, process qualification, and manufacturing validation.
  • Ability to analyze yield, quality, and cost data to drive improvement actions.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills across engineering, operations, and supplier organizations.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing to cross-functional teams.

Travel

  • Up to 10% domestic and international travel may be required to support manufacturing partners, suppliers, audits, and product launches.

description:
About the Company
Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in 2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer /Technical Lead – ADAS-SIL Testing

Group: ADAS/AD

BU : CARIAD Business Unit – India

Location: Whitefield, Bangalore


Experience: 6 to 10 years


Role Overview:

The ADAS VnV Technical Lead is responsible for leading the verification and validation (V&V) activities of ADAS functions. This role combines hands-on expertise in test automation, scenario modelling and scenario-based validation with leadership responsibilities to ensure the delivery of high-quality, safety-critical software components. The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) at Level 2, 2+, and 3, and manages the end-to-end software validation lifecycle aligned with ASPICE standards (SWE.4 to SYS.5). The Technical Lead drives test strategy promotes best practices in automation and continuous integration and ensures thorough coverage across functional and safety requirements.


Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to Requirements review, Test specification, implementation, execution and analysis of functional, and system-level test cases for ADAS Driving functionalities, ensuring alignment with ASPICE and ISO 26262 standards.
  • Understand detailed design documentation/interface architectures and create corresponding test specifications (SWE.4-SYS.5) and create test cases using python based internal tooling
  • Analyze system and software requirements, including interface specifications, to derive functional and scenario-based test cases (SWE.6).
  • Scenario based SIL Testing
  • SiL Recompute
  • Use GIT for source control, test asset versioning, and collaboration within multi-developer teams.
  • Operate in Linux environments, using command-line tools to work with data platforms
  • Stay open to adopting AI/ML-based techniques in the future for enhanced test intelligence and automation.
  • Guide and mentor a team of test engineers in test development, execution, and evaluation for ADAS features.
  • Encourage a proactive, quality-first mindset and promote technical growth through knowledge sharing and continuous feedback.
  • Facilitate code reviews, process improvements, and innovation within the team.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and career progression of team members to meet evolving project needs.
  • Expertise in Test Design, techniques, Test strategies, Plan and methods.
  • Expertise in multiple domain technologies such as ADAS

Skills :

  • Bachelor’s degree in ECE, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in SWE.4,SWE.6,SYS.5 testing with a strong focus on ADAS- L2,L2+,L3 software & systems V&V
  • Proficient in Python
  • 5+ years of experience in test framework development in Python, preferably in automotive or ADAS systems
  • Testing exposure in ADAS features like Driving, Active Safety, Traffic Sign Visualization/recognition is mandatory.
  • Good understanding of Vehicle Dynamics
  • Experience in scenario-based testing. open Scenario/VTD/IPG CarMaker
  • Proven expertise in test automation and verification techniques across various test levels (unit, functional, integration and qualification testing).
  • Solid understanding of Functional Safety standards, particularly ISO 26262 and ASPICE process knowledge.
  • Skilled in working with SIL models and test framework updates, including scenario generator and model integration.
  • Proficient with CarMaker or similar tools for generating road files, setting up test environments, and integrating with 3rd party tools
  • Familiarity with test evaluation logging
  • Experienced with GIT for version control, test script management, and collaboration workflows.
  • Exposure to AI/ML concepts is considered a plus for future enhancements in test automation and analytics.
  • ISTQB Test certification is a strong plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Docker, and Jenkins is desirable.
  • Good to have:

title: Prospect Research Specialist
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here is what we offer:

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

JOB PURPOSE:

Developing a robust culture of prospect research and portfolio management is vital to the University’s fundraising and to Development and Alumni Relations (DAR) efforts to build sustainable and broad-based annual, leadership, major, principal, and planned gift programs, as well as corporate and foundation relations prospect pipelines in support of annual and long-term fundraising targets.

The position embodies a customer-service orientation to lead generation, potential prospect identification, research, and qualification and provides—both proactively and in response to requests from colleagues—confidential and thoroughly researched profiles, reports, and briefings tailored to the needs of a variety of audiences.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY:

N/A

NATURE AND SCOPE:

Reporting to the Director of Prospect Development, the Prospect Research Specialist provides analysis and actionable support to gift officers and portfolio managers to inform prospect strategies and list segmentation. This position also works closely with the Advancement Services team and participates in regular prospect strategy meetings, ensuring quick and accurate updates of portfolios and donor records.

In collaboration with partners across campus, additional prospect names and introductions will be captured and centralized in DAR’s database. Teamwork and collaboration across campus and within DAR are essential.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

This role identifies, tracks, segments, and analyzes donor records and key relationships between the existing Howard community and prospective new sources of support to meet annual and long-term University fundraising objectives. The role ensures prospect data is collected and input into Raiser’s Edge, requiring systematized efforts to review local and national news, business publications, economic trends, and business developments to keep abreast of prospect information and to provide relevant updates to gift officers on assigned prospects.

Core responsibilities include the timely creation of prospect briefings and reports using research and screening tools. The position is expected to leverage analytics informed by predictive modelling, wealth screening, data mining and benchmarking to inform portfolio audit/balancing efforts and maintain a system of assigning prospects to gift officer portfolios. The Prospect Research Specialist must keep current on research and fundraising trends through regular contact with industry resources as well as vendors.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Demonstrate sound project management skills;
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to analyze substantial amounts of data;
  • Ability to embody a customer service approach while providing support to multiple team members;
  • Ability to prepare tailored profile reports as needed/requested by gift officers and DAR leadership;
  • Knowledge of research software (i.e., Donor Search, WealthEngine, iWave, etc). and other tools;
  • Demonstrated proficiency in query and report building in a development CRM (Customer Relationship Management) (i.e. Raiser’s Edge, Salesforce or similar)
  • Commitment to maintaining the professional and ethical standards set forth for the field by the Association of Researchers for Advancement (APRA);
  • Ability to navigate internal processes and structures to problem-solve and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence;
  • Ability to and adhere to standard operating procedures for data process functions;
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently with purpose and accuracy in a fast-paced environment; and
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and a high degree of discretion.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

Associate's or Bachelor's degree or (3) years of experience in a prospect research position

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and database management experience; familiarity with Raiser’s Edge preferred
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Play Finders Internship
description:
Job Description

Are You an Aspiring Toy Inventor Looking to Discover New Play?

Join the LEGO® Group’s Play Discovery team within the Creative Play Lab for a Paid Internship at our Head Quarters in Billund, Denmark!

Are you driven by an unquenchable passion for discovering new play opportunities through early-stage ideation, concept development, and prototyping? If so, you could be one of the talented students joining our Play Discovery department this year, where creativity and imagination thrive!

Start date: September 2026

Length: 4 months (until end of December 2026)

About us:

Creative Play Lab is an ambitious, future‑focused innovation hub inventing radical new play opportunities and never‑seen‑before experiences for LEGO® fans of today and tomorrow. We grow the boundaries of what play can become, using bold experimentation, advanced technologies, and deep insight into how kids play to imagine meaningful, next‑generation experiences. Our mix of creatives, innovators, researchers, engineers, and technologists rapidly transforms curiosity into tangible concepts, redefining the future of play and ensuring LEGO® play remains at the forefront of creativity and joyful exploration.

As an intern in our Play Discovery department, you’ll join teams dedicated to letting loose their creative curiosity and exploring new play experiences. You’ll unleash your imagination across a range of innovation missions, collaborating cross-functionally to develop concepts into playable prototypes.

About the Internship:

We look for interns who bring something genuinely different to our innovation hub, adding fresh cultural insight, creative energy, and new ways of thinking. Your time with us will span personal curiosity projects, team capability-building initiatives, and innovation Missions. Every day is different and you’ll learn directly from a world‑class multidisciplinary team as you build your craft, embracing ambiguity as you discover new play experiences.

Meet the Play Finder team:

As an intern Play Finder, you will embark on broad play explorations to spark play for children of all ages. You will truly embody what it means to think like a kid and see the world from their perspective. This role focuses on analysing, observing and remixing old and new play, to find ingredients that can be used within the teams and projects you support. You will work in a very multidisciplinary way, cross-pollenating different media, observing and analysing trends, building with existing LEGO elements, remixing and modifying concepts with a variety of digital and physical tools as you try to 'discover the fun' with your playful eye. You are just a big kid looking for the 'toy' in everything. Your work will directly shape the products and experiences that end up in the hands of millions of builders worldwide.

Internship Eligibility:

To qualify for this internship opportunity, you must meet all of the following criteria: (1) You will be a student for the full duration of the internship period; (2) You are currently due to graduate after 31st December 2026; (3) You will not be requesting a delayed graduation date to qualify for this internship; (4) This internship will contribute quantitatively towards your course credit and is a compulsory part of your education; (5) You are available to undertake this internship contract starting from 1st September 2026 and ending on 31st December 2026 in Billund, Denmark.

We also encourage interns to have experience with at least some of the following:

  • Sketching

  • Painting

  • Sculpture

  • Woodwork

  • Graphic Design

  • LEGO Model Building

  • Textiles

  • Machine Workshop tools e.g. lathe, drills etc.

  • Electronics

  • 3D CAD programs

  • Game Engines

  • Coding

  • Videography / Editing

  • Broad understanding of the Toy market across genres & play types

What we’re looking for:

Curiosity: Our teams thrive on a playful curiosity in all they do. You need to be always asking questions, seeking the reason “why”, digging for answers even when it’s hard and never stop wondering “what if...”

Bravery: Our organisation is a huge place full of different people and different perspectives. You need to be comfortable meeting new people every day, speaking up when you disagree, receiving feedback, facing the unknowns of innovation head on and forging yourself a path when things aren’t well defined.

Focus: Our workload and priorities are always changing. You need to be happy shifting priorities fast, focusing on a high priority task one week then focusing on developing your own independent curiosities the next.

Responsibilities:

We want you to bring all your energy, enthusiasm and experiences to work every day so we can achieve amazing things together while you learn along the way. Some of your typical responsibilities could include...

  • Find the fun in new technologies, materials and playthings

  • Seek inspiration from the wider world outside and bringing findings back to the internal teams

  • Challenge colleagues to think like a kid and embody the kids perspective in your approach to toy design

Perks:

  • Work with a passionate multi-disciplinary team of like-minded creative inventors where you’ll learn something new every day and build your professional network

  • Live and work in the global headquarters of the LEGO® Group in Billund, Denmark and explore our state-of-the-art campus

  • Be an active co-creator with kids – they know how to make fun and meaningful play.

Application:

We welcome international applications for this role however you must be able to live and work in Billund, Denmark for the duration of the internship itself. The LEGO® Group will provide support with permits to work in Denmark for the internship period and we can support with finding accommodation. The costs of your accommodation along with your travel costs to/from Denmark must be covered by you.

We have multiple Play Discovery internships available, each supporting a different team with their own focus area. Take a moment to review all these opportunities and apply only to those that truly align with your strengths. If you have broad skills, applying to more than one team is acceptable but applying to a large number of teams doesn’t increase your chances of making a successful application and makes it harder for us to understand where you’d shine. Please be thoughtful in your approach.

Please ensure your application is completed in English.

To apply, simply submit the following by Saturday 25th April 2026. Please do not risk missing this deadline as we will not consider late applications for this role.

Please attach the following items to your application as 4 separate .PDF documents. Applications failing to do this shall not be considered.

  • An A4 size poster (landscape) designed by you to showcase why you think you are a good fit for the internship. You may use text, photographs, colour etc. to communicate your enthusiasm, talent and values.

  • A current CV detailing your education and relevant experiences.

  • A full portfolio showcasing a more in-depth range of your work. This should include projects that highlight your interests, reflect your passions and demonstrate your hobbies.

  • A bespoke cover letter (no more than 200 words) that tells us what motivates you to apply for this internship and why you think you’re best suited for the placement. If you can do or say something to help your cover letter stand out then please do. We encourage you to be original and authentic to who you are.

Come and join us as we discover the future of play!

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

Job description:

Planning and Scheduling

· Ensure all planned work supports production, deposition strategies and operational priorities

Work Management and CMMS

· Coordinate and maintain departmental CMMS including asset registers, equipment hierarchies, preventive maintenance schedules and work order history.

Materials, Spares and inventory management

· Manage critical spares and rotable spare strategies for TSF infrastructure

· Support annual critical spare reviews and inventory optimization

Asset Management

· Support implementation of the ISO 55001 asset management principles across the TSF department

· Maintain accurate asset registers and equipment hierarchies

· Support lifecycle planning for pumps, pipelines, valves, instrumentation, civil infrastructure and mobile equipment.

· Participate in asset criticality assessments

· Assist in asset replacement planning for long-term capital forecasting

· Support risk-based maintenance strategies across department assets

Reliability and Continous improvement

· Support Root Cause Analysis investigations

· Monitor equipment reliability trends

· Assist with preventive maintenance optimization

· Develop reliability and maintenance performance dashboards

TSF Infrastructure planning

· Support planning and maintenance of;

- Tailings pipelines

- Pump stations

- Decant systems

- Return water systems

- Drainage infrastructure

- Instrumentation

- Dam safety monitoring systems

- Roads and Civil infrastructure

· Assist in ensuring infrastructure reliability and operational readiness.

Safety, Health, Environment and Risk Management

· Promote a strong safety culture through visible leadership and compliance with company standards.

· Ensure all planned activities are conducted in accordance with applicable safety and environmental requirements.

· Participate in risk assessments and operational reviews.

· Identify and escalate operational risks that may impact TSF performance or safety.

Minimum Requirements

Qualifications

· Full grade twelve (12) certificate

· Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering or related Engineering discipline.

· Professional registration with recognized engineering body (EIZ/ERB)

· Minimum 2 years’ experience in mining operations, tailings management, construction, maintenance coordination, or related field.

Added advantage

· Training or certification in Maintenance Planning, CMMS, Asset management or MS projects

· Knowledge of TSF operations and water management systems will be advantageous.

· Familiarity with Power BI, Pronto or similar tools

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
Compensation: $100,000-$120,000 per year
Location: Omaha, NE - Hybrid

The job:

As a Senior Web Developer at Buildertrend, you’ll help shape the digital experiences that connect residential construction professionals with the tools they need to build more efficiently and profitably. You’ll own meaningful web initiatives from technical strategy through deployment and measurement, while serving as a trusted technical partner to Marketing, Design, Analytics, Revenue Operations and Product Engineering. Your work will improve the performance, reliability, accessibility and security of Buildertrend’s public-facing websites and the customer journeys they support. Success in this role means the Web team is trusted to solve problems, make sound technical decisions and create web experiences that help builders spend less time on paperwork and more time growing their businesses.

What you will do:

  • Partner with marketing, design, Revenue Operations and other stakeholders to understand business needs and turn them into thoughtful technical solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain functionality across Buildertrend’s public-facing websites.
  • Own complex web initiatives from discovery and technical planning through implementation, deployment, measurement and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and maintain custom WordPress themes, plugins, Gutenberg blocks, reusable components and integrations using PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
  • Help shape Buildertrend’s web architecture by evaluating CMS platforms and traditional, decoupled and headless approaches against business needs, scalability, maintainability and long-term strategy.
  • Keep high-traffic, business-critical websites fast, secure, accessible and protected from bot and crawler abuse.
  • Monitor site health, investigate production issues and own incidents through resolution.
  • Build automated tests with tools such as Playwright to protect critical customer journeys.
  • Make sure lead-generation paths, including forms, APIs, webhooks and integrations, work accurately.
  • Lead code reviews and mentor other developers.
  • Use Claude or other cutting-edge AI tools as a part of how you build to accelerate problem solving and improve development efficiency while still applying critical thinking, and owning the quality of your final work.

Who you are and what you need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, web development or a related field, or equivalent professional experience required.
  • 5+ years of professional web or software development experience, including hands-on work supporting production applications required.
  • Prior experience supporting B2B SaaS websites in strongly preferred.
  • Deep experience building and maintaining WordPress applications with PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
  • Experience developing custom WordPress themes, plugins, Gutenberg blocks and reusable components.
  • Experience with modern JavaScript development, including React.
  • Experience evaluating or migrating CMS platforms and web architectures, including headless or decoupled approaches.
  • Experience implementing automated testing with Playwright or a comparable tool.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, REST APIs, webhooks and third-party integrations.
  • Strong understanding of web performance, data privacy, security and accessibility standards, including OWASP, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and WCAG.
  • Ability to take an ambiguous problem, evaluate the options and recommend a pragmatic path forward, and mentor others along the way.

We are giving you:

  • Exceptional health packages, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life insurance and short- and long-term disability benefits
  • A 401(k) plan with Buildertrend matching contributions to help you plan for the future
  • Generous paid time off, 11 paid holidays, plus personal days to make sure you have time to recharge
  • Parental leave and paid sabbaticals to support you during life’s big moments
  • Volunteer time off – because giving back matters
  • Wellness program and onsite fitness center to keep you feeling your best
  • Opportunities for hybrid or remote work to give you the flexibility you need
  • Technology reimbursement to help cover costs for the tech you need to do your job from home
  • Free daily lunches when you're at our HQ office, plus monthly events to connect with your team

Who we are:

Great builders don’t just manage projects – they run successful businesses. That’s where Buildertrend comes in. As the leading residential construction management platform, we give contractors the power to control their financials, schedules, team workflows and client relationships – all in one system. No more juggling disconnected tools or guessing on profitability. With nearly two decades of industry expertise, Buildertrend helps builders work smarter, scale faster and stay ahead of the competition. If you want to learn more about us, check out:

At Buildertrend, we fully recognize that we all work so we can live better lives—we appreciate and respect that this is a job and not your whole life. description:

Murfreesboro Blackman DEC

To represent Goodwill's commitment to hospitality by assisting donors in a prompt, friendly manner when unloading their donations and providing receipts. To safeguard donations by sorting and packing them in proper receptacles in the donation center. To maintain a clean, organized area in and around the donation center.

  • Exhibit hospitality and a high level of customer service awareness, including being courteous and appreciative to all donors, providing donation receipts, and greeting donors promptly and cheerfully, and handling all donated items with care and gratitude.
  • Be prompt and consistent in attendance.

Required Skills:

Education

  • None

Experience

  • One (1) year of experience working with the public is desired.

  • Experience working outdoors is preferred.

title: ekspert(-ka) relacji z klientem
description:
To masz na bank:

  • ​​​umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),
  • pracę stacjonarną w 2 Oddziale w Zabrzu, ul. Dworcowa 8,
  • zespół/lider: Magdalena Piekorz - Ćwik,
  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premia w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej.

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom najlepsze doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Dbamy
o portfele klientów w ponad 300 oddziałach w całej Polsce. Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,
  • masz ponad 3-letnie doświadczenie w bankowości i sprzedaży usług i produktów bankowych, w tym produktów inwestycyjnych,
  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,
  • lubisz stawiać sobie ambitne cele i dobrze czujesz się wiedząc do czego dążysz,
  • czujesz się komfortowo zarówno w pracy indywidualnej jak i zespołowej,
  • chcesz się rozwijać w bankowości i zdobywać nowe kompetencje zgodnie z wybraną specjalizacją z zakresu Klient Zamożny, Hipoteka, MŚP.

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych,
  • doświadczenie w sprzedaży produktów inwestycyjnych (w tym funduszy),
  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • obsługę bardziej wymagających potrzeb klienta oraz wsparcie w wyborze najlepszych produktów i usług bankowych,
  • zapewnienie profesjonalnej obsługi oraz najlepszych doświadczeń związanych z wizytą w oddziale,
  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych,
  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych zadań sprzedażowych, za które przyznajemy miesięczne premie na atrakcyjnym poziomie,
  • telefoniczny i bezpośredni kontakt z klientami,
  • budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami oraz pozyskiwanie nowych,
  • praca w zgodzie z obowiązującymi procedurami oraz standardami dotyczącymi i realizowanymi we wszystkich kanałach dystrybucji.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),
  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),
  • ubezpieczenie na życie,
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,
  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,
  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,
  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,
  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.
  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.
  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i otrzymywać pierwsze premie.
  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.
  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

  • wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,
  • spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,
  • pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

Job Description:

Job Title

Developer – Situation Interpretation & Collision Threat Assessment for ADAS

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced C++ Developer to join the ADAS/Automated Driving software development team, focusing on situation interpretation, environment understanding, and collision threat assessment.

The role involves developing and integrating software components that interpret information from vehicle sensors and perception systems, understand the surrounding driving situation, and assess potential collision risks and threats for advanced driver assistance functions like front and rear collision avoidance systems.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in modern C++ development, automotive software engineering, ADAS/AD concepts, and experience working with the Automotive SW development experience ecosystem. Experience with perception, object tracking, prediction, risk assessment is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain C++ software components for situation interpretation and collision threat assessment in ADAS/AD systems.
  • Implement algorithms to analyse the vehicle's surrounding environment and identify potential collision scenarios and safety-critical situations.
  • Process and interpret inputs from perception and sensor-fusion components, including:
    • Object lists
    • Object classification
    • Object tracking
    • Object positions and velocities
    • Lane and road information
    • Ego-vehicle state
    • Traffic/environment information
  • Develop algorithms for collision risk assessment, including:
    • Time-to-Collision (TTC)
    • Time-to-React / Time-to-Impact concepts
    • Relative distance and velocity analysis
    • Collision probability/risk estimation
    • Path/lane conflict assessment
    • Cut-in, cut-out, crossing and merging scenarios
  • Contribute to situation interpretation and scene understanding, transforming low-level perception information into meaningful driving situations.
  • Develop and maintain software for detecting and evaluating dynamic and static obstacles and their potential interaction with the ego vehicle.
  • Support the definition and implementation of ADAS safety-relevant use cases and functional requirements.
  • Integrate software components within the development environment.
  • Work closely with teams responsible for:
    • Perception
    • Sensor Fusion
    • Object Tracking
    • Prediction
    • Motion Planning
    • System Engineering
    • Verification & Validation
  • Perform software design, implementation, debugging, unit testing, and integration testing.
  • Analyze simulation and vehicle-test data & traces to identify false positives, false negatives, and corner cases in collision-threat assessment.
  • Support SIL/MIL/HIL and vehicle-level testing of ADAS functions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure compliance with automotive software development standards and coding guidelines.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of algorithms, software architecture, performance, robustness, and maintainability.

Required Technical Skills

C++ / Software Development

  • Strong hands-on experience with C++17/C++20 or equivalent modern C++.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Object-oriented programming
    • STL
    • Templates
    • Smart pointers
    • Multithreading/concurrency
    • Memory management
    • Exception handling
    • Design patterns
  • Experience developing real-time and performance-critical software.
  • Good knowledge of software development, debugging, profiling, and optimization.
  • Experience with Git and modern CI/CD development environments.

Strong understanding of one or more of the following:

  • Environment perception
  • Object detection and tracking
  • Sensor fusion
  • Situation interpretation
  • Scene understanding
  • Object prediction
  • Collision avoidance
  • Collision threat assessment
  • Lane/road model interpretation

Hands-on knowledge of concepts such as:

  • Time-to-Collision (TTC)
  • Relative position, velocity and acceleration
  • Longitudinal and lateral collision risk
  • Object trajectory intersection
  • Predicted collision point
  • Collision probability
  • Safe distance / safety margins
  • Cut-in and crossing-object scenarios
  • Pedestrian and cyclist interaction
  • Vehicle-to-vehicle and vehicle-to-object collision scenarios
  • False-positive and false-negative analysis
  • Edge-case and corner-case handling

Testing & Validation

  • Experience with unit testing and integration testing of C++ software.
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as Google Test/Google Mock.
  • Experience with simulation-based validation of ADAS functions.
  • Ability to analyze recorded sensor/perception data and vehicle logs.
  • Experience with SIL, MIL, HIL, or vehicle testing.
  • Knowledge of scenario-based testing and automated test execution is a plus.
  • Familiarity with tools for trace analysis and KPI tracking.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to understand complex vehicle/environment interactions.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong ownership and commitment to software quality.
  • Ability to work in an agile development environment.
  • Comfortable working with safety-critical and quality-sensitive automotive software.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with ADAS Level 2/Level 2+ or higher automation functions.
  • Experience with ACC, AEB, FCW, LKA/LCC, emergency maneuvering, or collision avoidance functions.
  • Experience with vehicle trajectory prediction.
  • Knowledge of probabilistic methods and uncertainty handling.
  • Knowledge of machine-learning-based perception systems and their interfaces.
  • Python scripting for test automation and data analysis.
  • Experience with large-scale automotive software platforms.

Key Competencies

Must Have:

  • Modern C++
  • Automotive software development
  • ADAS/Automated Driving fundamentals
  • Situation interpretation / environment understanding & modelling
  • Collision threat assessment
  • Git and software development best practices
  • Unit/integration testing
  • Trace analysis and data pattern recognition for KPI tracking

Good to Have:

  • Sensor fusion
  • Object tracking and prediction
  • ASPICE
  • SIL/HIL/vehicle testing/ trace analysis

Working with Embitel

• There is no ‘I’ in word ‘Team’ and no hierarchy at Embitel

organization’s Mission and Vision

title: Spécialiste Performance Financière et Pricing

  • Poste basé à proximité du RER A/Ligne L Nanterre-Université,

description:

Visiting Faculty, Department of Biology

‌

Xavier University invites applications for a visiting faculty position in the Department of Biology to begin in Fall 2027, to complement its new undergraduate programs in Neuroscience. The successful candidate should bring a passion for teaching undergraduates. This is not a remote position. The position is renewable annually for up to three years, pending continued need. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

The individual must either be a Ph.D. candidate or hold a Ph.D. in an area of the biological sciences. Specialization in neuroscience required, with any area of neuroscience welcomed. Responsibilities include: teaching the equivalent of 4 courses per semester which may include courses in neuroscience, majors-level anatomy and/or physiology, professional skills courses for majors and/or other upper division courses of interest. Most of these are existing classes and already have materials prepared that will be shared.

Xavier is a member of the Association of Jesuit Colleges and Universities as well as the Big East. Xavier is growing, with life sciences a major focal direction. Xavier is a national university in the Carnegie classifications, and was recently named in the most innovative schools nationally by U.S. News and World Report.

At Xavier and in this department, we believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive environment that welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and manifests belonging. We welcome candidates from all walks of life with different strengths, experiences, beliefs, and backgrounds to apply.

Xavier University is part of the 500-year-old Jesuit Catholic tradition of academic excellence in the liberal arts and is strongly committed to enhancing equity, inclusion, and diversity. These values are central to our mission. We strive for a climate of respect and inclusiveness that welcomes and supports members from diverse backgrounds and life experiences, is committed unreservedly to open and free inquiry, and deliberately seeks out multiple perspectives.

Applicants should submit the following to Xavier University’s website, an application letter, curriculum vitae, statement of teaching philosophy that incorporates how you can support student belonging. Review of applications will begin January 4, 2027. Finalists will be asked for letters of recommendation. Questions may be sent to the Chair of the Department of Biology, Dr. Kat Morris, at morrisk10@xavier.edu.

Presales Consulting Manger, NetworkingThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

This position is for an existing vacancy. All interested candidates are encouraged to apply.


As the Presales Consulting Manger, you will lead a team of high-performing Sales Engineers responsible for supporting one of HPE Networking's most strategic customers. This leadership role is accountable for driving technical sales strategy, developing world-class presales talent, and partnering closely with account leadership to accelerate business growth and strengthen executive-level customer relationships.


The successful candidate will combine deep networking and telecommunications expertise with exceptional leadership, business acumen, and customer engagement skills. You will serve as the senior technical leader, ensuring our systems engineering team delivers differentiated customer outcomes through innovative networking, security, AI-driven networking, cloud, and infrastructure solutions.


Working closely with Sales Leadership, Product Management, Services, Channel Partners, and Executive Stakeholders, you will develop and execute technical account strategies, support large and complex opportunities, and foster a high-performance culture that enables growth and customer success.
This role requires the ability to effectively engage customer executives, influence strategic technology decisions, and lead a geographically distributed team through complex sales cycles and transformational initiatives.



Leadership & Team Development


  • Lead a talented Systems Engineering organization with deep expertise across networking domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, inclusion, and continuous technical growth.
  • Model HPE Bold Goals leadership behaviors—Think Big, Win as a Team, Act with Urgency, and Innovate & Transform.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain top technical talent while developing succession plans and career growth opportunities.
  • Establish team goals and performance metrics aligned with regional and corporate objectives.

Customer & Business Leadership


  • Serve as the senior technical leader and trusted advisor for service providers.
  • Develop executive-level relationships with customer technology and business stakeholders.
  • Partner with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to create and execute account strategies that drive revenue growth and market share expansion.
  • Provide strategic guidance on networking, security, cloud, AI, automation, and infrastructure initiatives.
  • Support executive briefings, customer workshops, and strategic planning sessions.

Presales & Technical Strategy


  • Lead technical sales engagements for complex, multi-domain networking and infrastructure opportunities.
  • Guide solution architecture, technical validation, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and competitive positioning efforts.
  • Ensure technical resources are aligned to priority opportunities and customer objectives.
  • Drive solution-selling methodologies that connect technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to address customer requirements and influence product direction.

Operational Excellence


  • Manage technical opportunity pipelines, forecasting activities, and resource planning.
  • Improve SE productivity, coverage, and technical program consistency across the Area.
  • Align resources to high‑value opportunities and ensure predictable, high‑quality execution.
  • Support HPE’s Operate Efficiently goals by simplifying processes and scaling best practices.
  • Drive consistency and operational rigor across the systems engineering organization.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends within the telecommunications industry.
  • Partner with channel organizations and strategic partners to expand market opportunities and customer engagement.

Required Experience


  • 10+ years of experience in networking, telecommunications, infrastructure, or cloud technologies.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing Systems Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Presales organizations.
  • Demonstrated success supporting large telecommunications providers, preferably service providers or comparable Tier 1 service providers.
  • Experience leading geographically distributed technical teams.
  • Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and participate in strategic customer engagements.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, telecom architectures, cloud networking, security, automation, and AI-driven infrastructure solutions.
  • Proven track record of supporting large-scale, complex sales opportunities and driving business results.
  • University or Bachelor's degree, advanced university or Master's degree preferred.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Strong expertise in Juniper networking technologies and carrier-class networking environments.
  • Experience with service provider architectures, WAN, routing, switching, SD-WAN, security, and network automation.
  • Deep expertise in service provider networking (MPLS, Segment Routing, BGP, IS-IS, etc.), data center networking (EVPN/VXLAN, leaf‑spine), and campus & branch networking.
  • Knowledge of AI-powered networking and cloud-native network operations.

title: Healthcare Director / DON
description:
2077 S. Independence Boulevard, Virginia Beach, Virginia 23453

Job Description

The Health Care Director (HCD) is responsible for leading the health and wellness activities for the community’s resident population and managing day-to-day healthcare operations. As the community clinical leader, the HCD manages a team of nurses, medication technicians and nursing assistants in the provision of quality care and services while assuring compliance with all applicable local, State and Federal regulations and Harmony Senior Services policies and standards.

  • Evaluates residents prior to move-in to assure that their care and service needs can be met in the community. Conducts reevaluations as indicated by the residents’ condition and/or State regulations.
  • Develops a service plan unique to each resident based on the evaluation and the resident’s stated preferences.
  • Revises the service plan as indicated by the residents’ condition and/or State regulations.
  • Participates in a review of the residents’ service plan with an interdisciplinary team including the resident, family members, physicians, other members of the community leadership team, third party medical providers, and community wellness team members to assure that the residents care and service needs are accurately reflected and the plan promotes resident safety and satisfaction.
  • Collaborates with each resident’s physician, pharmacist, and other members of their healthcare team to promote coordinated care and services.
  • Responsible for the community’s medication management program.
  • Collaborates with the pharmacy, and performs audits, manages physician orders, provides comprehensive oversight of controlled drugs and completes other activities that promote safety in the medication use process in compliance with all State/Federal/Local regulations.
  • Provides supervision and oversight for medication technicians,
  • Approved Medication Assistive Personnel (AMAP), and other State approved and trained unlicensed personnel who administer resident medications.
  • Provides training and conducts skill/competency validation and/or medication pass observations in accordance with State regulations.
  • Provides supervision and oversight for C.N.A. and other direct care personnel. Provides training as needed to assure that the assessed needs of residents are met.
  • Delegates appropriately and within the scope of practice of the nursing license the HCD holds.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of all applicable local, State and Federal regulations and assures that documentation meets all requirements, and the resident care department is survey ready at all times.
  • Participates in the development of and compliance with plans of correction, as applicable.
  • Serves as the community’s infection preventionist and oversees activities that prevent or limit the spread of communicable infectious illness based on established principles of infection control and prevention.
  • Monitors resident care and quality indicators to identify trends that may require attention and improvement plans. Discusses these in the community’s weekly At-Risk meeting or the monthly QAPI meeting.
  • Builds and develops the resident care team by interviewing, hiring, and onboarding new associates, serving as a resource for questions or concerns, providing ongoing training, evaluating performance, coaching and providing feedback, and fostering a culture of respect and fairness.
  • Collaborates with the Executive Director to assure the resident care department is operated within the established budget.
  • Collaborates with the Director of Sales and Marketing on external business development opportunities.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications


  • Current valid and unencumbered license to practice as an RN or LPN in accordance with State regulations and requirements.
  • Has completed any State-required training courses related to practicing nursing in assisted living (for example Delegating Nurse course, State-specific medication training courses etc.).
  • Must be able to think critically and apply knowledge and principles of the nursing process to promote safe, quality care.
  • 1-2 years’ experience required; 3 or more years’ experience preferred.
  • Supervisory/management experience is strongly preferred.
  • Current CPR certification is required.
  • Must be able to work occasional weekends, off-shifts and take calls after hours as needed.
  • Must be able to lift, carry and push up to 50 pounds.

Salary Range: $92,000 annually - $95,000 annually

Why Harmony?

  • 401k + Fulltime & Part-time Benefits Packages

  • Training, Development & Career Laddering

  • Great work-life balance

  • Flexible Scheduling

Job Description:

Role: HPE Networking Aruba Certification Lead

The Product Adoption Content and Education team develops and delivers the content our customers need to install, manage, and configure HPE Networking’s products and solutions. HPE Networking is all about powering connections and empowering change.

The courseware and certification developers on the this team strive for this goal daily by:

  • Putting teamwork first. We know that we can do so much more collectively than we can individually. We are respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and courageous. We also remember a huge part of teamwork is not taking ourselves too seriously and every day we try to sprinkle a little bit of fun into the mix.
  • Being unafraid to fail. We know that everything won't be done perfectly the first time. We go for it anyway. When we make mistakes, we get up, brush ourselves off, learn from experience, support each other, and try again.
  • Remembering why our work is important. Our job is to help make our customers successful. We do this through simplified onboarding, intuitive help in our applications, and giving customers the content they need when they need it. When we do this, we help make their lives better, which has intrinsic meaning. We also help make something essential to life as we know it, connectivity from anywhere to anywhere, possible. We measure our success against these goals.

We are looking for a Certification Lead to join our industry-leading certification team! In this role you’ll create customer-focused and manage certification content, including comprehensive concepts, examples, tasks, and hands-on activities for HPE Networking’s cutting-edge cloud services, automation, and networking products.
The ideal candidate is a subject matter expert in the content, and a persistent self-starter with strong collaborative skills who also has an interest in leading certification content development projects. This ideal candidate enjoys continuous learning and professional growth and can excel in a fast-paced, highly-technical working environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Certification Program Development & Workshop Management
    • Plan, schedule, staff, and actively participate in written certification development workshops.
    • Plan, schedule, staff, and actively participate in expert-level (E-level) certification workshops.
    • Maintain and manage a network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) based on technical expertise and specialization.
    • Communicate certification program objectives, processes, and requirements across the organization.
    • Evaluate and recommend new certification exams, specializations, and learning paths as emerging technologies are introduced.
  • Exam Blueprint & Content Development
    • Create, review, and maintain certification exam blueprints to ensure objectives and topics are accurately represented prior to workshop development.
    • Leverage AI-assisted tools to generate portions of exam content for upcoming certification workshops.
    • Review, validate, and consolidate existing exam items into a reusable practice item bank.
    • Edit, update, and enhance exam items to develop and maintain practice exams.
  • Expert-Level (E-Level) Exam Development
    • Convert workshop outputs into functional exam environments and validate all individual tasks to ensure known-good configurations.
    • Work with lab engineering teams to design, build, maintain, and validate master topologies used for expert-level certification exams.
    • Build and maintain exam forms and topology files for online delivery.
    • Troubleshoot and validate issues within expert-level exam delivery environments during candidate testing.
    • Review candidate and lab team feedback regarding expert-level study guides, labs, and supporting materials.
    • Evaluate technical exam feedback and propose detailed corrective actions and improvements.
  • Quality Assurance & Exam Maintenance
    • Review certification exam performance data to identify content updates, revisions, and security enhancements.
    • Work with operations teams to ensure exams are fully prepared and validated for delivery.
    • Coordinate with operations teams to publish and communicate updates related to new or revised exams.
    • Assist in maintaining exam integrity, accuracy, and alignment with current technologies and job roles.
  • Learning Content & Project Management
    • Partner with contractors and internal stakeholders to develop self-study bundles, lab content, and courseware materials.
    • Manage project activities associated with learning content development and delivery.
  • Candidate & Stakeholder Support
    • Provide guidance and recommendations to certification candidates regarding learning paths, certification tracks, and exam selection.
    • Explain and discuss the technical content, objectives, and value of certification exams with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Attend company events and testing activities to support candidate registration and certification operations.

Key Focus Areas

  • Certification Strategy
  • Exam Development
  • Technical Validation
  • Lab Design & Automation
  • SME Management
  • Quality Assurance
  • Operations Coordination
  • Project Management
  • Candidate Enablement
  • Certification Program Governance

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience producing technical content.
  • BA/BS in Technical Writing, English, Computer Science, or related degree/networking certification or comparable experience.
  • Ability to research complex technical concepts (independently and collaboratively).
  • Strong problem-solving skills; ability to make progress with less-than-complete information.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to utilize AI tools to scale the creation of content, retaining high quality output.
  • Hands-on experience with network technologies, including routing, switching, security, network automation, virtual machines, containers, and cloud-services.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expertise with the HPE Aruba Networking and/or HPE Juniper Networking products and technologies.
  • Have networking industry expert-level certifications.
