  • potrafisz zarządzać Zespołem Sprzedażowym w oparciu o współpracę, otwartą komunikację i partnerskie relacje,

  • masz minimum dwuletnie doświadczenie menedżerskie zdobyte w branży bankowej w segmencie małych i średnich przedsiębiorstw (MŚP) i w obszarze produktów detalicznych,

  • dobrze znasz ofertę produktów oferowanych przez nasz bank i konkurencję,

  • masz entuzjastyczne podejście do nowoczesnej, digitalnej bankowości,

  • znasz prawo bankowe,

  • skutecznie osiągasz wyniki biznesowe i Twoim priorytetem jest wysoka jakość obsługi klienta,

  • masz zdolności organizacyjne i dużą otwartość na zmiany,

  • posiadasz umiejętności: sprzedażowe, negocjacyjne, zarządzania czasem pracy, budowania relacji z klientem,

  • lubisz ciągły rozwój i inspirujesz innych do działania,

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych,

  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • zarządzanie oraz organizacja pracy podległego zespołu doradców klienta firmowego i zarządzanie oraz organizacja pracy zespołu specjalistów w obszarze produktów detalicznych,

  • dbanie o najwyższą jakość obsługi, budowanie relacji z klientami z segmentu małych i średnich przedsiębiorstw (MŚP) i w obszaru produktów detalicznych,

  • budowanie zaangażowanego i efektywnego Zespołu,

  • dbanie o przestrzeganie wyznaczonych procedur i standardów operacyjnych,

  • budowanie kultury ryzyka i odpowiedzialność za ryzyko w Zespole,

  • rozwój pracowników w Zespole, w tym podnoszenie kompetencji i wdrażanie nowozatrudnionych,

  • edukacja pracowników w zakresie wykorzystania nowych technologii Digital i promowanie aktywnego wykorzystywania nowych technologii z zakresu naszej oferty firmowej i detalicznej,

  • zarządzanie realizacją planów biznesowych Zespołu,

  • współpraca z innymi jednostkami naszego banku w celu realizacji celów strategicznych,

  • poszukiwanie źródeł do pozyskiwania nowych klientów poprzez współpracę z innymi kanałami/jednostkami wewnętrznymi/klientami zewnętrznymi,

  • budowanie marki na lokalnym rynku,

  • aktywny udział w udoskonalaniu procesów i zgłaszaniu propozycji nowych rozwiązań.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),

  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),

  • ubezpieczenie na życie,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),

  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,

  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,

  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,

  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,

  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci)

  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,

  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy. W tym czasie również weźmiesz udział w szkoleniu z rozwoju kompetencji menadżerskich.

  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,

spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,

pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

description:
About Tilray Brands, Inc.

Tilray Brands, Inc. (“Tilray”) (Nasdaq: TLRY; TSX: TLRY), is leading global lifestyle and consumer packaged goods company with operations in Canada, the United States, Europe, Australia, and Latin America that is leading as a transformative force at the nexus of cannabis, beverage, wellness, and entertainment, elevating lives through moments of connection. Tilray’s mission is to be a leading premium lifestyle company with a house of brands and innovative products that inspire joy, wellness and create memorable experiences. Tilray’s unprecedented platform supports over 40 brands in over 20 countries, including comprehensive cannabis offerings, hemp-based foods, and craft beverages.

Posting


INVENTORY CONTROL ASSOCIATE


Department: Supply Chain/Inventory

Reports To: Supply Chain Manager

Days/Hours: Full Time: Sunday – Thursday (10:00pm - 6:30am)

Compensation Type: Hourly - $20.00


JOB SUMMARY:

The Inventory Control Associate is responsible for maintaining records of materials in inventory and on order. Monitoring reorder points and initiates action to replenish stock. Reconciles discrepancies in inventories and notifies supervisor of irregularities

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Monitor and assist with maintaining current inventory levels by performing weekly and monthly physical inventory counts, recommending and executing replenishment.
  • Reconciling stock counts to computer/ERP generated reports; track orders and investigates problems.
  • Initiates action to replenish stock by processing purchase order requests and other related paperwork.
  • Record purchases, maintain database, track orders and investigates variances/discrepancies.
  • Receiving, unpacking and delivering items to shelves or to requesting department.
  • Process and document returns as required following established procedures.
  • Inspects shipments for accuracy and completeness and resolves inconsistencies.
  • Audit process documents to ensure accuracy; maintain database as necessary.
  • Update database with new product details as necessary.
  • Perform routine clerical duties, including data entry and answering telephones.
  • Maintains cleanliness and functionality of the inventory warehouse.
  • Collaborate all Departments to investigate and resolve Supply Chain issues.
  • Perform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to adapt promptly to any change in working condition and to get problems resolved without delay
  • Ability to perform even when under work pressure
  • Great verbal and written communication skills.
  • Highly organized and efficient in time management
  • Ability to relate across departments connected to the position, and with all other team members
  • Ability to handle several tasks simultaneously
  • Proficient with the use of the computer, especially Excel, Word, Outlook and Adobe.
  • Ability to reconcile stock counts to report data.
  • Strong data entry skills and accuracy.

EDUCATION:

  • Minimum of high school diploma with focus on business/computer curriculum.
  • Minimum of one year of inventory control experience.
  • Experience in a GMP/HACCP facility environment is an asset. (not required)

title: Skilled Facilities Worker (Short-Term)
description:
Zajac Ranch – Job Description, Skilled Facilities Worker (Short-Term)

Organization Overview

The Mel Jr. & Marty Zajac Foundation is a not-for-profit organization based in Vancouver, BC, dedicated to supporting children, seniors, and individuals with special needs through innovative community projects that foster lifelong skills, independence, and connection.

Our current major focus is Zajac Ranch, a fully accessible camp in Mission, BC, for children and young adults with complex medical conditions and disabilities. Located on over 41 acres of beautiful, forested land on the shores of Stave Lake, Zajac Ranch provides life-changing summer camp experiences and welcomes school groups, community groups, and private rentals during the off-season. Revenue generated from rentals helps support our medical summer camp programs.

Location: Zajac Ranch, Mission, BC
Reports To: Director, Facilities
Employment Type: Full-time, temporary (3-month term)
Compensation: $25 - $32/hr, commensurate with experience

Zajac Ranch is seeking a hands-on and reliable Skilled Facilities Worker to join our Facilities team for a three-month, full-time short-term position. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys practical, varied work and takes pride in keeping buildings, grounds, and shared spaces safe, functional, and welcoming.

The successful candidate may bring experience in general maintenance, carpentry, basic plumbing, repairs, painting, groundskeeping, handyman work, or other skilled trades. We understand that candidates may not have experience in every area listed below. We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic, a positive attitude, and a willingness to contribute where their skills are best suited.

This is a unique opportunity to work in a beautiful camp environment where your work directly supports children and young adults with medical conditions and disabilities.

Position Term & Potential Extension

This is a three-month, full-time temporary position intended to support current site-operations needs. At the end of the initial term, there may be an opportunity for extension based on ongoing site-operations requirements. Any extension would be subject to organizational need and mutual agreement and is not guaranteed.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities may include a combination of the following, depending on experience, skill set, and operational needs:

  • Support the repair, upkeep, and maintenance of Ranch buildings and facilities
  • Complete general handyman tasks, repairs, and preventative maintenance
  • Assist with carpentry projects, including basic construction, repairs, and finishing work
  • Assist with basic plumbing maintenance and repairs, including minor leaks, faucet and fixture repairs, toilet repairs, drain clearing, and other routine plumbing-related tasks
  • Monitor plumbing systems, water fixtures, washrooms, kitchens, and utility areas to help ensure they remain safe, functional, and in good working order
  • Identify and report larger plumbing concerns or issues requiring a licensed plumber or external contractor
  • Perform painting, patching, servicing, and general building upkeep
  • Support groundskeeping and yard maintenance, including lawn care, gardening, pruning, weeding, watering, and moving plants
  • Assist with pressure washing, seasonal clean-up, and outdoor maintenance
  • Chop and stack wood as needed
  • Help ensure facilities are clean, safe, functional, and ready for campers, staff, guests, and rental groups
  • Follow maintenance checklists, procedures, and work plans
  • Identify and report maintenance concerns, hazards, or repair needs in a timely manner
  • Work both independently and as part of the broader Ranch team

Qualifications & Experience

We welcome candidates with a variety of practical skills and backgrounds. Ideal candidates may have:

  • 2–5 years of experience in maintenance, carpentry, facilities, construction, repairs, plumbing, or a related hands-on role
  • Experience with general building repairs, maintenance, painting, carpentry, basic plumbing, or groundskeeping
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through practical maintenance challenges
  • Good time management and organizational skills
  • The ability to take direction and complete tasks efficiently
  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented approach
  • A positive, adaptable, and dependable attitude
  • Pride in quality workmanship and attention to detail

Candidates do not need to meet every qualification to be considered. If you have strong hands-on skills and are excited about contributing to a meaningful workplace, we encourage you to apply.

Skills & Competencies

  • General maintenance and repair skills
  • Carpentry knowledge or willingness to assist with carpentry-related work
  • Basic plumbing knowledge or willingness to assist with routine plumbing-related maintenance and repairs
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to follow detailed checklists, safety procedures, and instructions
  • Physical stamina for active, hands-on work
  • Commitment to cleanliness, safety, and maintaining a welcoming environment
  • Flexibility to support different projects and seasonal needs

Health & Safety

  • Follow all WorkSafeBC regulations and Zajac Ranch safety protocols
  • Report hazards, unsafe conditions, plumbing concerns, and maintenance issues immediately
  • Use tools, equipment, and materials safely and responsibly
  • Contribute to a safe environment for campers, staff, visitors, and rental groups

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift approximately 25–50 lbs.
  • Frequent bending, lifting, standing, walking, and hands-on physical work
  • Ability to work indoors and outdoors in a variety of weather conditions
  • Comfort working in a camp and rentals facility environment

Work Environment

  • Full-time, temporary three-month position, typically Monday to Friday
  • Work takes place onsite at Zajac Ranch in Mission, BC
  • Seasonal fluctuations in workload based on summer camp, rentals, projects, and site needs

title: specjalista(-ka) relacji z klientem
description:
To masz na bank:

  • ​​​umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),

  • pracę stacjonarną w 1 Oddziale w Giżycku,

  • lider zespołu- Marzena Sępkowska,

  • udział w atrakcyjnym systemie premiowym (z gwarantowaną premią w okresie wdrożeniowym) i w szerokiej ofercie benefitowej.

Na bank cenimy sobie relacje z ludźmi. Do oddziałów szukamy osób, które tak jak my chcą zapewnić naszym klientom najlepsze doświadczenie w sektorze finansowym - jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Dbamy o portfele klientów w ponad 300 oddziałach w całej Polsce. Zarządzamy wieloma produktami bankowymi dla osób prywatnych oraz przedsiębiorstw.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz minimum średnie wykształcenie,

  • posiadasz minimum roczne doświadczenie w bankowości i chcesz się rozwijać w tym sektorze,

  • cenisz sobie kontakt z ludźmi i długotrwałe relacje oparte na zaufaniu,

  • stawiasz sobie ambitne cele i dobrze się czujesz wiedząc do czego dążysz,

  • lubisz działać nie tylko indywidualnie, ale też zespołowo i osiągać wspólnie ustalone cele.

Mile widziane, jeśli będziesz mieć:

  • umiejętność porozumiewania się w języku angielskim na poziomie komunikatywnym, umożliwiającym kontakt z klientem zagranicznym i pomoc w wyborze odpowiednich produktów bankowych,

  • prawo jazdy kat. B.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • wspieranie klientów w wyborze najlepszych produktów i usług bankowych,

  • zapewnienie profesjonalnej obsługi oraz najlepszych doświadczeń związanych z wizytą w oddziale,

  • oferowanie i promowanie produktów bankowych,

  • realizacja indywidualnych i zespołowych zadań sprzedażowych, za które przyznajemy miesięczne premie na atrakcyjnym poziomie,

  • telefoniczny i bezpośredni kontakt z klientami,

  • budowanie długotrwałych relacji z klientami banku oraz pozyskiwanie nowych,

  • codzienną obsługę transakcji gotówkowych (w oddziałach gotówkowych) i bezgotówkowych,

  • praca w zgodzie z obowiązującymi procedurami oraz standardami jakości

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę (pierwszą na 7 miesięcy, po zakończeniu okresu wdrożenia możliwość zawarcia umowy na czas nieokreślony),

  • pracę stacjonarną w Oddziale (lokalizacja na początku oferty),

  • ubezpieczenie na życie,

  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),

  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na warunkach pracowniczych,

  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,

  • kartę Multisport oraz aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary,

  • możliwość udziału w wolontariacie,

  • dodatkowe świadczenia socjalne (np. wyprawka dla dzieci),

  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, praca hybrydowa, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,

  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w naszym banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie wrzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.

  • Pierwsze szkolenie będzie trwało 6 miesięcy w ramach Akademii Rozwoju Mocy.

  • Po 2 miesiącach zaczniesz realizować część planu sprzedażowego i wejdziesz do systemu premiowego.

  • Przez pierwsze miesiące pokażemy Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowiemy na wszystkie pytania.

  • Po okresie wdrożenia zaczniesz w pełni realizować plany sprzedażowe.

Dołącz do nas w 3 krokach:

wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu,

spotkaj się z rekruterem i menadżerem,

pracuj z nami w naszym Zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

description:
About the Company
Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in 2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

Job Description:

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer /Technical Lead – ADAS-SIL Testing

Group: ADAS/AD

BU : CARIAD Business Unit – India

Location: Whitefield, Bangalore


Experience: 6 to 10 years


Role Overview:

The ADAS VnV Technical Lead is responsible for leading the verification and validation (V&V) activities of ADAS functions. This role combines hands-on expertise in test automation, scenario modelling and scenario-based validation with leadership responsibilities to ensure the delivery of high-quality, safety-critical software components. The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) at Level 2, 2+, and 3, and manages the end-to-end software validation lifecycle aligned with ASPICE standards (SWE.4 to SYS.5). The Technical Lead drives test strategy promotes best practices in automation and continuous integration and ensures thorough coverage across functional and safety requirements.


Job Description:

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to Requirements review, Test specification, implementation, execution and analysis of functional, and system-level test cases for ADAS Driving functionalities, ensuring alignment with ASPICE and ISO 26262 standards.
  • Understand detailed design documentation/interface architectures and create corresponding test specifications (SWE.4-SYS.5) and create test cases using python based internal tooling
  • Analyze system and software requirements, including interface specifications, to derive functional and scenario-based test cases (SWE.6).
  • Scenario based SIL Testing
  • SiL Recompute
  • Use GIT for source control, test asset versioning, and collaboration within multi-developer teams.
  • Operate in Linux environments, using command-line tools to work with data platforms
  • Stay open to adopting AI/ML-based techniques in the future for enhanced test intelligence and automation.
  • Guide and mentor a team of test engineers in test development, execution, and evaluation for ADAS features.
  • Encourage a proactive, quality-first mindset and promote technical growth through knowledge sharing and continuous feedback.
  • Facilitate code reviews, process improvements, and innovation within the team.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and career progression of team members to meet evolving project needs.
  • Expertise in Test Design, techniques, Test strategies, Plan and methods.
  • Expertise in multiple domain technologies such as ADAS

Skills :

  • Bachelor’s degree in ECE, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in SWE.4,SWE.6,SYS.5 testing with a strong focus on ADAS- L2,L2+,L3 software & systems V&V
  • Proficient in Python
  • 5+ years of experience in test framework development in Python, preferably in automotive or ADAS systems
  • Testing exposure in ADAS features like Driving, Active Safety, Traffic Sign Visualization/recognition is mandatory.
  • Good understanding of Vehicle Dynamics
  • Experience in scenario-based testing. open Scenario/VTD/IPG CarMaker
  • Proven expertise in test automation and verification techniques across various test levels (unit, functional, integration and qualification testing).
  • Solid understanding of Functional Safety standards, particularly ISO 26262 and ASPICE process knowledge.
  • Skilled in working with SIL models and test framework updates, including scenario generator and model integration.
  • Proficient with CarMaker or similar tools for generating road files, setting up test environments, and integrating with 3rd party tools
  • Familiarity with test evaluation logging
  • Experienced with GIT for version control, test script management, and collaboration workflows.
  • Exposure to AI/ML concepts is considered a plus for future enhancements in test automation and analytics.
  • ISTQB Test certification is a strong plus.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Docker, and Jenkins is desirable.
  • Good to have:
  • Knowledge and experience in AI/ML validation techniques, particularly in the context of perception systems and data-driven ADAS features.
  • 5+ years of experience in test framework development in Python, preferably in automotive or ADAS systems

Working with Embitel

organization’s Mission and Vision

title: Director, Head of Hardlines, Licensing & Extended Line
description:
Job Description


Just imagine LEGO® branded hardline products reaching consumers around the world through standout partnerships, premium products, and new experiences. Then make it real.


About the role

As our Head of Hardlines, Licensing & Extended Line, you'll define and lead the future strategy for the Hardlines licensed business within the LEGO Group. Based in Copenhagen, you'll shape the category roadmap, grow and optimize the product portfolio, and build strong licensing partnerships that extend the reach of the LEGO® brand. You'll lead a small team, work closely with stakeholders across product development, creative, and commercial functions, and play an active role on the Licensing & Extended Line Leadership Team.


Required Qualifications

  • Delivered solid track record of outbound licensing experience with a strong focus on Hardlines, ideally in a global environment.
  • Built category strategies and roadmaps that translated business objectives into commercial results.
  • Led the development of premium brands through licensing partnerships.
  • Managed complex internal and external stakeholder networks within matrix organizations.
  • Directed teams and people toward shared business and category goals.
  • Applied analytical skills to assess commercial performance and identify market opportunities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Completed a master's degree in a business-related field or gained equivalent professional experience.


What you'll build

  • Create and drive the Hardlines strategy and category roadmap with key stakeholders.
  • Grow and optimize the Hardlines product portfolio through innovation and portfolio management.
  • Own key licensing partner relationships and support long-term commercial success.
  • Partner closely with creative teams to deliver high-quality product assortments.
  • Expand presence across priority markets and key retail partners.
  • Establish and develop a newly formed Hardlines team.

If you've worked in a role where you combined licensing strategy, partner management, portfolio development, and commercial leadership, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to balance brand building, commercial performance, and consumer relevance while turning strategy into action.


Life on the team

The Hardlines team is part of the Global Licensing & Extended Line organization. LEL is globally developing all non-brick physical consumer products for the LEGO Group. Together, we work to amplify the reach and relevance of the LEGO brand through high-quality products and experiences. You'll join a collaborative team environment where relationship building, curiosity, initiative, confidence, and partnership are valued. We work closely across functions and encourage different perspectives as we solve challenges together.


What success looks like

Success means creating a clear direction for the Hardlines category, building strong licensing partnerships, and developing a focused portfolio that strengthens consumer engagement. Over the next 12 to 18 months, you'll help shape the future growth of the business while working closely with licensing partners, product development teams, creative leaders, and senior stakeholders across the organization. You'll be at the center of turning opportunity into long-term impact for the category.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

description:

Help shape the clinical experiences that prepare tomorrow's physicians.

title: Demand Planner
description:
Join us as we empower the world to work out, creating healthier lives together.

At Life Fitness, we're passionate about helping people live healthier, more active lives. We're looking for a Demand Planner / Inventory Analyst to join our Supply Chain team and help us make smart, data-driven decisions around forecasting, inventory, and product availability.


This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving problems, improving processes, and collaborating with teams across the business.


This is a hybrid role based in Rosemont, IL, with remote work on Mondays and Fridays and in-office collaboration days Tuesday through Thursday

.


What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain demand forecasts for finished goods across business units.
  • Analyze historical data, identify trends, and use insights to improve forecast accuracy.
  • Review forecast assumptions and challenge conclusions that aren't supported by data.
  • Analyze forecast errors, stockouts, and excess inventory to identify root causes and recommend solutions.
  • Translate revenue forecasts into unit forecasts.
  • Monitor inventory levels and product availability at our U.S. distribution center.
  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards tracking key supply chain metrics such as forecast accuracy and inventory turns.
  • Support the SIOP process by gathering and consolidating forecast information from domestic and international teams.
  • Support new product launches and product phase-in/phase-out planning.
  • Build forecasting models and scenarios using Excel and other analytical tools.

title: specjalista (-tka) ds. monitoringu kredytów
description:
Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę na zastępstwo
  • pracę hybrydową (częściowo w biurze w Warszawie, Pl. Europejski 3A, częściowo w domu)
  • zespół: Zespół Monitoringu Kredytów

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. W naszej centrali łączymy kilkanaście jednostek biznesowych, w tym nasze zaplecze technologiczne. Choć jesteśmy zupełnie różni to mamy jeden cel - wszystko robimy na bank.

Na co dzień pracujemy w metodyce agile - w chapterach i squadach. Mamy też możliwość integracji z innymi pracownikami np. dzięki ponad 20 Klubom Zainteresowań.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • posiadasz minimum 3–letnie doświadczenie na podobnym stanowisku
  • masz bardzo dobrą znajomość programów pakietu MS Office
  • masz wykształcenie wyższe
  • potrafisz budować i utrzymywać pozytywne relacje z klientem wewnętrznym i zewnętrznym
  • lubisz pracować zespołowo, potrafisz zadbać o pozytywną atmosferę, chętnie dzielisz się wiedzą i wspierasz osoby z zespołu
  • cechujesz się umiejętnością ustalania priorytetów oraz kolejności zleconych zadań
  • posiadasz umiejętność logicznego i analitycznego myślenia
  • wykazujesz dużą otwartość na zmiany i na zdobywanie nowej wiedzy
  • jesteś komunikatywna/y i lubisz pracować pod presją czasu

Twoje zadania w tej roli:u

  • monitoring transakcji kredytowych, zobowiązań umownych, w tym w zakresie zabezpieczeń
  • kontakt z klientem biznesowym i korporacyjnym, w tym pozyskiwanie dokumentów finansowych i niefinansowych i innych danych do monitoringu klienta
  • zasilanie pozyskanymi danymi odpowiednich narzędzi analitycznych
  • analiza dokumentów kredytowych i udział w posprzedażowym procesie kredytowym
  • bieżąca współpraca z jednostkami uczestniczącymi w procesie (m.in. Bankierzy, Lending, DZiUK, Ryzyko, Obszar Prawny)
  • raportowanie statusów prac w ramach monitoringu
  • udział w projektach, inicjowanie zmian



To masz na bank:

  • umowę na zastępstwo,
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym,
  • możliwość zwinnej pracy w zespole projektowym w ramach metodyki Agile,
  • wpływ na zakres i priorytety podczas planowania prac zespołu,
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,
  • kartę Multisport,
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach,
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony,
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci,
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne,
  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.
  • Na początku Twój przełożony pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach.

  • Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.
  • Spotkaj się (online) z rekruterem(-ką) i managerem(-ką).
  • Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

description:

Job Description:

The Parts Coordinator’s primary responsibility and accountability is to provide an exceptional and successful customer experience while proactively managing the process of ordering, receiving, storing, dispatching and returning parts for each repair order. The Parts Coordinator plays a pivotal role in the success of the customer’s experience by verifying the accuracy and quality of parts received in a timely manner as per the production schedule and vehicle needs.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Ensure consistent execution of WOW (Wow Operating Way) plan.

  • Communicate all customer requests and needs to appropriate team members.

  • Work with vendors to order and receive all parts as indicated on the repair orders confirming the quality, correctness and quantity of parts received, accurately identifying parts necessary to complete repairs in the shop.

  • Ensure timely parts distribution to the shop in accordance with the production schedule.

  • Enter all parts invoices into the recommended Management Information System (MIS).

  • Label and track all parts by the R.O.# and store them with the vehicle and/or scheduled repairs; Communicate all Parts Price Changes (also known as Parts Price Increases - PPI) to all required team members.

  • Order and receive supplemental Parts in the MIS, monitor performance of parts, materials and sublet vendors. Ensure daily reconciliation of the parts vendor invoice history report (e.g. 043 Report).

  • Ensure invoices and credit memos are posted and filed/scanned in a timely manner.

  • Ensure vendor invoices have the correct negotiated discount to maintain proper profit margins.

Education and/or Experience Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

  • 1-3+ years of experience working with automotive parts (auto body parts is a bonus)

  • Customer Service Oriented and strong organizational ability to manage pressure and conflicting demands and prioritize tasks takes initiative in problem solving situations

  • I-Car Registered (working towards Gold Class certification)

Required Skills/Abilities ​

  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing

  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.

  • Effectively manage a fast-paced environment, demonstrating multi-tasking ability while working under pressure

  • Working knowledge of vehicle repairs practices

  • Management Information System: Summit, Repair Centre

  • Working Knowledge of: Mitchell, Audatex

  • Solid problem-solving abilities

  • Above average computer proficiency

  • Above average organizational skills

  • Ability to keep up and succeed in a fast-paced working environment

  • Ability to work well with others and achieve common goals

  • Other duties as assigned

Other Requirements

  • Frequently required to bend, crouch, reach, handle tools

  • Lift in excess of 50 lbs. of materials

We provide innovative professional and liberal arts educational experiences that prepare students to be critical thinkers and engaged global citizens.

POSITION:

Part-time, Adjunct Instructor

RESPONSIBILITIES:

VTSU Online uses Canvas and provides a generic course template for all courses. The instructor is responsible for adding outcomes, academic materials, discussion and assignment that support the course description. Additionally, VTSU Online instructors are obligated to adhere to the VTSU Online Standards that address instructor presence, student engagement, instructor expectations, and assessment of student work.

Course # & Name: EDU-3445-SO01: Engineering Design in the Classroom

Credits: 3

Course description:

Beginning with a review of the basic principles of physical processes, this course introduces students to the design procedures for mechanical operations and problem solving. With consideration of social context, scientific methods, and principles of engineering, students learn when and how mechanics are useful for addressing real-world problems. The social and ethical effects of science and engineering are considered.

Qualifications:

For consideration, candidates must possess at least a master's degree in a related discipline or equivalent experience. For consideration, candidates must possess at least a master’s degree in a related discipline. A minimum of five years of experience teaching fully online, asynchronous courses is required, along with demonstrated familiarity with adult learning theory. Experience with Canvas is preferred. Faculty are responsible for designing their own course with the full support of an instructional designer and the structured VTSU Online Canvas Template. Instructors are expected to add weekly content including outcomes, readings, videos, discussions, and assessments in alignment with the course description, and follow and VTSU Online Standards of course design, readiness, instructor presence, engagement, assessment, and accessibility. The full course must be ready and published at least one week prior to the start of the semester.

Candidates should submit a cover letter, resume, a letter of reference, academic transcript, and statement of commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion. Compensation is dependent upon online teaching experience (within and outside of the Vermont State Colleges System) and bargaining unit status; the starting range is between $1000-1250 per credit.

description:

Job Description:

As a Senior Systems Engineer - HPE Campus & Branch, you will serve as an HPE Mist specialist partnering with the AI for Networking Seller and be the trusted technical advisor supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers throughout the customer lifecycle. You will partner closely with HPE account teams to win new customers, expand strategic accounts, and ensure existing customers remain successful.


You will lead from the front by driving technical discovery, architecture discussions, demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements. You will help HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers develop winning technical strategies, differentiate HPE Mist from competitive solutions, and guide customers from initial evaluation through successful adoption and operational outcomes.


Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, executive presence, and the ability to build trusted relationships across customers, partners, sales teams, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Customer Success.


Responsibilities


Partner with HPE Sales Teams


· Act as the HPE Mist technical specialist supporting HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers across strategic sales opportunities.

· Partner with account teams to develop technical account strategies that drive new-logo acquisition, competitive displacement and customer expansion.

· Engage early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify technical and business requirements, and align HPE Mist solutions to desired outcomes.

· Provide technical leadership throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from qualification and discovery through design, validation, close, deployment, and adoption.

· Build strong working relationships with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers and operate as an extension of the account team.


Lead Technical Sales Engagements


· Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and executive briefings.

· Translate complex customer requirements into clear, differentiated HPE Mist architectures and solution recommendations.

· Communicate effectively with audiences ranging from network engineers and architects to IT leaders, CISOs, and CIOs.

· Develop competitive technical strategies and position the unique value of HPE Mist AI-native networking against alternative solutions.

· Create compelling customer experiences that build technical confidence, accelerate decisions, and improve win rates.


Drive Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept


· Own and lead HPE Mist demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements from planning through successful completion.

· Define clear POC objectives, success criteria, test plans, customer responsibilities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

· Configure, deploy, validate, and troubleshoot HPE Mist solutions in customer environments.

· Partner with HPE Territory Managers and Systems Engineers to convert successful technical evaluations into production opportunities.

· Document results, lessons learned, and reusable best practices that improve future demonstrations and POCs.


Ensure Customer Success


· Serve as a trusted technical advisor before, during, and after the sale to help customers realize the full value of HPE Mist.

· Provide architecture guidance, migration planning, deployment best practices, operational recommendations, and adoption support.

· Proactively identify technical risks, adoption barriers, and customer health concerns, then coordinate the right HPE resources to drive resolution.

· Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product Management, and Engineering on strategic customer needs and escalations.

· Help maintain happy customers who become long-term advocates and references for HPE Mist.


Maintain HPE Mist Technical Excellence


· Develop and maintain deep expertise across HPE Mist wireless, wired, WAN, access assurance, location services, cloud operations, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.

· Stay current on product releases, architectures, competitive developments, industry standards, and emerging campus and branch technologies.

· Be hands-on with design, configuration, demonstrations, troubleshooting, and customer validation.

· Create and share technical content, design guidance, demos, best practices, and reusable enablement materials.

· Contribute actively to the broader HPE Mist technical community and promote a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.


Enable HPE Teams and Partners


· Enable HPE Territory Managers, Systems Engineers, partners, and distributors through mentoring, technical training, workshops, and opportunity support.

· Help scale HPE Mist expertise across the field by sharing repeatable sales motions, competitive insights, demo practices, POC methodologies, and lessons learned.

· Support customer events, webinars, seminars, executive briefings, partner sessions, and field enablement programs.

· Collaborate across HPE teams to ensure consistent positioning and a unified customer experience.


HPE Campus & Branch Mist Expertise


The successful candidate will develop and maintain specialist-level expertise across:

· HPE Mist AI and Marvis AI

· Enterprise wireless networking and Wi-Fi 6E/Wi-Fi 7

· Campus and branch switching

· Wireless Assurance and Wired Assurance

· WAN Assurance and branch networking

· NAC, identity, and network access control

· Location Services and user engagement capabilities

· Cloud management, APIs, automation, and AI-driven operations

· Campus routing, segmentation, resiliency, and security architectures


Qualifications


· 7+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, technical consulting, or a related enterprise networking role.

· Proven success supporting complex technical sales cycles, customer demonstrations, architecture workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements.

· Deep knowledge of enterprise wireless networking, including RF fundamentals, industry standards, site surveys, high-density design, roaming, security, and troubleshooting.

· Strong campus and branch networking knowledge, including Ethernet, VLANs, TCP/IP, Layer 2/Layer 3 design, routing, switching, multicast, QoS, ACLs, firewalls, segmentation, and resiliency.

· Experience with identity and access technologies including 802.1X, AAA, RADIUS, EAP methods, certificates, SAML, and common client operating systems.

· Experience designing and supporting large campus, distributed enterprise, and branch networking environments.

· Hands-on experience with wireless design and validation tools such as Ekahau, Hamina, NetAlly, or iBwave.

· Familiarity with REST APIs, Python, scripting, automation, cloud integrations, or Infrastructure as Code is highly desirable.

· Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

· Executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with technical practitioners, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.

· Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic opportunities and customer engagements simultaneously.

· Self-motivated, collaborative, and passionate about customer success, technical excellence, and winning as a team.

· Ability to travel up to 50% based on customer and business needs.


Preferred Experience and Certifications


· Prior experience with HPE Mist, Aruba or another leading enterprise networking platform.

· Experience supporting competitive displacement and complex enterprise transformation initiatives.

· Relevant industry certifications such as CWNP/CWNE, JNCIP/JNCIE, CCNP/CCIE, CISSP, or equivalent.

title: Play Ideation Internship
description:
Job Description

Are You an Aspiring Ideator Looking to Discover New Play?

Join the LEGO® Group’s Play Discovery team within the Creative Play Lab for a Paid Internship at our Head Quarters in Billund, Denmark!

Are you driven by an unquenchable passion for discovering new play opportunities through early-stage ideation, concept development, and prototyping? If so, you could be one of the talented students joining our Play Discovery department this year, where creativity and imagination thrive!

Start date: September 2026

Length: 4 months (until end of December 2026)

About us:

Creative Play Lab is an ambitious, future‑focused innovation hub inventing radical new play opportunities and never‑seen‑before experiences for LEGO® fans of today and tomorrow. We grow the boundaries of what play can become, using bold experimentation, advanced technologies, and deep insight into how kids play to imagine meaningful, next‑generation experiences. Our mix of creatives, innovators, researchers, engineers, and technologists rapidly transforms curiosity into tangible concepts, redefining the future of play and ensuring LEGO® play remains at the forefront of creativity and joyful exploration.

As an intern in our Play Discovery department, you’ll join teams dedicated to letting loose their creative curiosity and exploring new play experiences. You’ll unleash your imagination across a range of innovation missions, collaborating cross-functionally to develop concepts into playable prototypes.

About the Internship:

We look for interns who bring something genuinely different to our innovation hub, adding fresh cultural insight, creative energy, and new ways of thinking. Your time with us will span personal curiosity projects, team capability-building initiatives, and innovation Missions. Every day is different and you’ll learn directly from a world‑class multidisciplinary team as you build your craft, embracing ambiguity as you discover new play experiences.

Meet the Play Ideation team:

The Play Ideation team champions the exploration and shaping of early‑stage ideas and future possibilities. We turn ‘what if?’ into ‘what’s next?’ by helping teams nurture emerging concepts and seed visions that can be felt, tested, understood, and communicated. We grow early sparks into visions for new play by cultivating a creative, collaborative, and playful environment.

Internship Eligibility:

To qualify for this internship opportunity, you must meet all of the following criteria: (1) You will be a student for the full duration of the internship period; (2) You are currently due to graduate after 31st December 2026; (3) You will not be requesting a delayed graduation date to qualify for this internship; (4) This internship will contribute quantitatively towards your course credit and is a compulsory part of your education; (5) You are available to undertake this internship contract starting from 1st September 2026 and ending on 31st December 2026 in Billund, Denmark.

We also encourage interns to have experience with at least some of the following:

  • Sketching

  • Concept Artwork

  • Graphic Design

  • Facilitation

  • LEGO® Model Building

  • Animation

  • Videography / Editing

  • Artistic hobbies – music, art, dance, design, fashion etc.

  • Cultural awareness – visiting exhibitions, researching, exploring, travelling

What we’re looking for:

Curiosity: Our teams thrive on a playful curiosity in all they do. You need to be always asking questions, seeking the reason “why”, digging for answers even when it’s hard and never stop wondering “what if...”

Bravery: Our organisation is a huge place full of different people and different perspectives. You need to be comfortable meeting new people every day, speaking up when you disagree, receiving feedback, facing the unknowns of innovation head on and forging yourself a path when things aren’t well defined.

Focus: Our workload and priorities are always changing. You need to be happy shifting priorities fast, focusing on a high priority task one week then focusing on developing your own independent curiosities the next.

Responsibilities:

We want you to bring all your energy, enthusiasm and experiences to work every day so we can achieve amazing things together while you learn along the way. Some of your typical responsibilities could include...

  • Supporting teams in facilitating their ideation sessions

  • Helping to turn sparks into visualisations into concepts

  • Exploring your own ideation and directions for creative exploration

  • Challenging teams to think outside the norm and broaden their horizons

Perks:

  • Work with a passionate multi-disciplinary team of like-minded creative inventors where you’ll learn something new every day and build your professional network

  • Live and work in the global headquarters of the LEGO® Group in Billund, Denmark and explore our state-of-the-art campus

  • Be an active co-creator with kids – they know how to make fun and meaningful play.

Application:

We welcome international applications for this role however you must be able to live and work in Billund, Denmark for the duration of the internship itself. The LEGO® Group will provide support with permits to work in Denmark for the internship period and we can support with finding accommodation. The costs of your accommodation along with your travel costs to/from Denmark must be covered by you.

We have multiple Play Discovery internships available, each supporting a different team with their own focus area. Take a moment to review all these opportunities and apply only to those that truly align with your strengths. If you have broad skills, applying to more than one team is acceptable but applying to a large number of teams doesn’t increase your chances of making a successful application and makes it harder for us to understand where you’d shine. Please be thoughtful in your approach.

Please ensure your application is completed in English.

To apply, simply submit the following by Saturday 25th April 2026. Please do not risk missing this deadline as we will not consider late applications for this role.

Please attach the following items to your application as 4 separate .PDF documents. Applications failing to do this shall not be considered.

  • An A4 size poster (landscape) designed by you to showcase why you think you are a good fit for the internship. You may use text, photographs, colour etc. to communicate your enthusiasm, talent and values.

  • A current CV detailing your education and relevant experiences.

  • A full portfolio showcasing a more in-depth range of your work. This should include projects that highlight your interests, reflect your passions and demonstrate your hobbies.

  • A bespoke cover letter (no more than 200 words) that tells us what motivates you to apply for this internship and why you think you’re best suited for the placement. If you can do or say something to help your cover letter stand out then please do. We encourage you to be original and authentic to who you are.

Come and join us as we discover the future of play!

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect:

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process.

Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong.

The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team.

The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer.

Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights.

Just imagine building your dream career.

Then make it real.

Join the LEGO® team today.

About the Company
Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in 2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

The Senior Product Manager, Cost and Coverage owns the end-to-end financial front door for members from understanding the cost of care to collecting payment from members upfront or providing financing options where needed, and ensuring the post-encounter Explanation of Benefits is simple and accurately matches the cost estimate provided. This role defines the product strategy, vision, and value proposition of Highmark’s cost transparency and coverage experiences. The ideal candidate outlines the strategic vision and business case, gains alignment and support from key strategic partners and stakeholders, and oversees execution of that vision, while also coaching and guiding junior team members.


This role is currently envisioned as a “player-coach model” to 3 other product managers/analysts with growth potential into formal people management.

This is a business product development role, not a technology product role. Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to independently develop business cases is required.

The Cloud Developer builds from the ground up to meet the needs of mission-critical applications, and is always looking for innovative approaches to deliver end-to-end technical solutions to solve customer problems. title: Specjalista(-ka) / Starszy(-a) Specjalista(-ka) ds. zarządzania wydatkami
description:
To masz na bank:

  • umowa o pracę (pierwsza na 12 miesięcy),
  • praca w modelu hybrydowym (częściowo w biurze we Wrocławiu, ul. Robotnicza 11 (przy muzeum współczesnym)),
  • zespół/lider: Zespół Zarządzania Wydatkami, Milena Popendo,
  • cel roli: rozwój controllingu wydatków, planowania i analiz w zakresie kosztów, nakładów, zasobów i projektów oraz bycie partnerem dla biznesu.

Należymy do pierwszej trójki największych banków w Polsce i jesteśmy częścią międzynarodowej Grupy Erste. Jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym. Choć jesteśmy zupełnie różni to mamy jeden cel - wszystko robimy na bank. Mamy też możliwość integracji z innymi pracownikami np. dzięki ponad 20 Klubom Zainteresowań.
Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.


Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • udział w procesach controllingowych dla kosztów, nakładów, zasobów,
  • wsparcie procesów planowania finansowego, budżetowania i kontroli wydatków,
  • zapewnienie efektywnego wykorzystania środków budżetowych oraz utrzymanie wysokiej jakości procesów zarządzania kosztami operacyjnymi, nakładami inwestycyjnymi oraz kosztami amortyzacji,
  • współpraca z jednostkami organizacyjnymi Banku (business partnering) w celu wsparcia zarządzania wydatkami,
  • wspieranie inicjatyw, mających na celu poprawę efektywności wykorzystania środków budżetowych,
  • przygotowywanie analiz finansowych i rekomendacji wspierających podejmowanie decyzji biznesowych,
  • identyfikowanie potencjalnych ryzyk i możliwości optymalizacji kosztów,
  • udział w rozwoju narzędzi i systemów wspierających zarządzanie wydatkami.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz wyższe wykształcenie – preferowane kierunki ścisłe lub ekonomiczne,
  • masz doświadczenie w obszarze finansów i/lub analizy danych,
  • potrafisz z jednej strony myśleć analitycznie i pracować z dużą ilością danych liczbowych, z drugiej zaś współpracować i budować relacje,
  • posiadasz umiejętność rozwiązywania problemów,
  • chcesz rozwijać się jako partner dla biznesu wspierający procesy zarządzania wydatkami,
  • masz motywację do rozwoju i podnoszenia kwalifikacji zawodowych,
  • cechuje Cię pro-aktywność, dbałość o szczegóły, samodzielność, odpowiedzialność za powierzone zadania oraz umiejętność pracy w zespole.

Mile widziane:

  • znajomość i doświadczenie w pracy z Oracle Business Intelligence / EPM (Oracle Hyperion Planning), MS SQL, Power Query.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę;
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym;
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego);
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego;
  • kartę Multisport;
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach;
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony;
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci;
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala;
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne.


Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?
Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań. Przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach:
1. Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.
2. Spotkaj się (online) z rekruterem/-ką i managerem/-ką.
3. Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania.
Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

08/28/26

Job Type

Election Workers (Seasonal)

Department

Elections

About the Position

Ready to combine your technical skills with a civic purpose? Join Maricopa County Elections as a Temporary T-Tech!

As a Temporary T-Tech, you are responsible for providing technical collaboration with our Poll Workers. You will provide troubleshooting, equipment security, and retrieval services. You will assist with technical conflict resolutions at our polling sites, supporting our election activities before, during, and after the election cycle.

Apply today! Temporary Election Workers who meet the eligibility requirements can earn a one-time $1,250 retention incentive. Don’t miss your opportunity to qualify!

About Us

Maricopa County Elections serves over 2.5 million registered voters as they exercise their right to make informed decisions regarding the selection of local and national leaders and ballot measures. We believe in teamwork, creating a vibrant, exciting work environment, and pursuing opportunities to make a positive impact in the communities that make up the 4th largest and fastest-growing County in the United States! Our work supports elections in cities, towns, school districts, and special districts, and we look forward to welcoming you to our team!

Proud To Offer

  • Work with a greater purpose
  • Opportunities for growth and development within Maricopa County
  • Want to learn more about the County’s Qualifying and Compensation Philosophy? Follow this link to learn more! Work With Us | Maricopa County, AZ

We Require

This position requires a high school diploma or GED.

Other Requirements

  • Must be a registered voter or have the ability to become a registered voter in the State of Arizona by the time of hire
  • May require the use of a personal vehicle, which would require a valid driver’s license, current auto insurance, and attendance in Maricopa County’s Defensive Driving Course
  • Must possess or have the ability to obtain a valid unrestricted Arizona driver's license by the time of hire
  • Must pass an applicable background screening
  • Must be able to work overtime as necessary

We Also Value

  • One or more years of professional driving experience
  • One or more years of general office experience
  • One or more years of warehouse experience
  • One or more years of computer experience or information technology
  • One or more years of customer support experience
  • One or more years of election experience

  • Supports troubleshooting efforts throughout the election cycle and equipment security and retrieval activities at the close of Election Day
  • Travels throughout Maricopa County to perform laptop software, hardware installations, configurations, repairs, and ongoing support
  • Works in collaboration with Poll Workers to set up Vote Centers and Polling Locations before opening for election activities
  • Prepares and retrieves information and enters/updates information in reports, logs, or other documentation/record-keeping systems
  • Carries a 50lb backpack of materials for repairs throughout the assignment
  • Analyzes programs to ensure prompt problem resolution and ticket closure
  • Assists other divisions of Elections with their daily functions and activities, along with other job duties as assigned

Working Conditions

  • Full-time/Temporary/Overtime/Holiday hours are mandatory during the election cycle
  • Requires the ability to sit or stand for extended periods, to lift floor-to-shoulder and shoulder-to-waist up to 50 pounds, and carry it for 100 feet, to push/pull up to 50 pounds for 200 feet, to stoop and bend, and the use of upper extremity repetitive motions
  • Closed-toed shoes must be worn at all times
  • Work may occur outdoors in high temperatures or indoors
  • Utilizes a personal vehicle to travel within Maricopa County
  • Must not engage in any political discussion

Requires the use of:

  • Sitebooks

We are looking for a Java Full Stack Developer — SME Level to join our onsite technology team and help deliver enterprise-grade solutions with quality, scalability, and performance at the center.   • Complete all assigned, mandatory training within the timeframe provided.
  • Conduct and/or participate in regularly scheduled 1:1 meetings with your direct manager and/or direct reports.

Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Enterprise Java development using Java 8/17.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Core Java, J2EE fundamentals, and enterprise application architecture.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spring Boot.
  • Experience with Linux at an intermediate level.
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Solr, and Apache Spark.
  • Experience with enterprise caching platforms such as Coherence, Apache Ignite, or Redis.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and consuming REST APIs.
  • Experience with messaging services, preferably Kafka.
  • Basic experience using AWS SDK and Azure SDK.
  • Experience with Angular for front-end application development.
  • Very strong NoSQL database management skills.
  • Expert analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
  • Ability to perform code reviews and mentor junior developers.
  • Strong commitment to high-quality delivery, production stability, and defect prevention.

Good to Have

  • Experience with graph databases.
  • Experience with Cassandra or MongoDB.
  • Experience with Docker.
  • Exposure to IoT solutions.
  • Experience with ETL tools.
  • Knowledge of Agile development methodology.
  • Experience with web services or JMS.
